title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
title_zh: SEAR：自我演化的智能体机器人技术

paragraphs.en: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿语言模型智能体现在能够自主改进机器人：它们编写控制代码、进行测试，并将有效部分作为技能和记忆保留下来，用于下一项任务。 我们提出了 SEAR（自我演化的智能体机器人系统），这是一个围绕两个问题构建的框架和基准测试。 智能体是真的在学习，还是仅仅尝试得更频繁？ 而且，它所学到的内容是否仍然能帮助它在新的任务、新的模拟器以及真实机器人上发挥作用？ 该框架以三种模式运行智能体：编写成为策略的代码（代码即策略）、在控制回路中实时执行（智能体即策略），或作为研究人员微调视觉-语言-动作模型（自动研究）。 该基准测试增加了控制机制，以区分保留的经验与重复尝试、熟悉的任务、特权模拟器状态、更大的预算以及运气。 通过七种前沿语言模型、330 项模拟任务和五项物理任务，以及超过四年的智能体运行时间，我们总结出三项发现。 首先，机器人智能体的学习曲线既取决于总的时间预算，也取决于相对于模型能力的任务难度。 更难的任务使得更长的运行时间更有价值；而在较易的任务中，重复执行简短的尝试同样有效。 其次，控制代码和共享程序可以在不同任务和模拟器之间迁移，而特定于任务的解决方案则无法迁移。 在真实机器人上，我们观察到智能体设计的练习场景与全新的人类设计场景之间存在性能差距。 第三，不同模型以不同的方式实现更有效的演化。 有些模型通过实时执行表现最佳，而另一些则先编写代码。 而且，一个纯文本模型能够与一个功能相当的跨模态模型保持同步：感知能力有助于错误评估，但智能体推理和工具使用可能更为关键。 我们公开了该基准测试和代码库，以支持未来的研究。

paragraphs.en: Language-model (LM) agents can now improve robots on their own. Given a task and a way to check success, a coding agent writes a control program, runs it, reads what went wrong, and revises the program. It can save what worked as a skill for the next task, or collect its own rollouts and fine-tune a vision-language-action model (VLA) on them. Recent systems run this self-improvement loop in simulation and on real robots ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Waddle Labs, 2026 ) . Robots need this ability because, once deployed, they meet objects, conditions, and tasks that no one prepared them for, and no engineer is there to rewrite their programs.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型（LM）智能体现在能够自主提升机器人的性能。 给定一项任务和验证成功的方法，编码智能体会编写控制程序、运行该程序、读取出错信息，并修订程序。 它可以将有效的方法保存为技能用于下一项任务，或者收集自身的执行记录，并基于这些记录对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）进行微调。 近期的系统在这一模拟环境和真实机器人上运行这种自我改进循环（Fu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a；Lu et al., 2026；Xiao et al., 2026；Waddle Labs, 2026）。 机器人需要这种能力，因为一旦部署，它们会遇到无人预料到的物体、条件和任务，而现场也没有工程师可以重新编写它们的程序。

sents.zh: 近期的系统在这一模拟环境和真实机器人上运行这种自我改进循环（Fu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a；Lu et al., 2026；Xiao et al., 2026；Waddle Labs, 2026）。

sents.en: Robots need this ability because, once deployed, they meet objects, conditions, and tasks that no one prepared them for, and no engineer is there to rewrite their programs.
sents.zh: 机器人需要这种能力，因为一旦部署，它们会遇到无人预料到的物体、条件和任务，而现场也没有工程师可以重新编写它们的程序。

paragraphs.en: A rising success rate, however, is not proof that the agent learned. We ask two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? A rising curve can come from resampling, since more independent attempts solve more problems ( Brown et al., 2024 ) , or from one lucky run, a larger budget, or simulator state a real robot never sees. And does what it learns still help elsewhere? A held-out initial state of the practiced task is the smallest possible step away from practice. Experience that is worth keeping should also help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot. Prior systems each define their own protocol, so their results cannot answer either question or be compared with one another.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，成功率的上升并不能证明智能体已经学会了。我们提出两个问题。 智能体是真的在学习，还是仅仅尝试得更频繁？ 上升的曲线可能源于重新采样，因为更多独立的尝试能解决更多问题（Brown 等人，2024），也可能源于一次幸运的运行、更大的预算，或者仿真器中真实机器人从未见过的状态。 而且，它所学到的东西在其他地方是否仍然有用？ 一个被保留的练习任务的初始状态，是偏离练习所能达到的最小步骤。 值得保留的经验也应该能在新任务、新仿真器以及真实机器人上发挥作用。 以往的每个系统都定义了自己的协议，因此它们的结果既无法回答这两个问题，也无法相互比较。

sents.zh: 而且，它所学到的东西在其他地方是否仍然有用？

sents.zh: 一个被保留的练习任务的初始状态，是偏离练习所能达到的最小步骤。

sents.zh: 值得保留的经验也应该能在新任务、新仿真器以及真实机器人上发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SEAR ( S elf- E volving A gentic R obotics ), a framework and benchmark for answering both ( Section 2 ). The framework runs an LM agent through one harness in simulation and on hardware, in three modes: the agent writes a program that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), stays in the control loop and acts live (agent-as-policy), or fine-tunes a VLA on rollouts it collects (auto-research). In code-as-policy, the policy usually contains no learned action model: the LM writes ordinary Python that calls perception, inverse-kinematics, and servo tools. A pretrained VLA is also in the toolbox, but almost no final program uses it ( Section 5.2 ). Between tasks the agent keeps a library of code skills and written memories. Figure 2 shows the loop and a few physical tasks being learned this way. The benchmark pairs every comparison with a control. Three short restarts at the same total budget (best-of-3) and a run with no library separate learning from resampling. A sealed judge grades frozen policies on initial states the agent never sees. Repeated runs expose luck. Five generalization tiers measure how far a gain reaches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SEAR（自进化基因机器人学），一个用于回答两类问题的框架和基准（第 2 节）。 该框架通过一个模拟器和硬件运行 LM 智能体，采用三种模式：智能体编写程序作为策略（代码即策略）、留在控制循环中实时执行（智能体即策略），或在收集到的轨迹数据上微调 VLA（自动研究）。 在“代码即策略”模式下，策略通常不包含已学习的动作模型：LM 编写的普通 Python 代码会调用感知、逆运动学和伺服工具。 工具箱中也包含一个预训练的 VLA，但几乎没有最终程序使用它（第 5.2 节）。 在不同任务之间，智能体会保留一个代码技能库和已记录的记忆。 图 2 展示了这一循环以及通过这种方式学习的一些物理任务。 该基准将每次比较都与一个对照组进行配对。 在相同总预算下进行的三次短暂重启（三选最佳）以及一个没有技能库的运行，将学习与重采样区分开来。 一个密封的评判器会在智能体从未见过的初始状态上对已固化的策略进行评分。 重复运行会暴露运气因素的影响。 五个泛化层级用于衡量改进效果所能达到的范围。

paragraphs.en: The agents learn, but not always ( Section 3 ). The learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. An inherited library helps most where a model succeeds sometimes but not reliably on its own. It adds little when the model almost always fails or almost always succeeds without it. On RoboLab, GPT-5.6-sol scores 46.9% with no library, 42.4% with its own library, and 60.6% with another model’s library, so experience saved as code transfers across models. A library can also be harmful when brittle skills or outright mistakes are carried forward.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体能够学习，但并非总能成功（第 3 节）。 机器人智能体的学习曲线既取决于总的时间预算，也取决于任务难度相对于模型能力的程度。 更难的任务使得更长的训练过程更有价值；而在较易的任务中，重复尝试较短的训练过程同样有效。 在模型自身偶尔成功但无法稳定表现的情况下，继承的库能发挥最大帮助作用。 当模型几乎总是失败，或即使没有该库也几乎总能成功时，它带来的帮助微乎其微。 在 RoboLab 中，GPT-5.6-sol 不使用任何库时的得分为 46.9%，使用自身库时为 42.4%，而使用另一模型的库时则达到 60.6%，这表明以代码形式保存的经验可以在不同模型间迁移。 如果脆弱的技能或明显的错误被继承下来，库也可能产生负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Code and shared routines transfer; task-specific solutions do not ( Section 4 ). Grasp and control routines carry across tasks and simulators, and one program, written before the agent is told its tasks, succeeds on scenes it never explored when its routines work there. Code policies keep working under hardware faults that do not move the camera, and a trained VLA keeps working when the camera is moved. On a real robot, success in practice overstates success on new scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 代码和共享程序可以转移，但特定任务解决方案则不能（第 4 节）。 抓取和控制程序可以在不同任务和模拟器之间延续使用；一个在智能体被告知任务之前编写的程序，即使从未探索过某些场景，只要其程序在这些场景中有效，就能成功应对这些场景。 代码策略在不会导致摄像头移动的硬件故障下仍能持续运行，而经过训练的 VLA 在摄像头被移动时也能继续工作。 在实际机器人上的成功表现，夸大了其在新场景中的实际成功率。

sents.zh: 代码和共享程序可以转移，但特定任务解决方案则不能（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The LM matters, and so does how it likes to act ( Section 5 ). The strongest model leads every simulated family, and the gap between models widens as tasks get harder. A text-only model beats a multimodal model with the same general-capability score on the hardest family, RoboLab, with and without a library. On hardware, GPT-6-astra more than doubles its score when it acts live (from 41% to 88%), but acting live is slow: a live episode takes a median of 12.8 minutes of robot time, against 3.8 for a frozen code policy. Fable 5.1, placed in the live loop, writes and runs scripts for almost every command, and scores about the same either way.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型本身很重要，它偏好的行为方式也同样重要（第 5 节）。 性能最强的模型在所有模拟家庭中均表现领先，且随着任务难度增加，模型间的差距也在拉大。 在最具挑战性的家庭场景 RoboLab 中，纯文本模型无论是否使用代码库，其表现都优于具有相同通用能力分数的多模态模型。 在硬件方面，当 GPT-6-astra 进行实时操作时，其得分会翻倍以上（从 41% 提升至 88%），但实时操作速度较慢：一个实时流程平均需要 12.8 分钟的机器人运行时间，而冻结代码策略仅需 3.8 分钟。 Fable 5.1 被置于实时循环中后，几乎会为每条指令编写并运行脚本，但其得分无论采用哪种方式都基本相同。

sents.zh: 语言模型本身很重要，它偏好的行为方式也同样重要（第 5 节）。

sents.zh: 在硬件方面，当 GPT-6-astra 进行实时操作时，其得分会翻倍以上（从 41% 提升至 88%），但实时操作速度较慢：一个实时流程平均需要 12.8 分钟的机器人运行时间，而冻结代码策略仅需 3.8 分钟。

paragraphs.en: An empirical study of seven frontier LMs improving robots from their own experience, across three modes (code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research), 330 simulated tasks in two physics engines, and five physical tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 一项关于七款前沿大型语言模型（LM）如何基于自身经验改进机器人的实证研究，涵盖三种模式（代码即策略、智能体即策略和自动研究）、两种物理引擎中的 330 项模拟任务以及五项物理任务。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark whose matched controls separate what an agent retains from what it gets by trying more often, seeing familiar tasks, reading privileged information, spending a larger budget, or being lucky, with a sealed judge that grades programs and trained checkpoints the same way. It extends to other MuJoCo- and Isaac-based tasks that expose a primitive API and a success predicate.
paragraphs.zh: 一项基准测试，其匹配的控制变量能够区分智能体所保留的内容与它通过更频繁尝试、看到熟悉任务、阅读特权信息、花费更多预算或运气好而获得的内容；该测试采用密封的评判机制，以相同方式对程序和训练好的检查点进行评分。 这项基准还可扩展至其他基于 MuJoCo 和 Isaac 的任务，这些任务暴露了基础 API 和成功判定条件。

sents.en: A benchmark whose matched controls separate what an agent retains from what it gets by trying more often, seeing familiar tasks, reading privileged information, spending a larger budget, or being lucky, with a sealed judge that grades programs and trained checkpoints the same way.
sents.zh: 一项基准测试，其匹配的控制变量能够区分智能体所保留的内容与它通过更频繁尝试、看到熟悉任务、阅读特权信息、花费更多预算或运气好而获得的内容；该测试采用密封的评判机制，以相同方式对程序和训练好的检查点进行评分。

sents.en: It extends to other MuJoCo- and Isaac-based tasks that expose a primitive API and a success predicate.
sents.zh: 这项基准还可扩展至其他基于 MuJoCo 和 Isaac 的任务，这些任务暴露了基础 API 和成功判定条件。

paragraphs.en: An agentic framework and harness that runs code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research agents against the same environments, tools, and libraries in simulation and on physical robots (code: https://github.com/Self-Evolving-Agentic-Robotics/SEAR ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种智能体框架与工具，可在模拟环境和实体机器人中运行“代码即策略”、“智能体即策略”和自动研究类智能体，且使用相同的环境、工具和库（代码：https://github.com/Self-Evolving-Agentic-Robotics/SEAR）。

paragraphs.en: SEAR organizes LM-driven robot learning ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) by what the agent produces and what runs on the robot ( Figure 2 ):
paragraphs.zh: SEAR 通过智能体所生成的内容以及在机器人上运行的内容，对由语言模型驱动的机器人学习（Fu et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a；Xiao et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026）进行了组织（图 2）：

paragraphs.en: Code-as-policy (CaP). The agent writes a program, and the program is the policy. No LM runs at execution time, so the policy is fast, and it can be replayed and re-graded without the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 代码即策略（CaP）。 智能体编写一个程序，而该程序就是策略。 执行时不需要运行语言模型，因此策略运行迅速，并且无需智能体即可重复执行和重新评分。

sents.en: Code-as-policy (CaP).
sents.zh: 代码即策略（CaP）。

sents.en: The agent writes a program, and the program is the policy.
sents.zh: 智能体编写一个程序，而该程序就是策略。

sents.en: No LM runs at execution time, so the policy is fast, and it can be replayed and re-graded without the agent.
sents.zh: 执行时不需要运行语言模型，因此策略运行迅速，并且无需智能体即可重复执行和重新评分。

paragraphs.en: Agent-as-policy (AaP). The LM stays in the control loop and chooses each command from live observations. Every command waits on a model call, so episodes are slower and evaluation costs grow with each rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体即策略（AaP）。 语言模型保留在控制回路中，并根据实时观察选择每个命令。 每个命令都需要等待模型调用，因此回合过程更慢，且每次展开都会增加评估成本。

sents.en: Agent-as-policy (AaP).
sents.zh: 智能体即策略（AaP）。

sents.en: The LM stays in the control loop and chooses each command from live observations.
sents.zh: 语言模型保留在控制回路中，并根据实时观察选择每个命令。

sents.en: Every command waits on a model call, so episodes are slower and evaluation costs grow with each rollout.
sents.zh: 每个命令都需要等待模型调用，因此回合过程更慢，且每次展开都会增加评估成本。

paragraphs.en: Auto-research (AR). The agent runs training experiments on another model ( Rank et al., 2026 ) : it collects rollouts from code policies it treats as teachers, curates them, fine-tunes the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025 ) , evaluates it, and decides what to try next.
paragraphs.zh: 自动研究（AR）。 该智能体在另一个模型上运行训练实验（Rank 等人，2026）：它从被其视为“教师”的代码策略中收集 rollout，对其进行整理和筛选，对 VLA π₀.₅（Black 等人，2025）进行微调、评估，并决定下一步尝试什么。

sents.en: Auto-research (AR).
sents.zh: 自动研究（AR）。

sents.en: The agent runs training experiments on another model ( Rank et al., 2026 ) : it collects rollouts from code policies it treats as teachers, curates them, fine-tunes the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025 ) , evaluates it, and decides what to try next.
sents.zh: 该智能体在另一个模型上运行训练实验（Rank 等人，2026）：它从被其视为“教师”的代码策略中收集 rollout，对其进行整理和筛选，对 VLA π₀.₅（Black 等人，2025）进行微调、评估，并决定下一步尝试什么。

paragraphs.en: Every agent starts from the same toolbox: SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) for segmentation, a pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces. Each task starts in a fresh workspace. What persists from task to task is the library : versioned code skills and written memories harvested from the best policy of each finished task. AR checkpoints and data never carry over to the next task. Only skills and memories do. Simulation experiments use CaP and AR, because a judge can cheaply re-grade their frozen outputs. The hardware experiments also use AaP. Table 1 places existing systems in this space.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都从相同的工具箱开始：用于分割的 SAM3（Carion 等人，2026）、一个预训练的 π₀.₅、以及逆运动学和伺服接口。 每个任务都在一个新的工作空间中开始。 在任务之间持续存在的是这个库：版本化的代码技能以及从每个已完成任务的最佳策略中收集到的书面记忆。 AR 检查点和数据绝不会带到下一个任务中。 只有技能和记忆会被保留。 模拟实验使用 CaP 和 AR，因为裁判可以低成本地重新评估它们已冻结的输出结果。 硬件实验也使用 AaP。 表 1 将现有系统置于这一框架中。

sents.en: Every agent starts from the same toolbox: SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) for segmentation, a pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces.
sents.zh: 每个智能体都从相同的工具箱开始：用于分割的 SAM3（Carion 等人，2026）、一个预训练的 π₀.₅、以及逆运动学和伺服接口。

sents.en: Each task starts in a fresh workspace.
sents.zh: 每个任务都在一个新的工作空间中开始。

sents.en: What persists from task to task is the library : versioned code skills and written memories harvested from the best policy of each finished task.
sents.zh: 在任务之间持续存在的是这个库：版本化的代码技能以及从每个已完成任务的最佳策略中收集到的书面记忆。

sents.en: AR checkpoints and data never carry over to the next task.
sents.zh: AR 检查点和数据绝不会带到下一个任务中。

sents.en: Only skills and memories do.
sents.zh: 只有技能和记忆会被保留。

sents.en: Simulation experiments use CaP and AR, because a judge can cheaply re-grade their frozen outputs.
sents.zh: 模拟实验使用 CaP 和 AR，因为裁判可以低成本地重新评估它们已冻结的输出结果。

sents.en: The hardware experiments also use AaP.
sents.zh: 硬件实验也使用 AaP。

sents.en: Table 1 places existing systems in this space.
sents.zh: 表 1 将现有系统置于这一框架中。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating a fixed policy is easy: roll it out on held-out states and count the successes. Evaluating a system that changes itself is harder, because its success rate can rise for five reasons that have nothing to do with retained experience. SEAR pairs each with one control ( Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估固定策略很简单：在预留的状态上执行该策略，并统计成功次数。 评估能够自我改变的系统则更为困难，因为其成功率可能因五个与保留经验无关的原因而上升。 SEAR 与每个对照组进行配对（表 2）。

sents.en: Evaluating a fixed policy is easy: roll it out on held-out states and count the successes.
sents.zh: 评估固定策略很简单：在预留的状态上执行该策略，并统计成功次数。

sents.en: Evaluating a system that changes itself is harder, because its success rate can rise for five reasons that have nothing to do with retained experience.
sents.zh: 评估能够自我改变的系统则更为困难，因为其成功率可能因五个与保留经验无关的原因而上升。

sents.en: SEAR pairs each with one control ( Table 2 ).
sents.zh: SEAR 与每个对照组进行配对（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: Five simulated families, from easiest to hardest ( Figure 3 ):
paragraphs.zh: 五个模拟家庭，从最简单到最困难（图 3）：

paragraphs.en: robosuite ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) , in MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) : 7 tasks, from lifting a cube to a two-arm handover.
paragraphs.zh: robosuite（Zhu 等人，2020），在 MuJoCo（Todorov 等人，2012）中：7 项任务，从举起立方体到双臂交接。

paragraphs.en: LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , in MuJoCo: 40 language-conditioned household tasks.
paragraphs.zh: LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023），在 MuJoCo 中：40 项语言条件化的家庭任务。

paragraphs.en: LIBERO-PRO ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) : 160 tasks made by changing the wording, objects, layout, or goal of the 40 LIBERO tasks. The changes also move tasks away from instances a model may have seen in pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: LIBERO-PRO（Zhou 等人，2025）：通过改变 40 个 LIBERO 任务的措辞、对象、布局或目标而生成出的 160 个任务。 这些改动也使任务偏离了模型在预训练中可能见过的实例。

sents.en: LIBERO-PRO ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) : 160 tasks made by changing the wording, objects, layout, or goal of the 40 LIBERO tasks.
sents.zh: LIBERO-PRO（Zhou 等人，2025）：通过改变 40 个 LIBERO 任务的措辞、对象、布局或目标而生成出的 160 个任务。

sents.en: The changes also move tasks away from instances a model may have seen in pretraining.
sents.zh: 这些改动也使任务偏离了模型在预训练中可能见过的实例。

paragraphs.en: LIBERO-RIG ( Cui et al., 2026 ) : 18 LIBERO tasks, each with one hidden hardware fault, such as a moved camera, a miscalibrated arm, an actuation error, or worn gripper pads. The 18 tasks cover ten kinds of fault ( Appendix N ).
paragraphs.zh: LIBERO-RIG（Cui 等人，2026）：包含 18 个 LIBERO 任务，每个任务都存在一个隐藏的硬件故障，例如摄像头移位、机械臂校准错误、执行器误差或抓取器垫磨损。 这 18 个任务涵盖了十种故障类型（附录 N）。

sents.en: LIBERO-RIG ( Cui et al., 2026 ) : 18 LIBERO tasks, each with one hidden hardware fault, such as a moved camera, a miscalibrated arm, an actuation error, or worn gripper pads.
sents.zh: LIBERO-RIG（Cui 等人，2026）：包含 18 个 LIBERO 任务，每个任务都存在一个隐藏的硬件故障，例如摄像头移位、机械臂校准错误、执行器误差或抓取器垫磨损。

sents.en: The 18 tasks cover ten kinds of fault ( Appendix N ).
sents.zh: 这 18 个任务涵盖了十种故障类型（附录 N）。

paragraphs.en: RoboLab ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , in Isaac Sim ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) : 105 cluttered, randomized tasks on a different physics engine and action API.
paragraphs.zh: RoboLab（Yang 等人，2026a），在 Isaac Sim（NVIDIA，2025）中：使用不同的物理引擎和行动 API 完成 105 项杂乱且随机化的任务。

paragraphs.en: A run with a library walks the families in this order: robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, then either LIBERO-RIG or RoboLab. The five families hold 330 tasks in all. The physical platform has two YAM-Ultra arms with parallel-jaw grippers, a fixed overview camera, and two wrist cameras. Its five tasks test placement, pushing, reorientation, stacking, and language-conditioned arrangement ( Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个包含多个库的运行时，按以下顺序运行各个家族：robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO，然后运行 LIBERO-RIG 或 RoboLab。 这五个家族总共包含 330 个任务。 该物理平台配备两个带有平行夹爪的 YAM-Ultra 机械臂、一个固定全景摄像头和两个腕部摄像头。 其五个任务分别测试放置、推动、重新定向、堆叠和语言条件化排列（附录 J）。

sents.en: A run with a library walks the families in this order: robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, then either LIBERO-RIG or RoboLab.
sents.zh: 一个包含多个库的运行时，按以下顺序运行各个家族：robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO，然后运行 LIBERO-RIG 或 RoboLab。

sents.en: The five families hold 330 tasks in all.
sents.zh: 这五个家族总共包含 330 个任务。

sents.en: The physical platform has two YAM-Ultra arms with parallel-jaw grippers, a fixed overview camera, and two wrist cameras.
sents.zh: 该物理平台配备两个带有平行夹爪的 YAM-Ultra 机械臂、一个固定全景摄像头和两个腕部摄像头。

sents.en: Its five tasks test placement, pushing, reorientation, stacking, and language-conditioned arrangement ( Appendix J ).
sents.zh: 其五个任务分别测试放置、推动、重新定向、堆叠和语言条件化排列（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: Sealed judge. The agent works in its own container, where it can run local simulations, inspect failures, install packages, and train checkpoints. When the budget ends or the agent submits, its policy is frozen, and only the frozen program with its imported skills, or the AR checkpoint, is passed to a separate judge. The judge holds the held-out initial states and the grading logic, and ignores any success the policy claims. Each randomized task splits its initial states into DEV seeds the agent uses freely, VAL seeds the judge grades and reports back during development, and TEST seeds graded once at the end. Every reported simulation score is the TEST success rate over ten rollouts per task, and learning curves use VAL scores. Agents still found ways around the seal, such as reading object geometry from asset files; Section A.9 lists them.
paragraphs.zh: 密封裁判。 智能体在其自身的容器中运行，可以在其中执行本地模拟、检查故障、安装软件包和训练检查点。 预算结束或智能体提交后，其策略将被冻结，只有包含已导入技能的冻结程序或 AR 检查点会被传递给一个独立的裁判。 裁判持有预留的初始状态和评分逻辑，并且会忽略策略声称的任何成功。 每个随机化任务都会将其初始状态分为 DEV 种子（智能体可自由使用）、VAL 种子（裁判在开发期间用于评分并反馈）以及 TEST 种子（最终一次性评分）。 每份报告的模拟分数都是每个任务十次运行中的 TEST 成功率，而学习曲线则使用 VAL 分数。 智能体仍然找到了绕过密封的方法，例如从资源文件中读取对象几何信息；A.9 节列出了这些方法。

sents.en: Sealed judge.
sents.zh: 密封裁判。

sents.en: The agent works in its own container, where it can run local simulations, inspect failures, install packages, and train checkpoints.
sents.zh: 智能体在其自身的容器中运行，可以在其中执行本地模拟、检查故障、安装软件包和训练检查点。

sents.en: When the budget ends or the agent submits, its policy is frozen, and only the frozen program with its imported skills, or the AR checkpoint, is passed to a separate judge.
sents.zh: 预算结束或智能体提交后，其策略将被冻结，只有包含已导入技能的冻结程序或 AR 检查点会被传递给一个独立的裁判。

sents.en: The judge holds the held-out initial states and the grading logic, and ignores any success the policy claims.
sents.zh: 裁判持有预留的初始状态和评分逻辑，并且会忽略策略声称的任何成功。

sents.en: Each randomized task splits its initial states into DEV seeds the agent uses freely, VAL seeds the judge grades and reports back during development, and TEST seeds graded once at the end.
sents.zh: 每个随机化任务都会将其初始状态分为 DEV 种子（智能体可自由使用）、VAL 种子（裁判在开发期间用于评分并反馈）以及 TEST 种子（最终一次性评分）。

sents.en: Every reported simulation score is the TEST success rate over ten rollouts per task, and learning curves use VAL scores.
sents.zh: 每份报告的模拟分数都是每个任务十次运行中的 TEST 成功率，而学习曲线则使用 VAL 分数。

sents.en: Agents still found ways around the seal, such as reading object geometry from asset files; Section A.9 lists them.
sents.zh: 智能体仍然找到了绕过密封的方法，例如从资源文件中读取对象几何信息；A.9 节列出了这些方法。

paragraphs.en: Conditions. Vanilla starts every task with an empty library. Lineage is the same setup, but the agent inherits and extends its library task after task. Best-of-3 splits a Vanilla session’s budget into three fresh attempts and keeps the one with the best VAL score. A code-as-policy session gets one hour per task (two on RoboLab). AR gets the same total development time for each suite, a group of tasks within a family. Each condition runs three times per model, except AR on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab (one run). Self-exploration withholds the instruction and the judge: the agent practices on the scenes with its inherited library, proposes its own tasks, and only then sees the instruction and writes one final policy.
paragraphs.zh: 条件。 Vanilla 在每次任务开始时都使用一个空的库。 Lineage 的设置相同，但智能体会在每个任务中继承并扩展其库。 Best-of-3 将 Vanilla 会话的预算分成三次新的尝试，并保留 VAL 分数最高的那次结果。 代码即策略的会话每次任务获得一小时（RoboLab 上为两小时）。 AR 为每个套件（同一系列中的任务组）分配相同的总开发时间。 除 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上的 AR（各运行一次）外，每种条件对每个模型运行三次。 自我探索会隐藏指令和评判者：智能体使用其继承的库在场景中进行练习，提出自己的任务，然后才看到指令并编写最终策略。

paragraphs.en: Generalization tiers. T1 new initial states of the practiced task; T2 the same tasks under changed conditions (LIBERO-PRO scenes, LIBERO-RIG hardware faults), run with frozen policies and no further practice; T3 new tasks in the same simulator, after self-exploration; T4 a new simulator and action API (MuJoCo to RoboLab’s Isaac Sim), after self-exploration; T5 the physical robot.
paragraphs.zh: 泛化层级。 T1：已练习任务的新初始状态；T2：在变化条件下执行相同任务（LIBERO-PRO 场景、LIBERO-RIG 硬件故障），使用冻结策略运行且不再进行练习；T3：在同一模拟器中，经过自我探索后执行新任务；T4：经过自我探索后，使用新的模拟器和动作 API（从 MuJoCo 切换到 RoboLab 的 Isaac Sim）；T5：物理机器人。

paragraphs.en: Physical protocol. On hardware nothing resets itself, so each task comes with a reset task the agent must also learn (take the banana out of the bowl, scramble the letters). An external evaluator judges before-and-after images, and practice stops after ten consecutive successes (Block Stacking has no early stop) or at a 12-hour budget per task. The frozen policy is then run once on each of ten scenes staged by an operator (five scenes for AaP, whose episodes are slower). The operator confirms the evaluator’s verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 物理协议。 在硬件上，没有任何东西会自动重置，因此每个任务都附带一个重置任务，智能体也必须学会执行（将香蕉从碗中取出、打乱字母顺序）。 外部评估器会判断前后图像，并在连续成功十次后停止练习（积木堆叠没有提前终止机制），或在每个任务达到12小时预算时停止。 随后，冻结策略会在操作员布置的十个场景中各运行一次（AaP使用五个场景，其回合更慢）。 操作员会确认评估器的判断结果。

paragraphs.en: Agents. Simulation uses five LMs, each through a coding tool: Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code), GPT-5.6-sol (Codex), and Gemini-3.6-flash, Kimi-k3, and DeepSeek-v4-flash (all through OpenCode). A comparison of models is therefore a comparison of model-and-tool pairs. DeepSeek-v4-flash is text-only: it receives the same images and RGB-D tools as the other models but cannot view the images itself. Hardware uses Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and GPT-6-astra, for seven LMs across simulation and hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体。 模拟使用了五个大型语言模型（LM），每个模型都通过一个编码工具：Claude Opus 5（Claude Code）、GPT-5.6-sol（Codex）、Gemini-3.6-flash、Kimi-k3 和 DeepSeek-v4-flash（全部通过 OpenCode）。 因此，对模型的比较实际上是对模型与工具组合的比较。 DeepSeek-v4-flash 仅支持文本输入：它能接收到与其他模型相同的图像和 RGB-D 工具，但自身无法查看这些图像。 硬件部分使用了 Claude Fable 5.1、Opus 5 和 GPT-6-astra，模拟与硬件部分共涉及七个大型语言模型。

paragraphs.en: The results below depend on which language model drives the agent. The library helps most for models that do moderately well without it: a weak model writes little worth saving, and a strong model has little left to gain ( Section 5.1 ). We first separate learning from trying more often, then ask what the library adds.

paragraphs.en: Best-of-3 is the fair version of trying more often: three fresh attempts at a third of the budget, keeping the one with the best validation score. On robosuite, the easiest family, one hour beats three 20-minute attempts for Opus (93.8 against 90.0% TEST; Table 16 ) and, on validation, for every model but Gemini-3.6-flash, which is level ( Table 15 ). On RoboLab, the hardest, the sign of the session term depends on the model, and it follows one quantity ( Table 5 ): when the model first succeeds. GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.6-flash reach their first validation success at a median of 21 and 36 minutes, inside a 40-minute attempt, so each of the three attempts gets past the first success, and best-of-3 beats one two-hour session by 1.6 and 2.8 points. Opus and DeepSeek-v4-flash 1 1 1 DeepSeek-v4-flash’s RoboLab runs with a library cover only the first 58 tasks: they stopped when the API provider retired the model. On LIBERO-RIG, DeepSeek is DeepSeek-v4.1-flash. need about an hour, and Kimi-k3 nearly an hour and a half. A 40-minute attempt ends before their first success, and splitting costs them 5 to 24 points. Part of that cost is that short attempts often end without submitting a policy: Kimi-k3 submits a policy in 10% of its 40-minute attempts against 68% of its two-hour runs. Under LIBERO-RIG’s hidden faults the session term is the largest in the study, 66 points for Opus, whose first success comes at a median of 28 minutes, after a 20-minute attempt has ended. Task difficulty alone therefore does not decide which setup is better. What decides it is the model’s time to first success compared with the length of one short attempt. The same holds averaged over all five families ( Figure 5 ): only GPT-5.6-sol reaches its first success inside a short attempt, and it gains 2.9 points from the long session, against 14.5 to 31.9 for the other four models.
paragraphs.zh: “三选最佳”是更频繁尝试的公平版本：用三分之一的预算进行三次全新尝试，并保留验证得分最高的结果。 在 robosuite 这个最简单的任务系列中，一个小时的尝试比三个各 20 分钟的尝试对 Opus 的表现更好（93.8% 对比 90.0% 的测试得分；见表 16），而在验证集上，除 Gemini-3.6-flash 外所有模型都表现更优，而 Gemini-3.6-flash 则处于同一水平（见表 15）。 在 RoboLab 这个最难的系列中，单次会话的得分趋势因模型而异，但都遵循一个指标（见表 5）：模型首次成功的时间。 GPT-5.6-sol 和 Gemini-3.6-flash 在 40 分钟尝试内分别以中位数 21 分钟和 36 分钟达成首次验证成功，因此三次尝试都能超越首次成功的时间点，“三选最佳”方案比单次两小时会话分别高出 1.6 分和 2.8 分。 Opus 和 DeepSeek-v4-flash 1 1 1 DeepSeek-v4-flash 在 RoboLab 上的运行仅包含前 58 个任务：当 API 提供商停用该模型时，他们的运行也停止了。 在 LIBERO-RIG 上，DeepSeek 使用的是 DeepSeek-v4.1-flash，需要大约一小时，而 Kimi-k3 则需要近一个半小时。 40 分钟的尝试会在它们首次成功之前结束，而这种分段方式使它们损失了 5 到 24 分。 部分损失源于短时尝试常常在未提交策略的情况下结束：在 Kimi-k3 的 40 分钟尝试中，仅 10% 提交了策略，而在两小时运行中则有 68% 提交了策略。 在 LIBERO-RIG 的隐藏故障设置下，单次会话的得分是研究中最高的，Opus 得分为 66 分，其首次成功的中位时间为 28 分钟，此时一个 20 分钟的尝试已经结束。 因此，仅凭任务难度无法决定哪种方案更优。 真正决定因素是模型首次成功所需的时间与单次短时尝试时长之间的对比。 在所有五个任务系列中取平均后（见图 5），结论同样成立：只有 GPT-5.6-sol 能在短时尝试内达成首次成功，且相比长时会话仅获得 2.9 分的提升，而其他四个模型分别获得了 14.5 到 31.9 分的提升。

paragraphs.en: The library helps most in the middle. How much the library adds depends less on which model inherits it than on how well that model does on a family without one ( Figure 6 ; Figure 4 gives each model’s curves). Over the 25 model–family pairs of Table 6 , it adds 0.9 points on average where the model already scores above 80% without it (Opus and GPT-5.6-sol on every family but RoboLab), 12.0 points between 30 and 80%, and 3.0 below 30% (Gemini-3.6-flash and DeepSeek-v4-flash on RoboLab). Above 80%, there is little left to gain. Below 30%, the model rarely reuses what it saved: DeepSeek-v4-flash imports library code in 20% of its RoboLab policies, Gemini-3.6-flash calls most of its skills once, and Inkling-small, a sixth simulation model that we withdrew from the comparison, held 0 to 6 skills after 47 tasks ( Appendix O ). Between 30 and 80%, the gains are large: the library lifts Gemini-3.6-flash by 46.6 points under LIBERO-RIG’s faults, and Kimi-k3 from 30.1 to 51.9% on RoboLab, above GPT-5.6-sol with or without a library. paragraphs.en: What the library holds matters. Figure 7 shows a useful inherited skill: one skill, written on an earlier task, turns a failed grasp into a reliable one. Kimi-k3’s library fills with such routines (gripper control from measured opening, yaw alignment, pinch grasps), and its gain grows as they accumulate. GPT-5.6-sol’s library holds mostly object-location recipes and few grasp checks. In inspected failures, it reuses thresholds and offsets from earlier tasks and keeps tuning them after they fail on a new scene. To separate the library’s content from the model, we give GPT-5.6-sol libraries written by other models. On RoboLab, GPT-5.6-sol scores 46.9% without a library and 42.4% with its own, but 60.6% with the library Opus wrote and 55.7% with Kimi-k3’s (three runs over all 105 tasks for each donor library). The model is the same, and only the inherited library differs. Experience saved as code and notes can transfer between models.
paragraphs.zh: 图书馆包含的内容至关重要。 图 7 展示了一项有用的继承技能：一项在早期任务中写入的技能，能将一次失败的抓取转化为可靠的抓取。 Kimi-k3 的图书馆充满了这类程序（基于测量开度的夹爪控制、偏航对齐、捏合抓取），随着这些程序的积累，其增益也会增长。 GPT-5.6-sol 的图书馆主要包含物体定位方案，而抓取检查则很少。 在受检的失败案例中，它会重复使用早期任务中的阈值和偏移量，并在这些参数于新场景失效后继续调整它们。 为了将图书馆的内容与模型区分开来，我们向 GPT-5.6-sol 提供由其他模型编写的图书馆。 在 RoboLab 上，GPT-5.6-sol 在没有图书馆时的得分为 46.9%，使用自身图书馆时得分为 42.4%，但使用 Opus 编写的图书馆时得分为 60.6%，使用 Kimi-k3 的图书馆时得分为 55.7%（每种捐赠图书馆均在所有 105 个任务上运行三次）。 模型是相同的，只有继承的图书馆不同。 以代码和笔记形式保存的经验可以在不同模型之间转移。

paragraphs.en: Nothing in the loop requires a saved lesson to be checked again, so errors persist like skills do. In self-exploration, where the agent has no judge and must build its own success detector, one Opus run built a placement verifier in its first session, calibrated on sixteen episodes whose three failures happened not to move at all. The verifier declared success on 699 later rollouts and was wrong on 91% of them. Because its verdict was also the stopping rule, 637 rollouts ended without another grasp attempt. The run saved the verdict in memory as a fact, and every later session inherited it. The run scored 4.6% overall. Its two sibling runs, identical in setup but without that verifier, scored 15.5 and 23.6%, three to five times higher. Runs with the same setup often end far apart: two DeepSeek-v4-flash Lineage runs differed by 20.9 points with two tasks flipping between 0 and 100, and on LIBERO the library moves Opus and GPT-5.6-sol by less than a run’s standard deviation (94.4 against 95.2% and 88.3 against 87.1%). A single run cannot be told apart from luck, so SEAR reports the spread over three runs.
paragraphs.zh: 循环中没有任何内容需要重新检查已保存的教训，因此错误会像技能一样持续存在。 在自我探索中，智能体没有评判者，必须自行构建成功检测器；在一次 Opus 运行中，它首次会话就构建了一个位置验证器，该验证器基于十六个回合进行校准，而这三个失败的情况恰好是完全没有移动。 该验证器在后续 699 次展开中判定为成功，但其中 91% 的判定是错误的。 由于它的判定结果同时也是停止规则，因此有 637 次展开在未尝试再次抓取的情况下结束。 该运行将判定结果作为事实保存在内存中，并且之后每次会话都继承了这一结果。 该运行的总得分为 4.6%。 它的两个姊妹运行在设置上完全相同，但没有那个验证器，得分分别为 15.5% 和 23.6%，是前者的三到五倍。 采用相同设置的运行结果往往差异巨大：两次 DeepSeek-v4-flash Lineage 运行的得分相差 20.9 个百分点，其中两个任务在 0 和 100 之间波动；而在 LIBERO 上，库的移动使得 Opus 和 GPT-5.6-sol 的差异不到一次运行的标准差（94.4 对比 95.2%，以及 88.3 对比 87.1%）。 单次运行无法与运气区分开来，因此 SEAR 报告了三次运行之间的差异范围。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 follows Opus’s policies away from where they were practiced. Both policy forms lose ground at every simulation tier. The steps are uneven: the same code policy, practiced on LIBERO, scores 94.4% on LIBERO’s TEST states, 66.0% under LIBERO-RIG’s hardware faults, and 47.7% under LIBERO-PRO’s scene changes. A scene change costs more than a hardware fault, because a code policy re-detects the object before each move and so corrects a fault as it goes, as long as the camera stays where it was ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 展示了 Opus 的策略偏离其原有实践方式的情况。 两种策略形式在每一层模拟中都出现了性能下降。 各步骤表现不一：相同的代码策略在 LIBERO 上运行时，在 LIBERO 的测试状态中得分 94.4%，在 LIBERO-RIG 的硬件故障场景下得分为 66.0%，而在 LIBERO-PRO 的场景变化场景下则仅为 47.7%。 场景变化的代价高于硬件故障，因为代码策略在每次移动前都会重新检测物体，从而在过程中纠正故障，只要摄像头保持原位置不变（第 4.3 节）。

sents.zh: 表 3 展示了 Opus 的策略偏离其原有实践方式的情况。

paragraphs.en: The libraries are reused across tasks and simulators. On the first half of RoboLab, Opus’s three lineages imported 202 distinct skills 660 times, and skills written on the MuJoCo families were imported by about half of its RoboLab policies (two fifths for Kimi-k3, almost none for the other three models). The skills reused across simulators are control code, such as servo wrappers and grasp routines, not task solutions. One rim-pinch skill, written on LIBERO because a bowl was wider than the gripper, was imported by 66 later policies; RoboLab’s four spatial-relation tasks were solved 10 of 10 on first contact, in all three lineages, by libraries that already held LIBERO’s spatial skills and a memory that relation words name regions of the table ( Appendix P ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些库在不同任务和模拟器之间被重复使用。 在 RoboLab 的前半阶段，Opus 的三个谱系共 660 次导入了 202 个不同的技能；而为 MuJoCo 系列编写的技能则被其约一半的 RoboLab 策略所导入（Kimi-k3 占五分之二，其他三个模型则几乎未导入）。 跨模拟器重复使用的技能是控制代码，例如伺服驱动封装程序和抓取流程，而非任务解决方案。 有一个在 LIBERO 上编写的边缘夹持技能——由于某个碗比夹具更宽而编写——被后续 66 个策略所导入；RoboLab 的四个空间关系任务在所有三个谱系中均于首次接触时成功完成（10/10），这得益于已包含 LIBERO 空间技能以及能够用关系词命名桌面区域的记忆库（附录 P）。

sents.zh: 有一个在 LIBERO 上编写的边缘夹持技能——由于某个碗比夹具更宽而编写——被后续 66 个策略所导入；RoboLab 的四个空间关系任务在所有三个谱系中均于首次接触时成功完成（10/10），这得益于已包含 LIBERO 空间技能以及能够用关系词命名桌面区域的记忆库（附录 P）。

paragraphs.en: A program written without knowing the task works on new scenes when the routines it needs already work. In self-exploration, the agent gets neither task instructions nor a judge. It proposes its own practice and learns to map instructions onto common goals and reusable routines ( Figure 8 ). We froze one Opus lineage’s task-general program at four points along its RoboLab sequence and graded each, unchanged, on one task per scene ( Figure 16 ). Success on the same 44 tasks rises from 15.5 to 31.6%, and on twelve scenes the lineage never explored, from 5.8 to 22.5%. The gain follows the routines: at the last checkpoint, never-explored tasks that need only routines that already work somewhere average 52%, and those that need a routine never shown to work, such as removing an object from a container, average 1%. Improvement concentrates in grasping: grasp failures fall from 58 to 29% of graded episodes. When the instruction is finally disclosed, one rewrite adds a consistent margin over the frozen program: it is better in all 21 lineages of each of Opus, GPT-5.6-sol, and Kimi-k3 (median gains 7.8, 10.4, and 7.1 points; Table 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果所需程序已经能够运行，那么无需了解具体任务即可编写的程序也能在新场景中发挥作用。 在自我探索过程中，智能体既没有任务说明，也没有评判者。 它会提出自己的练习方法，并学会将指令映射到通用目标和可重复使用的程序（图 8）。 我们在 Opus 谱系中一个任务通用程序的 RoboLab 序列的四个节点上将其冻结，并对每个节点在每场景的一项任务上进行评分且不作修改（图 16）。 在相同的 44 项任务上的成功率从 15.5% 提升至 31.6%，而在谱系从未探索过的十二个场景中，该率从 5.8% 提升至 22.5%。 这种提升源于程序：在最后一个检查点中，从未被探索的任务中，那些仅需已在某处成功运行的程序的任务平均成功率为 52%，而那些需要从未被证明可行的程序（例如从容器中移除物体）的任务平均成功率为 1%。 改进主要集中在抓取方面：在评分回合中，抓取失败的比例从 58% 降至 29%。 当指令最终被揭示时，一次重写使该程序相较于冻结版本获得了稳定的优势：在 Opus、GPT-5.6-sol 和 Kimi-k3 各自的 21 个谱系中，其表现均更优（中位数提升分别为 7.8、10.4 和 7.1 分；表 14）。

paragraphs.en: In auto-research, an Opus agent trains one π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} checkpoint per suite of tasks from the rollouts of per-task code teachers, within the same development time a code agent gets. The agent decides what data to collect, how to train, and whether to fix a teacher.

paragraphs.en: Weights match code where demonstrations are plentiful. On LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO the VLA scores within two points of code (94.0 vs. 94.4 and 90.6 vs. 91.8%) and matches or beats it on about four tasks in five. It falls well short on robosuite (61.0 vs. 97.1) and RoboLab (47.2 vs. 68.0; Table 8 ). The limit is the number of demonstrations: RoboLab’s slow simulator yields about one seventh as many teacher episodes per agent-hour as LIBERO. RoboLab tasks with fewer than 50 successful demonstrations score 20.8% against 94.0% with 300 or more ( Table 25 ). The learning curves show the same split over session time ( Figure 10 ). The student rarely exceeds its teacher ( Figure 9 a): of the 11 tasks whose teacher solves no TEST state, the VLA succeeds on at least one TEST state in 2 of them.
paragraphs.zh: 在演示示例丰富的任务中，性能与代码一致。 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 上，VLA 的得分与代码得分相差两个百分点以内（94.0 对比 94.4，以及 90.6 对比 91.8%），并在大约五分之四的任务中达到或超越了代码水平。 在 robosuite（61.0 对比 97.1）和 RoboLab（47.2 对比 68.0；表 8）上，其表现明显落后。 限制因素是演示示例的数量：RoboLab 的慢速模拟器每智能体-小时产生的教师示例数量约为 LIBERO 的七分之一。 成功演示少于 50 次的 RoboLab 任务得分仅为 20.8%，而成功演示达到 300 次或以上的任务得分为 94.0%（表 25）。 学习曲线显示，随会话时间推移，得分分布呈现出相同的分化趋势（图 10）。 学生智能体很少超越其教师智能体（图 9a）：在 11 个教师智能体无法解决任何 TEST 状态的任务中，VLA 有 2 个任务至少成功解决了 1 个 TEST 状态。

paragraphs.en: Weights survive a moved camera; code does not. A code policy turns pixels into world coordinates through an assumed camera pose. When the scene camera moves, nothing in the program checks that pose, and the LM that wrote the program is not running at test time to notice. Code falls to 9%, while the VLA keeps 69% ( Figure 9 b). Under the seven faults that leave the scene camera in place, the code policy re-detects the object before each move and holds 90%. The VLA also handles new instructions better: trained on its own self-exploration data, where 95% of episodes carry a distinct instruction, it reaches 42.6 and 43.6% on held-out LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO tasks, level with or above the code policy written after the task instruction is disclosed (41.7 and 24.9%).
paragraphs.zh: 权重能在相机移动后继续有效，但代码则不然。 一种代码策略通过预设的相机姿态将像素转换为世界坐标。 当场景相机移动时，程序中没有任何机制会验证该姿态，而编写该程序的 LM 在测试时并未运行以察觉问题。 代码策略的准确率降至 9%，而 VLA 则保持 69%（图 9b）。 在七种使场景相机保持原位的故障情况下，代码策略会在每次移动前重新检测物体，并维持 90% 的准确率。 VLA 对新增指令的处理能力也更强：它基于自身的自我探索数据进行训练，其中 95% 的回合包含明确指令，在预留的 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 任务上分别达到 42.6% 和 43.6% 的准确率，与在任务指令公开后编写的代码策略（41.7% 和 24.9%）相当或更高。

sents.zh: 权重能在相机移动后继续有效，但代码则不然。

sents.zh: 一种代码策略通过预设的相机姿态将像素转换为世界坐标。

paragraphs.en: The two kinds of agent attend to different things. Code agents open rendered images in 84 to 96% of sessions; only 10 of 40 inspected VLA sessions ever look at a rollout of the policy they train. Two thirds of code agents’ memories concern grasp and contact, while over a third of VLA agents’ memories concern the training recipe ( Table 10 ). Code agents mostly debug how the robot interacts with objects. VLA agents mostly debug the training pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种智能体关注的事物不同。 在 84% 到 96% 的会话中，代码智能体会打开渲染后的图像；而在检查的 40 次 VLA 会话中，仅有 10 次会查看它们所训练策略的执行过程。 代码智能体记忆中有三分之二与抓取和接触有关，而超过三分之一的 VLA 智能体记忆则与训练方案相关（表 10）。 代码智能体主要调试机器人与物体的交互方式。 VLA 智能体主要调试训练流程。

paragraphs.en: On hardware the agent practices each task for up to 12 hours, starting from an empty library, and must also learn to reset the scene. Table 4 gives the frozen policies’ scores on staged scenes: Fable 5.1 leads at 70.2%, ahead of GPT-6-astra at 41.4 and Opus at 35.6.
paragraphs.zh: 在硬件上，智能体会对每个任务进行长达 12 小时的练习，从空白的知识库开始，并且还必须学会重置场景。 表 4 列出了冻结策略在分阶段场景中的得分：Fable 5.1 以 70.2% 领先，高于 GPT-6-astra 的 41.4% 和 Opus 的 35.6%。

sents.en: On hardware the agent practices each task for up to 12 hours, starting from an empty library, and must also learn to reset the scene.

sents.en: Table 4 gives the frozen policies’ scores on staged scenes: Fable 5.1 leads at 70.2%, ahead of GPT-6-astra at 41.4 and Opus at 35.6.
sents.zh: 表 4 列出了冻结策略在分阶段场景中的得分：Fable 5.1 以 70.2% 领先，高于 GPT-6-astra 的 41.4% 和 Opus 的 35.6%。

paragraphs.en: Ten practice successes in a row do not guarantee a high held-out score. Six practice runs reached ten successes in a row, which ends practice. only one of them, Fable’s Push-T, then succeeded on all ten staged scenes, and two (Fable’s Spell SEAR, Opus’s Cup Upright) succeeded on only four. The reason is that the agent’s own resets choose the states it practices on ( Figure 11 c). Only 10 of Opus’s 64 practice Push-T starts required turning the T by more than 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , against 6 of the 10 staged scenes. Fable’s reset, which scrambles the letters, never left a letter farther than 0.48 m from an arm, but 2 staged Spell SEAR scenes did. A streak measured on states of the agent’s own making can end practice before the hard states ever appear.
paragraphs.zh: 连续十次练习成功，并不保证在保留集上能获得高分。 有六次练习运行达到了连续十次成功，从而结束了练习。其中只有一次（Fable 的 Push-T）随后在所有十个场景中都成功了，而另外两次（Fable 的 Spell SEAR、Opus 的 Cup Upright）仅成功了四次。 原因是智能体自身的重置操作会决定它要练习的状态（图 11c）。 Opus 的 64 次 Push-T 练习启动中，只有 10 次需要将 T 旋转超过 90°（90^{\circ}），而十个场景中有 6 个需要这样做。 Fable 的重置操作会打乱字母，但从未让任何字母与手臂的距离超过 0.48 米，而 Spell SEAR 的两个场景却出现了这种情况。 在智能体自己创造的状态上测量的成功 streak，可能会在困难状态出现之前就结束练习。

sents.en: Ten practice successes in a row do not guarantee a high held-out score.
sents.zh: 连续十次练习成功，并不保证在保留集上能获得高分。

paragraphs.en: Frozen policies fail at limits the agents set themselves. We audited all 116 failed or partial evaluation outcomes; no scene was physically impossible, since each was solved by another agent, by the same agent in the other mode, or lay within measured reach. In 29 of 34 for Fable, 32 of 35 for Opus, and 26 of 47 for GPT-6-astra, the policy stopped at a limit, rule, or motion the agent had chosen itself, typically after a single incident in practice. Fable, for example, set a reach limit of 0.49 m with a vertical gripper, while tilting the gripper by 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} reaches 0.56 m. The two staged scenes beyond its limit fail ( Appendix K ). A lesson learned once becomes a rule, and nothing in the loop tests it again.
paragraphs.zh: 被冻结的策略在智能体自行设定的极限处失效。 我们审计了全部 116 个失败或部分成功的评估结果；没有任何场景在物理上是不可能的，因为每个场景都曾被另一个智能体、同一智能体在另一种模式下解决，或处于可测量的可达范围内。 在 Fable 的 34 个场景中，有 29 个；在 Opus 的 35 个场景中，有 32 个；在 GPT-6-astra 的 47 个场景中，有 26 个案例中，策略因智能体自行设定的极限、规则或动作而停止，实际上通常仅发生在单次事件之后。 例如，Fable 使用垂直夹爪时将可达距离限制为 0.49 米，而将夹爪倾斜 15°（15^{\circ}）后可达距离可达 0.56 米。 超出其极限的两个分阶段场景均失败（附录 K）。 一旦学到的教训就会变成规则，而循环中的任何内容都不会再次对其进行测试。

sents.en: Frozen policies fail at limits the agents set themselves.
sents.zh: 被冻结的策略在智能体自行设定的极限处失效。

sents.en: We audited all 116 failed or partial evaluation outcomes; no scene was physically impossible, since each was solved by another agent, by the same agent in the other mode, or lay within measured reach.
sents.zh: 我们审计了全部 116 个失败或部分成功的评估结果；没有任何场景在物理上是不可能的，因为每个场景都曾被另一个智能体、同一智能体在另一种模式下解决，或处于可测量的可达范围内。

sents.en: In 29 of 34 for Fable, 32 of 35 for Opus, and 26 of 47 for GPT-6-astra, the policy stopped at a limit, rule, or motion the agent had chosen itself, typically after a single incident in practice.
sents.zh: 在 Fable 的 34 个场景中，有 29 个；在 Opus 的 35 个场景中，有 32 个；在 GPT-6-astra 的 47 个场景中，有 26 个案例中，策略因智能体自行设定的极限、规则或动作而停止，实际上通常仅发生在单次事件之后。

sents.en: Fable, for example, set a reach limit of 0.49 m with a vertical gripper, while tilting the gripper by 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} reaches 0.56 m.
sents.zh: 例如，Fable 使用垂直夹爪时将可达距离限制为 0.49 米，而将夹爪倾斜 15°（15^{\circ}）后可达距离可达 0.56 米。

sents.en: The two staged scenes beyond its limit fail ( Appendix K ).
sents.zh: 超出其极限的两个分阶段场景均失败（附录 K）。

sents.en: A lesson learned once becomes a rule, and nothing in the loop tests it again.
sents.zh: 一旦学到的教训就会变成规则，而循环中的任何内容都不会再次对其进行测试。

paragraphs.en: The loop runs on a second embodiment. We ported the harness to a Sharpa Wave hand with 22 joints on a Flexiv arm, sharing no hardware with the two-arm rig. A Fable 5.1 agent learned to type random digits on a physical numpad at over five keys per second within 2.5 hours, and typed the first 100 digits of π \pi three times at 5.1 keys per second with one wrong digit in total across the three runs ( Figure 12 ); the learned typing policy also plays a short melody on a piano keyboard ( project website ). The agent learned on this hand alone, on hardware only. An accurate simulated twin of the hand later proved hard to build. The demonstration therefore shows that the harness can be moved to a new robot, not that skills transfer between robots.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环在第二种实现方案中运行。 我们将这套控制装置移植到一只具有 22 个关节的 Sharpa Wave 手型上，并安装于 Flexiv 机械臂，与双臂机械结构没有任何硬件共享。 一个 Fable 5.1 智能体在不到 2.5 小时内学会以每秒超过五个按键的速度在实体数字键盘上输入随机数字，并在三次尝试中三次成功输入 π \pi 的前 100 位数字，总错误位数仅为 1（图 12）；该智能体学到的打字策略还能在钢琴键盘上演奏一段短旋律（项目网站）。 该智能体仅在这只手上、且仅在硬件上完成了学习。 后来发现，要构建一个精确的该手的模拟孪生体十分困难。 因此，这一演示表明这套控制装置可以迁移到新的机器人上，而非技能可以在不同机器人之间转移。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 a compares the five simulation models without a library. Opus has the highest score on every family, with or without a library ( Table 6 ). GPT-5.6-sol is second on every family without a library. With a library, Kimi-k3 overtakes it on robosuite, LIBERO-RIG, and RoboLab. The ranking follows general capability. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) (high reasoning setting; Figure 13 b), Opus scores 48, GPT-5.6-sol 47, Kimi-k3 44, and Gemini-3.6-flash and DeepSeek-v4-flash 34 each. Without a library, the robot ranking follows this order on robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab. On LIBERO-RIG, where DeepSeek-v4.1-flash replaces DeepSeek-v4-flash, DeepSeek places third. Small differences on the index become large differences on the robot. Opus and GPT-5.6-sol are one index point apart, but 4.8 points of success apart on robosuite and 15.0 apart on RoboLab. The spread also grows with difficulty: without a library, the best and worst models are 23.8 points apart on robosuite and 43.6 on RoboLab. Under LIBERO-RIG’s hidden faults, the gap is 60.0 points. Below some level of capability, the loop has nothing to work with. One Inkling-small run went 29 tasks in a row without a valid policy, so it had nothing to save in its library, and we withdrew the model ( Appendix O ). The library pays off only above this capability floor ( Section 3.2 ). With three runs per model, the rankings are not firm. On the easier families, the spread between repeated runs often exceeds the gap between neighboring models ( Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 13a 比较了五个没有知识库的模拟模型。 无论是否使用知识库，Opus 在所有任务族中的得分都最高（表 6）。 在没有知识库的情况下，GPT-5.6-sol 在所有任务族中排名第二。 使用知识库后，Kimi-k3 在 robosuite、LIBERO-RIG 和 RoboLab 上超过了它。 排名反映了整体能力的高低。 在人工分析智能指数（Artificial Analysis, 2026）（高推理设置；图 13b）中，Opus 得分为 48，GPT-5.6-sol 为 47，Kimi-k3 为 44，而 Gemini-3.6-flash 和 DeepSeek-v4-flash 均为 34。 在没有知识库的情况下，机器人排名在 robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上遵循这一顺序。 在 LIBERO-RIG 中，由于 DeepSeek-v4.1-flash 替代了 DeepSeek-v4-flash，DeepSeek 排名第三。 指数上的微小差异会转化为机器人任务上的巨大差异。 Opus 和 GPT-5.6-sol 的指数得分仅相差 1 分，但在 robosuite 上的成功分数相差 4.8 分，在 RoboLab 上则相差 15.0 分。 随着难度增加，这种差距也会扩大：在没有知识库的情况下，最佳模型和最差模型在 robosuite 上的得分相差 23.8 分，在 RoboLab 上则相差 43.6 分。 在 LIBERO-RIG 的隐藏故障测试中，这一差距达到了 60.0 分。 当能力低于某个水平时，循环系统便无可用资源进行运作。 在一次 Inkling-small 的运行中，模型连续完成了 29 个任务却未生成有效策略，因此无法将任何内容保存至知识库，于是我们撤回了该模型（附录 O）。 只有当能力超过这一基础水平时，知识库才会发挥作用（第 3.2 节）。 由于每个模型仅运行了三次，排名结果并不稳固。 在较简单的任务族中，重复运行之间的差异通常超过了相邻模型之间的差距（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: A natural guess is that manipulation rewards the model that can see. Our results do not support this guess. DeepSeek-v4-flash is text-only, yet it combines the tools in its toolbox into working manipulation policies: nearly all of its RoboLab policies ask SAM3 for a mask of the named object and use the depth image to turn that mask into a 3-D position, and it produces a policy in 85% of runs. On RoboLab, the hardest family, it beats the multimodal Gemini-3.6-flash, which has the same index score (34). It wins without a library (23.1 against 18.3%) and with one (30.7 against 22.6% on the 58 tasks both completed), though not in best-of-3. DeepSeek-v4-flash trails Gemini-3.6-flash on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO (by 12.1 and 6.0 points without a library). When SAM3 misses an object, DeepSeek-v4-flash has no fallback. Among the multimodal models, GPT-5.6-sol never opens images directly and Gemini-3.6-flash opens one in 2% of runs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的推测是，操控任务会奖励能够“看见”的智能体。 我们的结果并不支持这一推测。 DeepSeek-v4-flash 仅支持文本输入，但它能将工具箱中的工具整合为可用的操控策略：其几乎所有 RoboLab 策略都会向 SAM3 请求目标物体的掩码，并利用深度图像将该掩码转换为三维位置；在 85% 的运行中，它都能生成有效策略。 在 RoboLab 最具挑战性的任务类别中，它的表现优于同样拥有 34 分指数得分的多模态模型 Gemini-3.6-flash。 无论是否使用工具库，它都能获胜（不使用工具库时得分为 23.1%，而对手为 18.3%；使用一个工具库时得分为 30.7%，而对手在 58 个共同完成的任务中得分为 22.6%），但在“三选最佳”测试中则未取胜。 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 任务上，DeepSeek-v4-flash 的表现落后于 Gemini-3.6-flash（不使用工具库时分别相差 12.1 分和 6.0 分）。 当 SAM3 未能识别某个物体时，DeepSeek-v4-flash 没有备用方案。 在多模态模型中，GPT-5.6-sol 从未直接打开图像，而 Gemini-3.6-flash 在 2% 的运行中会打开一张图像。

sents.en: A natural guess is that manipulation rewards the model that can see.
sents.zh: 一个自然的推测是，操控任务会奖励能够“看见”的智能体。

sents.en: Our results do not support this guess.
sents.zh: 我们的结果并不支持这一推测。

sents.en: DeepSeek-v4-flash is text-only, yet it combines the tools in its toolbox into working manipulation policies: nearly all of its RoboLab policies ask SAM3 for a mask of the named object and use the depth image to turn that mask into a 3-D position, and it produces a policy in 85% of runs.

paragraphs.en: Images are used mainly for diagnosis. Opus views six to seven images per run. After viewing an image, it edits its code 38% of the time, against a 24% baseline, and Kimi-k3 edits after 68% of its views. The failures these models diagnose are physical, not perceptual. Over 21,552 graded RoboLab episodes, the target’s distance, rotation, and clutter barely predict success (correlation 0.04 in magnitude). What fails is the grasp. In episodes where the policy logged how wide the gripper was when it closed, the gripper had closed on air in 78% of failed episodes and in 18% of successful ones. Tasks that need 3-D relations, such as stacking, are among the easiest. Tasks that require grasping rims, handles, or thin shafts are the hardest. Few policies rely on a learned action model: only 2% of no-library RoboLab policies call the pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} in the toolbox. GPT-5.6-sol’s policies that used it scored 16%, against 54% for those that did not.
paragraphs.zh: 图像主要用于诊断。 Opus 每次运行会查看六到七张图像。 在查看一张图像后，它 38% 的情况下会修改自己的代码（基线为 24%），而 Kimi-k3 则在 68% 的查看次数之后进行修改。 这些模型诊断出的失败是物理性的，而非感知性的。 在超过 21,552 个经过评分的 RoboLab 回合中，目标物的距离、旋转和杂乱程度几乎无法预测成功与否（幅度相关系数为 0.04）。真正导致失败的是抓取动作。 在策略记录了夹爪闭合时宽度的回合中，78% 的失败回合里夹爪抓到了空气，而在成功回合中这一比例为 18%。 需要三维关系（如堆叠）的任务属于最简单的任务之一。 需要抓取边缘、把手或细轴的任务是最难的。 很少有策略依赖已学习的动作模型：在无库 RoboLab 策略中，仅有 2% 的策略调用了工具箱中预训练的 π₀.₅。 使用 GPT-5.6-sol 的 GPT-5.6-sol 策略得分仅为 16%，而未使用的策略得分为 54%。

paragraphs.en: On hardware we also ran agent-as-policy: the LM stays in the loop at test time and re-observes the scene before every command ( Table 4 ). We gave two models the same instructions, which ask for one command at a time but allow the model to write its own tools. The two models act in opposite ways. GPT-6-astra issues every command through a separate model call and requests about one image per arm motion. Acting live, it scores 88.0%, against 41.4% as a frozen code policy, and 95% against 48% on the four non-stacking tasks. It uses a fresh image to notice and correct a mistake in at least 9 of its 25 evaluation episodes. Fable 5.1 instead scripts the robot: its tool code grows from 202 to 3,576 lines over the five tasks, those scripts issue 99% of its commands, and it looks at one image per seven motions. In effect, Fable 5.1 has turned live execution back into code-as-policy, and it scores about the same in both modes: 70% on the four non-stacking tasks either way. Overall it scores 66.4% live against 70.2% frozen, a gap that comes from Block Stacking, whose live runs used a different stopping rule. Each model scores highest in the mode it prefers, though for Fable 5.1 the margin is small. paragraphs.en: Self-improving LM agents. An LM agent can improve without weight updates by writing reflections on its failures into memory, as in Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , by growing a library of code skills, as Voyager does in Minecraft ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , or by rewriting its own improvement procedure ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) and harness ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Weng, 2026 ) . SEAR ’s library combines the first two. Lin et al. (2026b) show that much apparent self-evolution in LM agents is lucky resampling. Our best-of-3 and no-library controls test for the same effect in robot learning, where feedback comes from physical execution. Benchmarks for research agents ( Chan et al., 2024 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) share our emphasis on fixed budgets and isolated grading, and our sealed judge adapts EdgeBench’s separate work and judge containers ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的语言模型智能体。 语言模型智能体无需更新权重即可实现改进：它可以将对失败的反思写入记忆（如 Reflexion（Shinn 等人，2023）所示），可以扩展代码技能库（如 Voyager 在 Minecraft 中的做法（Wang 等人，2023）），也可以重写自身的改进流程（Zelikman 等人，2024）并加以利用（Lin 等人，2026a；Weng，2026）。 SEAR 的库结合了前两种方法。Lin 等人 （2026b）指出，语言模型智能体中许多看似自我进化的现象其实只是幸运的重新采样。 我们的“三选一最佳”和无库对照组在机器人学习中检验了同样的效应，其中反馈来自物理执行过程。 面向研究型智能体的基准测试（Chan 等人，2024；Wijk 等人，2025；Starace 等人，2025；Rank 等人，2026）与我们一样强调固定预算和独立评分，而我们的密封评判器则借鉴了 EdgeBench 的独立工作模块和评判容器（Zhu 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: LMs that write robot behavior. Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) and ProgPrompt ( Singh et al., 2023 ) have an LM write executable robot programs from instructions; Eureka ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and RoboGen ( Wang et al., 2024 ) have it write the machinery that produces a policy, such as reward code or task scenes. Auto-research in SEAR belongs to the second line: the agent builds the data and training pipeline for a VLA ( Black et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 编写机器人行为的语言模型。 《代码即策略》（Liang 等，2023）和 ProgPrompt（Singh 等，2023）让语言模型根据指令编写可执行的机器人程序；而 Eureka（Ma 等，2024）和 RoboGen（Wang 等，2024）则让它编写生成策略的机制，例如奖励代码或任务场景。 SEAR 中的自动研究属于第二类：智能体为 VLA 构建数据和训练流程（Black 等，2025）。

sents.en: LMs that write robot behavior.
sents.zh: 编写机器人行为的语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving robot agents. CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) benchmarks and improves coding agents for manipulation; ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) and RATs ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) grow skill libraries through practice or play and reuse them on new tasks; ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) lets an agent improve its own robot policy on real hardware; Waddle ( Waddle Labs, 2026 ) has agents control physical robots and share a skill library. A further wave appeared while this paper was being written. RPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , RoboRSI ( Wen et al., 2026 ) , and Embodied Turing Machines ( Hu et al., 2026b ) evolve a shared skill or code library through practice and validate changes before keeping them; Kuroki & Tang (2026) reuse an archive of agent-optimized programs on new tasks; Wei et al. (2026) evolve the harness of an agent that acts in the loop and find that keeping only revisions that beat the current harness matters. Closer to our auto-research mode, SimEX ( Hu et al., 2026a ) has a coding agent build and correct a robot toolbox and its simulator, and Robo-COP ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) lets an orchestrator fine-tune its VLA on demonstrations it curates on RoboLab tasks. Each defines its own protocol ( Table 1 ), so their results cannot be compared, and none reports both a budget-matched restart control (our best-of-3) and a no-library control. SEAR provides one shared protocol that includes both controls, and runs code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research under it. Three findings elsewhere echo ours. An agent that decides after each tool call succeeds more often than a program written in advance (56 against 24%; Ge et al., 2026 ; see also Li et al., 2026 ; Si et al., 2026 ). An LM orchestrator that plans, checks outcomes, and recovers around frozen VLAs and skills lifts LIBERO-PRO success from 12.8 to 53.3% with no training, a gap its authors call the orchestration gap ( Galanti et al., 2026 ) . And 123 rounds of agentic skill discovery can fail to solve a single target task ( Wang, 2026 ) . Along the same lines, RoboHarness ( BinceQu, 2026 ) gives a coding agent tracked image keypoints and a few motion primitives, with no training, and reports beating VLA and world-action models on BEHAVIOR household tasks (at twice the challenge’s step budget) and lifting between 68 and 86 of 100 unseen objects, depending on the LM. LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) was itself built for lifelong learning.
paragraphs.zh: 自我进化的机器人智能体。 CaP-X（Fu 等人，2026）为操控任务中的编码智能体提供基准并加以改进；ASPIRE（Lu 等人，2026）和 RATs（Zhang 等人，2026a）通过实践或游戏扩展技能库，并将这些技能重新用于新任务；ENPIRE（Xiao 等人，2026）允许智能体在真实硬件上改进自身的机器人策略；Waddle（Waddle Labs，2026）则让智能体控制物理机器人并共享一个技能库。 在撰写本文期间，又出现了一波相关研究。 RPG（Wang 等人，2026）、RoboRSI（Wen 等人，2026）和具身图灵机（Hu 等人，2026b）通过实践演化共享的技能或代码库，并在保留改动前进行验证；Kuroki & Tang（2026）则将智能体优化的程序存档重新用于新任务；Wei 等人 （2026）演化了一个在循环中执行操作的智能体的控制框架，并发现仅保留优于当前框架的修订版本至关重要。 更接近我们的自动研究模式的是 SimEX（Hu 等人，2026a），其中编码智能体负责构建和修正机器人工具箱及其模拟器；而 Robo-COP（Zhang 等人，2026b）则允许协调器基于其在 RoboLab 任务中精选的演示数据对 VLA 进行微调。 每项研究都定义了自身的协议（表 1），因此其结果无法相互比较，且没有任何一项同时报告了预算匹配的重新开始对照组（我们的“三选一最佳”方案）和无技能库对照组的结果。 SEAR 提供了一个包含两种对照组的通用协议，并在此框架下运行了“代码即策略”、“智能体即策略”和自动研究三种模式。 其他三项研究也得出了与我们一致的发现。 在每次工具调用后做出决策的智能体，比预先编写好的程序更频繁地取得成功（56% 对比 24%；Ge 等人，2026；另见 Li 等人，2026；Si 等人，2026）。 一种能够规划、检查结果并在冻结的 VLA 和技能周围进行恢复的语言模型协调器，在没有训练的情况下将 LIBERO-PRO 的成功率从 12.8% 提升至 53.3%，这一差距被其作者称为“协调差距”（Galanti 等人，2026）。 此外，123 轮智能体技能探索可能仍无法解决任何一个目标任务（Wang，2026）。 类似地，RoboHarness（BinceQu，2026）为编码智能体提供了已追踪的图像关键点和一些基础运动原语，且无需训练；报告称其在 BEHAVIOR 家庭任务中超越了 VLA 和世界动作模型（尽管步数预算是挑战任务的两倍），并根据所用语言模型的不同，成功抓取了 100 个未见过的物体中的 68 到 86 个。 LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023）本身正是为终身学习而设计的。

sents.zh: SEAR 提出一个问题：一旦由智能体而非训练循环来决定保留哪些内容，图书馆的价值又体现在何处。

sents.en: Interface standards such as XPolicyLab ( XPolicyLab, 2026 ) are complementary.
sents.zh: 诸如 XPolicyLab（XPolicyLab，2026）之类的接口标准具有互补性。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks of LM agents that use robots. RobotWorld ( Yang et al., 2026b ) evaluates frontier agents that act through robot tool calls on 84 simulated tasks across manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, one episode per task, and finds that models differ by the kind of goal they solve, as our models differ by how they prefer to act ( Section 5.3 ). RLE-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) tests coding agents as robot learning engineers across control, policy learning, perception, and mechanical design. EmbodiedSWE ( Shen et al., 2026 ) benchmarks coding agents on long-horizon dexterous tasks and turns their verified solutions into VLA training data, noting that the solutions tend to be specialized to single task instances. These benchmarks measure what an agent can do in one attempt. SEAR measures what the agent keeps from practice and how far from practice that knowledge still works.
paragraphs.zh: 使用机器人的语言模型智能体的基准测试。 RobotWorld（Yang 等人，2026b）评估通过机器人工具调用执行操作的边界智能体，涵盖操作、移动、驾驶和空中控制等 84 个模拟任务，每个任务仅运行一个回合。研究结果表明，模型的表现差异取决于其解决的目标类型，正如我们的模型表现差异取决于其偏好的行动方式（第 5.3 节）。 RLE-Bench（Ma 等人，2026）将编码智能体作为机器人学习工程师进行测试，涵盖控制、策略学习、感知和机械设计等领域。 EmbodiedSWE（Shen 等人，2026）对编码智能体在长期灵巧任务上的表现进行基准测试，并将其经过验证的解决方案转化为 VLA 训练数据。研究指出，这些解决方案往往针对单一任务实例高度特化。 这些基准测试衡量的是智能体在一次尝试中能够完成的任务。 SEAR 衡量的是智能体通过练习保留的知识，以及这种知识在脱离练习后仍能在多大程度上有效。

paragraphs.en: A continual learning loop. Today a SEAR agent carries one thing from task to task: its library of code skills, tools, and written memories. A trained action model stays with the suite that produced it. The natural next step is a loop in which everything the agent touches improves together. Every round of practice produces rollouts and feedback, and that experience can flow into four places: the library, as reusable code and memories; the harness, meaning the sensors, tools, reset procedures, and safety limits the agent works through; the action model, fine-tuned on the agent’s own rollouts with failures filtered out or turned into recovery data; and eventually the LM itself, trained on its own interaction traces. Whatever improves is handed back to the agent for the next round. Seen this way, the persistent state of the whole system plays the role that weights play elsewhere, except that much of it is readable, editable knowledge. Our results point at one architecture for that loop: the LM as a deliberative layer that plans, diagnoses, and writes code, and a VLA as a reactive layer for continuous control, trained on what the LM delegates to it. Code policies break when the camera moves, but the VLA does not. The VLA, in turn, is limited by the demonstrations that code supplies ( Section 4.3 ). Each layer therefore covers the other’s failure. Figure 14 sketches the loop, and Appendix S describes what evaluating it would require. SEAR is built to test whether such a loop changes the shape of the improvement curve, not only its height.
paragraphs.zh: 一种持续学习循环。 今天，一个 SEAR 智能体在各项任务之间携带着一样东西：它的代码技能、工具和书面记忆库。 一个训练好的动作模型会一直保留在产生它的套件中。 自然的下一步是一个循环，在这个循环中，智能体接触到的所有事物都会共同得到改进。 每一轮实践都会产生执行轨迹和反馈，而这些经验可以流入四个地方：作为可重用的代码和记忆存入库中；进入执行框架，即智能体所依赖的传感器、工具、重置程序和安全性限制；用于在智能体自身的执行轨迹上进行微调的动作模型（其中失败部分被过滤掉或转化为恢复数据）；以及最终训练于自身交互痕迹的语言模型本身。 任何得到改进的部分都会反馈给智能体，用于下一轮循环。 从这个角度看，整个系统的持久状态扮演了其他系统中权重所扮演的角色，只不过其中大部分是可读且可编辑的知识。 我们的研究结果指向了这种循环的一种架构：语言模型作为推理层，负责规划、诊断和编写代码；而视觉-语言动作模型（VLA）则作为反应层，用于持续控制，并由语言模型委托给它的任务进行训练。 当摄像头移动时，代码策略会失效，但 VLA 不会。 反过来，VLA 的能力又受到代码所提供的演示示例的限制（第 4.3 节）。 因此，每一层都覆盖了另一层的失效情况。 图 14 描绘了这种循环，附录 S 描述了评估它所需的内容。 SEAR 的设计旨在测试这样的循环是否改变了改进曲线的形态，而不仅仅是其高度。

paragraphs.en: What the controls bought. Each finding depends on a control a single learning curve would not have. Without best-of-3, we could not tell when one long session beats three restarts. Without the no-library run, the library would seem to help every model. Without repeated runs, the run that collapsed after saving a false verdict ( Section 3.3 ) would read as a model difference. Without the sealed judge and its audit, the shortcuts of Section A.9 would count as skill. Without the tiers, a gain on held-out states would pass for transfer. Section A.7 turns these findings into design rules for anyone building such a system, and Section A.8 lists the limitations of this study.
paragraphs.zh: 这些控制措施带来的成果。 每一项发现都依赖于某种单一学习曲线无法提供的控制手段。 如果没有“三局两胜制”，我们就无法判断一次长时间运行是否优于三次重启。 如果没有无库运行测试，库似乎会对每个模型都有帮助。 如果没有重复运行，那次在保存错误结论后崩溃的运行（第 3.3 节）会被误认为模型差异。 如果没有密封裁判及其审计，第 A.9 节中的捷径将被视为技能。 如果没有分层设计，对保留状态的改进会被误认为是迁移能力。 第 A.7 节将这些发现转化为任何构建此类系统的人应遵循的设计规则，而第 A.8 节则列出了本研究的局限性。

paragraphs.en: When an agent improves a robot from its own experience, a rising success rate is not enough evidence that it is learning. SEAR asks two questions: is the agent learning or just trying more often, and does what it learns help on tasks other than the one it practiced? It answers both with matched controls, a sealed judge, and five tiers of distance from practice. Across seven frontier LMs, the answers are mixed in ways a single learning curve would hide. Long sessions pay off only for models that are slow to reach a first success. Libraries help most for models that succeed sometimes but not reliably, and they can also hurt. Control code and shared routines transfer, while task-specific solutions do not, and a success streak in practice does not guarantee success on scenes someone else sets up. Finally, the choice of LM, and how that LM prefers to act, decide much of what the robot can do.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个智能体基于自身经验改进机器人时，成功率的上升并不足以证明它正在学习。 SEAR 提出了两个问题：这个智能体是在学习，还是仅仅在更频繁地尝试？以及它所学到的东西是否有助于除练习任务以外的其他任务？ 它通过匹配的控制组、一个封闭的评判机制，以及与练习任务五个不同层级的距离来回答这两个问题。 在七款前沿大语言模型中，答案呈现出单一学习曲线所无法揭示的复杂差异。 只有那些首次成功进展缓慢的模型，在长时间运行后才会获得回报。 对于偶尔成功但缺乏稳定性的模型，库的帮助最大，但它们也可能产生负面影响。 控制代码和共享程序可以被迁移，而特定任务的解决方案则无法迁移；此外，练习中的连续成功并不能保证在他人设定的场景中也能成功。 最后，大语言模型的选择以及该模型偏好的行为方式，在很大程度上决定了机器人能够完成哪些任务。

paragraphs.en: This appendix holds the evidence behind the main text that did not fit there, in the order of Sections 3 , 4 and 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录收录了正文中因篇幅所限未能容纳的证据，并按照第 3、4 和 5 节的顺序排列。

paragraphs.en: We pool 1,510 matched model–task pairs across robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab, each with three Vanilla repetitions and three Lineage repetitions (two on 171 pairs). Comparing means, Lineage scores higher than Vanilla on 96 of the 214 pairs where every Vanilla repetition scores zero. On the other 1,296 pairs it scores higher on 511 and lower on 354. Because a pair’s Vanilla score is itself noisy, some of these changes would appear in any rerun. We therefore compare each Lineage repetition with a third Vanilla repetition, both read against the mean of the first two Vanilla repetitions. On the 276 pairs where the first two Vanilla repetitions score zero, a Lineage repetition scores above zero in 32.5% of cases and at least 50% in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition does so in 22.5 and 13.0%. On the 1,234 pairs with some Vanilla success, a Lineage repetition scores above the Vanilla mean in 33.7% of cases and below it in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition, in 26.1 and 31.9%. The library therefore helps by 8 to 10 points on both kinds of pair. On unsolved pairs the margin comes from LIBERO-PRO and RoboLab; on LIBERO a third Vanilla repetition does as well. Bucketing pairs by the full Vanilla mean would be biased by regression to the mean, which is why the split-repetition comparison is used ( Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 中汇总了 1,510 个匹配成功的模型–任务对，每对均包含三次 Vanilla 重复试验和三次 Lineage 重复试验（其中 171 个对包含两次试验）。 对比均值可以发现，在 214 个所有 Vanilla 重复试验得分均为零的对中，Lineage 的得分高于 Vanilla 的有 96 个。 在其余 1,296 个对中，Lineage 的得分高于 Vanilla 的有 511 个，低于的有 354 个。 由于某个对的 Vanilla 得分本身存在噪声，这些变化中的部分可能在任何重复试验中都会出现。 因此，我们将每次 Lineage 重复试验与第三次 Vanilla 重复试验进行比较，两者均基于前两次 Vanilla 重复试验的均值进行评判。 在首次两次 Vanilla 重复试验得分均为零的 276 个对中，Lineage 重复试验有 32.5% 的情况得分高于零，23.1% 的情况得分至少达到 50%；而第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的对应比例分别为 22.5% 和 13.0%。 在 Vanilla 试验有部分成功的 1,234 个对中，Lineage 重复试验有 33.7% 的情况得分高于 Vanilla 均值，23.1% 的情况低于该均值；第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的对应比例分别为 26.1% 和 31.9%。 因此，该库在这两类对中分别带来了 8 到 10 分的提升。 在未解决的对中，这一差距来自 LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab；而在 LIBERO 中，第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的表现同样良好。 若按完整的 Vanilla 均值对各个对进行分组，会受到向均值回归的影响，因此我们采用了分拆重复试验的对比方法（表 7）。

sents.en: We therefore compare each Lineage repetition with a third Vanilla repetition, both read against the mean of the first two Vanilla repetitions.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将每次 Lineage 重复试验与第三次 Vanilla 重复试验进行比较，两者均基于前两次 Vanilla 重复试验的均值进行评判。

sents.en: On the 276 pairs where the first two Vanilla repetitions score zero, a Lineage repetition scores above zero in 32.5% of cases and at least 50% in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition does so in 22.5 and 13.0%.
sents.zh: 在首次两次 Vanilla 重复试验得分均为零的 276 个对中，Lineage 重复试验有 32.5% 的情况得分高于零，23.1% 的情况得分至少达到 50%；而第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的对应比例分别为 22.5% 和 13.0%。

sents.en: On the 1,234 pairs with some Vanilla success, a Lineage repetition scores above the Vanilla mean in 33.7% of cases and below it in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition, in 26.1 and 31.9%.
sents.zh: 在 Vanilla 试验有部分成功的 1,234 个对中，Lineage 重复试验有 33.7% 的情况得分高于 Vanilla 均值，23.1% 的情况低于该均值；第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的对应比例分别为 26.1% 和 31.9%。

sents.en: The library therefore helps by 8 to 10 points on both kinds of pair.
sents.zh: 因此，该库在这两类对中分别带来了 8 到 10 分的提升。

sents.en: On unsolved pairs the margin comes from LIBERO-PRO and RoboLab; on LIBERO a third Vanilla repetition does as well.
sents.zh: 在未解决的对中，这一差距来自 LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab；而在 LIBERO 中，第三次 Vanilla 重复试验的表现同样良好。

sents.en: Bucketing pairs by the full Vanilla mean would be biased by regression to the mean, which is why the split-repetition comparison is used ( Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 若按完整的 Vanilla 均值对各个对进行分组，会受到向均值回归的影响，因此我们采用了分拆重复试验的对比方法（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: We run GPT-5.6-sol on RoboLab with libraries written by Opus or Kimi-k3. For each task, the recipient gets the library version the donor held before attempting that task, with the same filters as in Lineage; the task, recipient model, and two-hour budget stay the same, and the crossover runs do not add their own experience to the donor library. One selected donor lineage per model, three runs of GPT-5.6-sol over all 105 tasks per donor, 630 runs in all; each task’s score averages its graded runs, leaving out seven judge crashes on policies that scored zero on validation. A useful library also reaches a higher score sooner. On the runs matched to the crossover (whose finals differ slightly from Table 15 ), GPT-5.6-sol with Opus’s library reaches 55.2% best-so-far validation success at half budget, above its no-library final 51.4%; For comparison, Kimi-k3 with its own library reaches 32.5% at half budget, above its Vanilla final 28.8%. In the crossover, the median time to first success among successful runs changes little; the library helps more runs succeed or reach higher scores within the budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboLab 上运行 GPT-5.6-sol，并使用由 Opus 或 Kimi-k3 编写的库。 对于每个任务，接收方在尝试该任务前会获得捐赠方所持的库版本，并应用与 Lineage 中相同的筛选条件；任务、接收方模型和两小时预算保持不变，且交叉运行不会将自身经验添加到捐赠方的库中。 每个模型选择一个选定的捐赠者谱系，每位捐赠者在全部 105 个任务上运行三次 GPT-5.6-sol，总计 630 次运行；每个任务的分数为其评分运行的平均值，排除在验证阶段得分为零的策略所导致的七次裁判崩溃。 一个有用的库也能更快地达到更高的分数。 在与交叉运行匹配的实验组中（其最终结果与表 15 略有不同），使用 Opus 库的 GPT-5.6-sol 在预算过半时达到了 55.2% 的最佳验证成功率，高于无库时的最终 51.4%；相比之下，使用自身库的 Kimi-k3 在预算过半时达到了 32.5%，高于其基础版本的最终 28.8%。 在交叉运行中，成功运行首次成功的中间时间变化不大；该库帮助更多运行在预算内取得成功或达到更高的分数。

paragraphs.en: Not every collapse is variance. (A self-exploration lineage starts from a donor library evolved on an earlier family; its frozen policy is the task-general program left at the end of exploration, and its authored policy the one rewritten once the instruction is disclosed.) The three Opus self-exploration replicates seeded from the LIBERO-RIG donor first read 26.7, 34.1, and 0.5% on RoboLab with the frozen policy, but the collapsed replicate was one of 23 lineages across four models that never discovered a wrong-axis gripper offset in the tool frame, a rig defect. Rerun from the start under the corrected frame, it finished at 25.0% frozen and 31.8% authored, close to but just below its two siblings, which had found the offset on their own. Its Gemini-3.6-flash counterparts did not recover: twelve rerun Gemini-3.6-flash lineages solved 11 of 1,429 graded tasks with the frame fixed. Only two self-exploration separations between models survive the replicate spread: Gemini-3.6-flash at or near zero on every RoboLab donor against an Opus mean of 24 to 37%, and Kimi-k3 ahead of Opus on LIBERO, 38.0 against 26.9% for the frozen policy.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每一次崩溃都是变异性。 （一条自我探索谱系始于一个在早期家族中演化出的捐赠库；其冻结策略是探索结束时留下的通用任务程序，而其生成策略则是在指令被揭示后重新编写的。）三个源自 LIBERO-RIG 捐赠库的 Opus 自我探索复制体，在 RoboLab 上使用冻结策略时首次读取的百分比分别为 26.7%、34.1% 和 0.5%，但崩溃的复制体是四个模型中 23 条谱系之一，这些谱系从未发现工具框架中错误轴向的夹具偏移量——这是一种夹具缺陷。 在修正后的框架下从头重新运行时，其冻结策略完成率为 25.0%，生成策略完成率为 31.8%，接近但略低于另外两个自行发现了该偏移量的兄弟谱系。 其 Gemini-3.6-flash 对应版本未能恢复：十二条重新运行的 Gemini-3.6-flash 谱系在框架固定的情况下，仅解决了 1,429 个分级任务中的 11 个。 模型间的自我探索差异中，仅有两种在复制体分布中得以保留：Gemini-3.6-flash 在所有 RoboLab 捐赠库上的表现均为零或接近零，而 Opus 的平均值为 24% 至 37%；Kimi-k3 在 LIBERO 上优于 Opus，其冻结策略完成率为 38.0%，而 Opus 为 26.9%。

sents.en: Not every collapse is variance.
sents.zh: 并非每一次崩溃都是变异性。

paragraphs.en: A fix for one hardware fault does not carry to another. We take the policy each lineage wrote for a LIBERO-RIG course task and run it, frozen, on the same task under the other faults. It scores within − 10 -10 to + 10 +10 points of the policy the same model had written for that task on LIBERO-PRO, before it met any fault ( + 2 +2 for Opus, − 4 -4 for GPT-5.6-sol, − 10 -10 for Kimi-k3, + 10 +10 for DeepSeek-v4-flash, and + 3 +3 for Gemini-3.6-flash on validation at the moderate level; Appendix N ). Success also falls with severity (67, 60, and 52% on validation from the moderate to the most severe level), so a severe fault approaches the cost of a scene change; proprioception noise is the axis where code’s correction runs out (73, 37, and 4%; Table 12 ). The no-library control shows the same profile, so this pattern comes from code-as-policy with SAM3 perception, not from the learning loop. End-to-end VLA policies degrade instead of breaking: at the same moderate level, pooled over eight models, their success falls from 93 to 45% when the scene camera is moved and to 75% under a camera-to-arm calibration error ( Cui et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 修复一个硬件故障的方案无法迁移到另一个故障。 我们采用每个谱系为 LIBERO-RIG 课程任务编写的策略，并在其他故障条件下以冻结状态在同一任务上运行该策略。 其得分与同一模型此前在 LIBERO-PRO 上为该任务编写的策略相比，偏差在 −10 至 +10 分之间（在遇到任何故障之前；Opus 为 +2 分，GPT-5.6-sol 为 −4 分，Kimi-k3 为 −10 分，DeepSeek-v4-flash 为 +10 分，Gemini-3.6-flash 在中等验证水平上为 +3 分；附录 N）。 成功率也随故障严重程度的增加而下降（从中等到最严重的验证水平，成功率分别为 67%、60% 和 52%），因此严重故障带来的成本接近场景切换的成本；本体感知噪声是代码纠错能力耗尽的临界点（73%、37% 和 4%；表 12）。 无库对照组表现出相同的模式，因此这一规律源于结合 SAM3 感知的“策略即代码”模式，而非学习循环本身。 端到端 VLA 策略在故障下会性能下降而非直接失效：在同一中等水平上，综合八个模型的结果来看，当场景相机移动时，其成功率从 93% 降至 45%，而在相机与机械臂的校准错误情况下则降至 75%（Cui et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Without the instruction, reach depends on the donor library and on the model. In self-exploration each lineage starts from a library evolved on an earlier family (its donor). The robosuite, LIBERO, and LIBERO-PRO donors are successive snapshots of one library, and the LIBERO-RIG donor branches from it. On RoboLab, a simulator none of them saw, Opus lineages seeded from the four donors reach 30.1, 23.6, 32.3, and 36.9% once the instruction is disclosed; apart from the robosuite snapshot, more experience in the donor gives more reach, a tendency rather than a rule at three replicates. For Kimi-k3 and GPT-5.6-sol the LIBERO-PRO donor is the best of the four and the LIBERO-RIG donor among the worst ( Table 14 ), so what a course adds to a library depends on the model that inherits it.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有指令，智能体的可达性取决于捐赠者库和模型。 在自我探索中，每个谱系都始于一个在早期家族（其捐赠者）上演化而来的库。 Robosuite、LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 捐赠者是同一库的连续快照，而 LIBERO-RIG 捐赠者则从中分支出来。 在 RoboLab 上——一个它们从未见过的模拟器中，一旦指令被披露，由四个捐赠者初始化的 Opus 谱系的可达性分别为 30.1%、23.6%、32.3% 和 36.9%；除了 Robosuite 快照外，捐赠者中的更多经验会带来更高的可达性，但在三次重复实验中，这更倾向于一种趋势而非绝对规律。 对于 Kimi-k3 和 GPT-5.6-sol，LIBERO-PRO 捐赠者在四个中表现最佳，而 LIBERO-RIG 捐赠者则属于最差之列（表 14），因此一个课程能为库增添什么，取决于继承该库的模型。

paragraphs.en: Teacher and student. Figure 9 a pairs each task’s VLA Lineage TEST score with the TEST score of the per-task code teacher whose rollouts it trained on (robosuite is omitted because its teachers have validation scores only). The student scores above its teacher on 15 of 305 tasks (2 LIBERO, 9 LIBERO-PRO, 4 RoboLab). Of the 11 tasks whose teacher solves no TEST state (3 LIBERO-PRO, 8 RoboLab), the student succeeds on some states of 2, both LIBERO-PRO. The agent can modify a teacher to collect the data it needs, but in these runs that rarely lifts a task the teacher cannot do at all.
paragraphs.zh: 教师与学生。 图9将每个任务的VLA Lineage TEST得分与该任务代码教师的TEST得分进行配对，后者是智能体在训练时所使用的教师（robosuite被省略，因为其教师仅具有验证得分）。 在305个任务中，该学生在15个任务上的得分高于其教师（2个LIBERO、9个LIBERO-PRO、4个RoboLab）。 在11个教师无法解决任何TEST状态的任务中（3个LIBERO-PRO、8个RoboLab），该学生在其中2个任务的某些状态下取得了成功，这两个任务均为LIBERO-PRO。 智能体可以修改教师以收集所需的数据，但在这些运行中，它很少能完成教师完全无法执行的任务。

sents.zh: 在305个任务中，该学生在15个任务上的得分高于其教师（2个LIBERO、9个LIBERO-PRO、4个RoboLab）。

sents.en: Of the 11 tasks whose teacher solves no TEST state (3 LIBERO-PRO, 8 RoboLab), the student succeeds on some states of 2, both LIBERO-PRO.
sents.zh: 在11个教师无法解决任何TEST状态的任务中（3个LIBERO-PRO、8个RoboLab），该学生在其中2个任务的某些状态下取得了成功，这两个任务均为LIBERO-PRO。

sents.en: The agent can modify a teacher to collect the data it needs, but in these runs that rarely lifts a task the teacher cannot do at all.
sents.zh: 智能体可以修改教师以收集所需的数据，但在这些运行中，它很少能完成教师完全无法执行的任务。

paragraphs.en: What the two libraries keep. A code library holds executable control skills, 306 to 322 per RoboLab lineage, of which a final program imports a median of five. A VLA library holds the research process: collection and training scripts and a memory of what went wrong, with no checkpoints or data. That is enough to spare a lineage from rediscovering the label format: nine of twelve Vanilla sessions checked it by open-loop replay, against two of twelve Lineage sessions. Inheriting the research process pays only where the task is hard: a VLA lineage ties the no-library VLA on LIBERO (94.0 each), trails it on LIBERO-PRO (90.6 against 92.4), and leads it on RoboLab (47.2 against 43.1; Table 16 ), each from one run. Extra development time pays through data: on RoboLab, sessions that spent their second half collecting more data gained about four times as much as sessions that retrained on the same data ( Table 26 ); tasks that require two or more placements score about half as well as one-placement tasks, while instructions that require reasoning about attributes or counts cost nothing detectable ( Table 27 ). One session found that the harness’s velocity labels, differenced from teacher commands, replayed to 4.37 rad of arm travel where the teacher had produced 14.80, an error the training loss did not show.
paragraphs.zh: 两个库所保留的内容。 代码库包含可执行的控制技能，每个 RoboLab 谱系有 306 至 322 项，最终程序平均导入其中五项。 VLA 库包含研究过程：数据收集与训练脚本，以及记录错误内容的记忆，但不含检查点或数据。 这足以让一个谱系免于重新发现标签格式：在十二个 Vanilla 会话中，有九个通过开环重播进行了验证，而十二个 Lineage 会话中仅有两个如此。 继承研究过程仅在任务困难时才有优势：VLA 谱系在与无库 VLA 的对比中，在 LIBERO 上表现一致（均为 94.0），但在 LIBERO-PRO 上稍逊一筹（90.6 对 92.4），而在 RoboLab 上则更胜一筹（47.2 对 43.1；表 16），以上结果均基于单次运行。 额外的开发时间通过数据带来了回报：在 RoboLab 中，将后半段时间用于收集更多数据的会话所获得的成绩，比在相同数据上重新训练的会话高出约四倍（表 26）；需要两次或以上放置的任务成绩约为仅需一次放置任务的一半，而需要推理属性或计数的指令则未表现出任何可检测的性能损失（表 27）。 一个会话发现，与教师指令相比，夹具的速度标签在重播时仅使机械臂移动了 4.37 弧度，而教师指令原本应产生 14.80 弧度的移动，这一误差并未反映在训练损失中。
