paragraphs.en: Eight rules for anyone building a self-evolving robot agent, each from a finding of this study:
paragraphs.zh: 为任何正在构建自我进化机器人智能体的研究者提出的八条规则，每一条都源于本研究的一项发现：

paragraphs.en: Qualify the base model on the hardest family first; a model below a minimum level of capability writes almost nothing worth saving, so its own library cannot help it ( Section 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 首先对基础模型在最具挑战性的语族上进行评估；如果模型的能力低于最低水平，它几乎写不出任何值得保留的内容，因此其自身的语料库也无法提供帮助（第 5.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Spend on grounded perception tools rather than on a multimodal model, and give image access for diagnosis ( Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将资金用于基于实际感知的工具，而非多模态模型，并为诊断提供图像访问权限（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Measure a model’s time to first success on a pilot and make sessions at least that long; beyond that, scale with parallel long runs. Report TEST, not VAL, scores ( Section 3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 测量模型在试点任务中的首次成功时间，并将会话时长至少设为该值；在此之上，通过并行长运行进行扩展。 报告测试（TEST）分数，而非验证（VAL）分数（第 3.1 节）。

sents.en: Measure a model’s time to first success on a pilot and make sessions at least that long; beyond that, scale with parallel long runs.
sents.zh: 测量模型在试点任务中的首次成功时间，并将会话时长至少设为该值；在此之上，通过并行长运行进行扩展。

sents.en: Report TEST, not VAL, scores ( Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 报告测试（TEST）分数，而非验证（VAL）分数（第 3.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Seed hard deployments with a library built around control and grasp routines, and test a library from another model if a model’s own does not help ( Sections 3.2 and 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 使用围绕控制和抓取程序构建的库来初始化部署，如果某个模型自身的库没有帮助，则测试来自另一模型的库（第 3.2 节和第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Choose between code and weights by the kind of change you expect: code for faults the program can observe, and weights for camera motion and new instruction wording. When training weights, spend the budget on demonstrations first ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 根据你预期的变化类型在代码和权重之间做出选择：如果程序能够观察到故障，则选择代码；如果是摄像头运动和新的指令措辞，则选择权重。 在训练权重时，应优先将预算用于演示（第 4.3 节）。

sents.en: Choose between code and weights by the kind of change you expect: code for faults the program can observe, and weights for camera motion and new instruction wording.
sents.zh: 根据你预期的变化类型在代码和权重之间做出选择：如果程序能够观察到故障，则选择代码；如果是摄像头运动和新的指令措辞，则选择权重。

sents.en: When training weights, spend the budget on demonstrations first ( Section 4.3 ).
sents.zh: 在训练权重时，应优先将预算用于演示（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Never let a checker the agent wrote itself decide when practice stops unless an independent check confirms it, and record where each memory came from so it can be re-validated ( Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 除非经过独立检查的确认，否则切勿让智能体自行编写的检查程序决定练习何时停止，并记录每个记忆的来源，以便能够重新验证（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Set up the start state of each evaluation independently of the agent’s own resets, and do not end practice because of a success streak on scenes the agent reset itself ( Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为每次评估设置初始状态时，应独立于智能体自身的重置操作，并且不要因为智能体在自行重置的场景中取得连续成功而终止练习（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Keep re-observation in the loop where things go wrong, and schedule re-tests of rules written after a single incident ( Sections 5.3 and 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在事情出错时，持续将重新观察纳入循环，并为单个事件之后编写的规则安排重新测试（第 5.3 节和第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Three runs per condition bound what we can distinguish, and replicate spread often exceeds the gap between neighboring models. The budget-matched VLA runs on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab are one run each, and every physical result is one practice run per agent. Agent-as-policy uses five staged scenes per task, has no Opus run, and uses a different stopping rule for Block Stacking. The physical runs start from an empty library, so we measure learning on hardware, not transfer from simulation to hardware. Each model runs through its own coding tool, so a model comparison is a comparison of model-and-tool pairs. Budgets are matched in wall-clock time, not compute. The sealed judge protects runtime state, but it does not hide everything an agent can read ( Section A.9 ). A zero score in three runs does not show that a model can never solve a task, only that it did not within the budget. Finally, model rankings change when the agent is not given the task instruction: in self-exploration Kimi-k3 matches or beats Opus on five of seven settings ( Table 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个条件下的三次运行限制了我们能够区分的能力，而重复扩散的程度常常超过了相邻模型之间的差距。 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上运行的预算匹配的 VLA 各有一次运行，且每个物理结果都对应智能体的单次练习运行。 “智能体即策略”方法在每个任务中使用五个分阶段场景，没有 Opus 运行，并且在“积木堆叠”任务中使用了不同的停止规则。 物理运行从一个空的库开始，因此我们衡量的是硬件上的学习能力，而非从模拟到硬件的迁移能力。 每个模型都通过其自身的编码工具运行，因此模型比较实际上是模型与工具组合的比较。 预算是根据实际运行时间进行匹配的，而非计算资源。 密封的评判器会保护运行时状态，但它并不会隐藏智能体能够读取的所有信息（第 A.9 节）。 三次运行中获得零分并不意味着模型永远无法解决某个任务，而仅表示它未能在预算内完成。 最后，当智能体未被提供任务说明时，模型排名会发生变化：在自我探索中，Kimi-k3 在七种设置中有五种与 Opus 表现相当或更优（表 14）。

sents.zh: 每个条件下的三次运行限制了我们能够区分的能力，而重复扩散的程度常常超过了相邻模型之间的差距。

sents.en: The budget-matched VLA runs on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab are one run each, and every physical result is one practice run per agent.
sents.zh: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上运行的预算匹配的 VLA 各有一次运行，且每个物理结果都对应智能体的单次练习运行。

sents.zh: “智能体即策略”方法在每个任务中使用五个分阶段场景，没有 Opus 运行，并且在“积木堆叠”任务中使用了不同的停止规则。

sents.zh: 密封的评判器会保护运行时状态，但它并不会隐藏智能体能够读取的所有信息（第 A.9 节）。

sents.en: Finally, model rankings change when the agent is not given the task instruction: in self-exploration Kimi-k3 matches or beats Opus on five of seven settings ( Table 14 ).
sents.zh: 最后，当智能体未被提供任务说明时，模型排名会发生变化：在自我探索中，Kimi-k3 在七种设置中有五种与 Opus 表现相当或更优（表 14）。

paragraphs.en: The seal is not absolute ( Appendix C ), and agents found and used its openings without being asked, as reasoning models do when an evaluation leaves one ( Bondarenko et al., 2025 ) . The most common was reading static asset files: Opus parsed the object XML in 115 of 179 LIBERO runs and 552 of 1,015 LIBERO-PRO runs, and the scene USD in 1,533 of 1,743 RoboLab runs; Kimi-k3 read object XML in 284 of 1,260 non-RoboLab runs. This was allowed, and it helped, but a physical robot cannot read an object’s geometry before acting. Policies can also call the environment’s success check, env.check_success() , which we leave callable as a stop signal; it returns only whether the task is done, and the judge grades with its own copy. How often a policy stops or branches on it depends on the model: 47% of GPT-5.6-sol’s graded RoboLab policies against 5% of Opus’s.
paragraphs.zh: 这种密封并非绝对（附录 C），智能体无需被要求便自行发现并利用其开口，正如推理模型在评估中遇到此类情况时所做的那样（Bondarenko 等，2025）。 最常见的做法是读取静态资产文件：Opus 在 179 次 LIBERO 运行中解析了 115 次的对象 XML，在 1,015 次 LIBERO-PRO 运行中解析了 552 次，并在 1,743 次 RoboLab 运行中解析了 1,533 次的场景 USD；Kimi-k3 则在 1,260 次非 RoboLab 运行中读取了 284 次的对象 XML。 这种做法是允许的，并且确实有所帮助，但物理机器人无法在行动前读取物体的几何结构。 策略还可以调用环境的成功检查函数 env.check_success()，我们保留其可调用性以用作停止信号；该函数仅返回任务是否完成，而评分者则使用其自身的副本进行评分。 策略基于此停止或分支的频率取决于模型：GPT-5.6-sol 的 RoboLab 策略中有 47% 会这样做，而 Opus 的策略中仅有 5% 会如此。

sents.zh: 这种密封并非绝对（附录 C），智能体无需被要求便自行发现并利用其开口，正如推理模型在评估中遇到此类情况时所做的那样（Bondarenko 等，2025）。

sents.zh: 最常见的做法是读取静态资产文件：Opus 在 179 次 LIBERO 运行中解析了 115 次的对象 XML，在 1,015 次 LIBERO-PRO 运行中解析了 552 次，并在 1,743 次 RoboLab 运行中解析了 1,533 次的场景 USD；Kimi-k3 则在 1,260 次非 RoboLab 运行中读取了 284 次的对象 XML。

sents.zh: 这种做法是允许的，并且确实有所帮助，但物理机器人无法在行动前读取物体的几何结构。

sents.en: Policies can also call the environment’s success check, env.check_success() , which we leave callable as a stop signal; it returns only whether the task is done, and the judge grades with its own copy.
sents.zh: 策略还可以调用环境的成功检查函数 env.check_success()，我们保留其可调用性以用作停止信号；该函数仅返回任务是否完成，而评分者则使用其自身的副本进行评分。

sents.en: How often a policy stops or branches on it depends on the model: 47% of GPT-5.6-sol’s graded RoboLab policies against 5% of Opus’s.
sents.zh: 策略基于此停止或分支的频率取决于模型：GPT-5.6-sol 的 RoboLab 策略中有 47% 会这样做，而 Opus 的策略中仅有 5% 会如此。

paragraphs.en: Task text also leaks. LIBERO encodes each instruction in the task file’s name, its language block, and its goal predicate, so a sealed condition must strip all three. When we audited the libraries meant to seed our task-blind lineages, the post-LIBERO Opus library already quoted a hidden instruction word for word, in a memory recording “Turn on the stove”, and the post-LIBERO-PRO library matched 10 of 40 LIBERO and 27 of 160 LIBERO-PRO instructions, so we could not use it. The harness now refuses exploration sessions that touch held-out task identifiers and rewrites prompts that contain hidden material. In one pilot we dropped, we also tried to hide the success check: the patch covered only our wrapper, and Opus and GPT-5.6-sol found env.env.check_success() within a single session. A seal has to be tested by trying to break it, not by checking that the patch applied.
paragraphs.zh: 任务文本也会泄露。 LIBERO 将每个指令编码到任务文件的名称、其语言块及其目标谓词中，因此密封条件必须剥离这三个部分。 当我们审计用于初始化我们任务盲谱系的库时，后 LIBERO 的 Opus 库已经逐字引用了一个隐藏指令：“打开炉灶”，而记忆记录中显示如此；后 LIBERO-PRO 库则匹配了 40 个 LIBERO 指令中的 10 个和 160 个 LIBERO-PRO 指令中的 27 个，因此我们无法使用它。 该框架现在会拒绝涉及预留任务标识符的探索会话，并改写包含隐藏内容的提示。 在我们放弃的一个试点中，我们还试图隐藏成功检查：补丁仅覆盖我们的包装层，而 Opus 和 GPT-5.6-sol 在单次会话内就找到了 env.env.check_success()。 必须通过尝试破坏密封来测试它，而不是仅仅检查补丁是否已应用。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 records what each system’s own paper or announcement reports; “partial” marks a feature that appears in a limited form. CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) : multi-turn program generation with execution feedback and an RL-trained coder (CaP-RL); simulation (robosuite, LIBERO-PRO, BEHAVIOR) and real robots; a task-agnostic skill library built from pooled rollouts and evaluated on the same tasks; a skill-library ablation without matched restarts; transfer to perturbations and from simulation to a real arm. ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) : the agent edits training code for learned policies (and can synthesize code policies) on a fleet of real bimanual stations, with simulation in Gym-PushT and RoboCasa; cross-task transfer appears through a written summary in one case; fixed test seeds and protected metrics in some settings, but agent-built verifiers. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) : code-as-policy with a growing skill library inherited by later tasks; an empty-library ablation but no budget-matched restarts; split debug, validation, and evaluation seeds with simulator ground-truth APIs forbidden; perturbations and unseen long-horizon tasks, with a limited real-robot study. RATs ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) : code-as-policy agents build a library through play and reuse it on downstream tasks; a no-play ablation and a compute-matched baseline but no independent restarts; held-out tasks, perturbations, a held-out simulator, and a preliminary real study. Waddle ( Waddle Labs, 2026 ) : agents control real arms by viewing cameras, writing code, and re-planning live, share a skill library, and in one case train an ACT policy; the announcement reports no controls or held-out evaluation. The rows of Table 11 come from each paper’s full text. Kuroki & Tang ( Kuroki & Tang, 2026 ) : a coding agent optimizes frozen programs for RoboCasa tasks and reuses an archive of four of them on nine new tasks; a no-archive comparison runs under shared session limits but unequal total compute; held-out test states, though the policies read ground-truth simulator segmentation. Harness evolution ( Wei et al., 2026 ) : an optimizer agent evolves the harness of a task agent that acts through a 3-D interface; selection-rule ablations but no restart or no-library control; held-out LIBERO tasks, while the RoboCasa campaign has no held-out set.
paragraphs.zh: 表1记录了每个系统自身的论文或公告中所报告的内容；“部分”表示某一功能仅以有限形式出现。 CaP-X（Fu et al., 2026）：多轮程序生成，结合执行反馈和通过强化学习训练的编码器（CaP-RL）；模拟环境（robosuite、LIBERO-PRO、BEHAVIOR）与真实机器人；基于汇总的多次运行结果构建的、不依赖具体任务的技能库，并在相同任务上进行评估；未匹配重启的对照实验；向扰动场景的迁移，以及从模拟到真实机械臂的迁移。 ENPIRE（Xiao et al., 2026）：智能体在真实的双手操作工作站集群上编辑用于学习策略的训练代码（并能合成代码策略），模拟环境包括 Gym-PushT 和 RoboCasa；在一例中通过书面摘要体现了跨任务迁移能力；部分设置中使用了固定的测试种子和保护性指标，但采用了由智能体构建的验证器。 ASPIRE（Lu et al., 2026）：以代码作为策略，并具备一个随任务推进而不断扩展的技能库，后续任务可继承该技能库；进行了空技能库对照实验，但未设置预算匹配的重启对照；将调试、验证和评估的种子数据分开处理，且禁止使用模拟器的真实值 API；测试了扰动场景和未见过的长期任务，但真实机器人研究规模有限。 RATs（Zhang et al., 2026a）：以代码作为策略的智能体通过交互构建技能库，并在下游任务中重复利用该库；进行了无交互对照实验和计算资源匹配的基线对比，但未设置独立的重启对照；测试了预留的任务、扰动场景和预留的模拟器环境，并开展了初步的真实机器人研究。 Waddle（Waddle Labs, 2026）：智能体通过摄像头观察、编写代码和实时重新规划来控制真实机械臂，共享技能库，并在一例中训练了 ACT 策略；公告未报告任何控制机制或预留的评估数据。 表11中的各行信息均源自各篇论文的全部内容。 Kuroki & Tang（Kuroki & Tang, 2026）：一个编码智能体为 RoboCasa 任务优化固定的程序，并在九个新任务中重复利用其中四个程序的存档；无存档对照实验在共享会话限制下运行，但总计算资源并不相等；测试了预留的测试状态，尽管策略读取的是模拟器的真实值分割结果。 Harness evolution（Wei et al., 2026）：一个优化智能体通过三维界面演化任务智能体的执行框架；进行了选择规则对照实验，但未设置重启对照或无技能库对照；测试了预留的 LIBERO 任务，而 RoboCasa 任务集未设置预留评估集。

paragraphs.en: SimEX ( Hu et al., 2026a ) : per-task programs over a persistent toolbox built within one task family; evaluation in a different simulator and on a real two-arm robot, after five scored adaptation rollouts in the evaluation environment. RPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) : an offline coding model revises a shared skill library and system prompt that a runtime agent uses; held-out seeds, but improvement uses the same success check and privileged simulator state; its rounds are not budget-matched. Robo-COP ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) : an orchestrator writes per-episode programs that call a VLA and fine-tunes that VLA, per task; held-out initial states of the same tasks. Embodied Turing Machines ( Hu et al., 2026b ) : coding agents grow one shared library and frozen per-task programs on RoboDojo; held-out test layouts, with simulator ground truth used during development. RoboRSI ( Wen et al., 2026 ) : agents repair a shared skill hierarchy and compose it at run time; most results improve on the evaluation tasks themselves, and only LIBERO-Plus uses a frozen held-out evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: SimEX（Hu 等人，2026a）：针对单个任务族内持久工具箱的每个任务编写程序；在评估环境中进行五次评分适应性运行后，在不同模拟器及真实双臂机器人上进行评估。 RPG（Wang 等人，2026）：一种离线编码模型，用于修订运行时智能体使用的共享技能库和系统提示；保留了预留的种子数据，但改进过程使用了相同的成功检查机制和特权模拟器状态；其运行轮次未进行预算匹配。 Robo-COP（Zhang 等人，2026b）：一个协调器为每个任务编写每集程序，调用 VLA 并针对该任务对 VLA 进行微调；保留了相同任务的初始状态作为预留测试数据。 具身图灵机（Hu 等人，2026b）：编码智能体在 RoboDojo 上扩展一个共享库，并生成固定的每个任务程序；保留了预留的测试布局，开发过程中使用了模拟器的真实数据作为基准。 RoboRSI（Wen 等人，2026）：智能体修复共享技能层级结构并在运行时进行组合；多数结果在评估任务本身上的表现有所提升，且仅 LIBERO-Plus 使用了预留的固定评估数据。

paragraphs.en: The seal is not absolute, and we report its limits beside each result. Work environments have internet access, so public LIBERO initial states remain obtainable even though we remove them from the work image. RoboLab’s validation feedback describes the VAL layouts, so an agent could use it to reconstruct them. Static task assets and task files are readable, and the success predicate is callable as a stop signal; Section A.9 reports what agents did with each. Audits found no reconstruction of test layouts in the inspected logs, but cannot establish that it was impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 这种密封并非绝对，我们会在每个结果旁报告其限制。 工作环境具备互联网访问权限，因此即使我们从工作图像中移除了它们，公开的 LIBERO 初始状态仍然可以获取。 RoboLab 的验证反馈描述了 VAL 布局，因此智能体可以利用它来重建这些布局。 静态任务资产和任务文件是可读取的，并且成功谓词可以作为停止信号调用；第 A.9 节报告了智能体对每个文件的操作。 审计未在检查的日志中发现测试布局的重建痕迹，但无法确定这是否绝对不可能发生。

paragraphs.en: Budgets. A CaP session lasts one hour per robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, or LIBERO-RIG task and two hours per RoboLab task, with up to eight agent-initiated submissions plus periodic host grades. AR receives the same total development time as CaP on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab, spent as one session per suite; robosuite’s AR budget differs and is given in Appendix E with the submission and early-stopping rules. Matching wall clock does not match compute, so we record environment steps, rollouts, submissions, API and token spend, and GPU time separately.
paragraphs.zh: 预算。 每个 CaP 会话的时长为：每个 robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 或 LIBERO-RIG 任务一小时，每个 RoboLab 任务两小时；最多允许八次由智能体发起的提交，外加定期的主持人评分。 AR 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上获得的总开发时间与 CaP 相同，且按每个套件一次会话进行分配；robosuite 的 AR 预算有所不同，具体细节及提交与提前终止规则见附录 E。 实际运行时间并不等同于计算量，因此我们分别记录环境步数、执行次数、提交次数、API 和令牌消耗量以及 GPU 使用时长。

paragraphs.en: Repetitions. Every repeated campaign reports its count. Three repetitions of a Lineage develop three independent libraries; three repetitions of Vanilla develop three independent policies. Means and sample standard deviations are over repetitions, never over evaluation episodes. Where a campaign has one trial (the budget-matched VLA analyses on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab; every physical lineage), we say so beside the result.
paragraphs.zh: 重复试验。 每次重复的试验都会报告其次数。 Lineage 的三次重复会生成三个独立的库；Vanilla 的三次重复会生成三个独立的策略。 均值和样本标准差均基于重复试验计算，而非评估回合。 如果某个试验仅有一次尝试（例如 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboLab 上预算匹配的 VLA 分析，以及每个物理谱系），我们会在结果旁明确说明。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 is a short reference for terms used in a specific sense; the text gives the authoritative definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 是一份关于特定含义术语的简要参考；正文中给出了权威定义。

paragraphs.en: For LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, DEV uses initial states 0–29, VAL uses states 30–39, and TEST uses states 40–49. Work images remove the VAL and TEST initial states. RoboLab uses separate cached files containing 30 DEV, 10 VAL, and 10 TEST layouts; only the DEV layouts are supplied to the work environment. For robosuite, development permits agent-chosen seeds, VAL uses documented public seeds, and TEST seeds are derived from a judge-side private salt. For RoboLab, the salt permutes the cached TEST layouts rather than generating their contents.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO，DEV 使用初始状态 0–29，VAL 使用状态 30–39，TEST 使用状态 40–49。 工作图像移除了 VAL 和 TEST 的初始状态。 RoboLab 使用独立的缓存文件，其中包含 30 个 DEV、10 个 VAL 和 10 个 TEST 布局；只有 DEV 布局会被提供给工作环境。 对于 robosuite，开发阶段允许智能体自行选择种子，VAL 使用已公开的文档种子，而 TEST 的种子则来自裁判端的一个私有盐值。 对于 RoboLab，该盐值会打乱缓存的 TEST 布局，而不是生成其内容。

paragraphs.en: Per-task budgets. Robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and LIBERO-RIG tasks receive a one-hour development budget, while RoboLab tasks receive two hours to accommodate longer simulation times. Each run permits up to eight agent-initiated submissions. Additional host-side evaluations run periodically, provide feedback, and are eligible for policy selection without consuming the manual submission allowance. Runs may terminate early upon perfect VAL success or exhaustion of the submission allowance.
paragraphs.zh: 每项任务的预算。 Robosuite、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 LIBERO-RIG 任务获得一小时的开发预算，而 RoboLab 任务则获得两小时，以适应更长的模拟时间。 每次运行允许最多八次由智能体发起的提交。 主机端会定期执行额外的评估，提供反馈，并且这些评估有资格用于策略选择，而不会占用手动提交的配额。 如果 VAL 测试完全成功或提交配额用尽，运行可能会提前终止。

TEST is a disjoint band used only after selection and never guides policy development or library harvesting.

paragraphs.en: The first term estimates the benefit of inherited state under matched current-task resources; the experience used to construct the library remains part of the lineage’s history. The second compares sustained iteration with independent shorter attempts. Both kinds of run can revise policies within a session, so this is a comparison of budget allocation rather than a control with all learning disabled. The LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and LIBERO-RIG best-of-3 attempts are told their 20-minute limit, which makes them submit earlier and more often than an untold attempt, while the robosuite and RoboLab attempts and the Lineage and Vanilla sessions are not told their budget. paragraphs.en: Selecting by validation overstates the winner for a model that submits often. Best-of-3 keeps the attempt with the highest validation score, and that attempt is often the one that overfit the validation states. GPT-5.6-sol submits about twice as often as any other model, and its RoboLab winners lose 6.6 points from validation to test; Opus’s lose none, and the other three lose 2 points or less. Even after this loss, GPT-5.6-sol still scores higher with best-of-3 than with one session.
paragraphs.zh: 对于频繁提交模型而言，通过验证来选择会高估获胜者。 “三局两胜制”会保留验证得分最高的尝试，而该尝试通常正是对验证状态过拟合的那一次。 GPT-5.6-sol 的提交频率约为其他任何模型的两倍，其 RoboLab 获胜者在测试中的得分比验证时低 6.6 分；Opus 的则没有损失，另外三个模型的损失在 2 分或更少。 即使存在这种损失，GPT-5.6-sol 在“三局两胜制”下的得分仍然高于单轮会话。

paragraphs.en: With three times the budget, resampling full-length runs pays for every model. Full-length runs vary a lot. The best of three full-budget Vanilla repetitions, which costs three times the budget, scores 17 points above a single repetition on RoboLab (15 when chosen by validation score) and 5 on robosuite. So when compute allows, run several full-length sessions in parallel rather than splitting one budget into short ones. At a fixed budget, whether to split depends on the model’s time to first success.
paragraphs.zh: 预算增加三倍后，对完整运行进行重采样能为每个模型带来回报。 完整运行的结果差异很大。 在三个全预算的 Vanilla 重复实验中表现最佳的一次，其成本是原始预算的三倍，在 RoboLab 上的得分比单次重复实验高出 17 分（若根据验证分数选择则为 15 分），在 robosuite 上则高出 5 分。 因此，当计算资源允许时，应并行运行多个完整长度的会话，而不是将单一预算拆分成多个短会话。 在预算固定的情况下，是否拆分预算取决于模型首次成功所需的时间。

paragraphs.en: The toolbox combines pretrained perception models with deterministic geometry and control. SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) provides text-prompted instance segmentation, returning masks, bounding boxes, and confidence scores. A vision-language model tool answers agent-defined questions about one or more images, optionally in a specified JSON format. It is instructed to describe visible properties (object identity, text, orientation, spatial relations) and to express uncertainty when observations are ambiguous. Its role is restricted to perception; task planning and action selection remain with the agent or generated policy. These perceptual estimates are separate from the external evaluator’s judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具箱将预训练的感知模型与确定性几何学和控制方法相结合。 SAM3（Carion 等人，2026）提供基于文本提示的实例分割功能，返回掩码、边界框和置信度分数。 一种视觉语言模型工具能够回答智能体针对一张或多张图像提出的问题，并可选择以指定的 JSON 格式输出结果。 该工具被要求描述可见的属性（物体身份、文本、方向、空间关系），并在观察结果存在歧义时表达不确定性。 其作用仅限于感知；任务规划和动作选择仍由智能体或生成的策略负责。 这些感知估计值与外部评估者的判断相互独立。

sents.en: The toolbox combines pretrained perception models with deterministic geometry and control.
sents.zh: 该工具箱将预训练的感知模型与确定性几何学和控制方法相结合。

sents.en: SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) provides text-prompted instance segmentation, returning masks, bounding boxes, and confidence scores.
sents.zh: SAM3（Carion 等人，2026）提供基于文本提示的实例分割功能，返回掩码、边界框和置信度分数。

sents.en: A vision-language model tool answers agent-defined questions about one or more images, optionally in a specified JSON format.
sents.zh: 一种视觉语言模型工具能够回答智能体针对一张或多张图像提出的问题，并可选择以指定的 JSON 格式输出结果。

sents.en: It is instructed to describe visible properties (object identity, text, orientation, spatial relations) and to express uncertainty when observations are ambiguous.
sents.zh: 该工具被要求描述可见的属性（物体身份、文本、方向、空间关系），并在观察结果存在歧义时表达不确定性。

sents.en: Its role is restricted to perception; task planning and action selection remain with the agent or generated policy.
sents.zh: 其作用仅限于感知；任务规划和动作选择仍由智能体或生成的策略负责。

sents.en: These perceptual estimates are separate from the external evaluator’s judgments.
sents.zh: 这些感知估计值与外部评估者的判断相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Geometry tools map image observations into robot coordinates using calibrated projection, ray–plane intersection, and valid depth measurements. They support plane fitting, object localization, footprint and orientation estimation, and rectified top-down views. Per-camera metadata identifies whether depth is available and metrically valid. Geometry tools remain available throughout a run, while learned model tools are enabled according to the run configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 几何工具通过校准投影、射线-平面交点和有效的深度测量，将图像观测结果映射到机器人坐标系中。 它们支持平面拟合、物体定位、足迹和方向估计，以及校正后的俯视视图。 每台相机的元数据会标识深度是否存在且具有度量有效性。 几何工具在整个运行过程中始终可用，而学习模型工具则根据运行配置启用。

sents.zh: 它们支持平面拟合、物体定位、足迹和方向估计，以及校正后的俯视视图。

sents.en: Per-camera metadata identifies whether depth is available and metrically valid.

sents.zh: 几何工具在整个运行过程中始终可用，而学习模型工具则根据运行配置启用。

paragraphs.en: Calibrated inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces support Cartesian motion, gripper control, and coordinated arm movement subject to workspace, joint-rate, and inter-arm separation constraints. Agents may query the motion planner without executing a command and replay recorded images to develop perception routines between physical attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 经过校准的反向运动学和伺服接口支持笛卡尔运动、夹具控制以及受工作空间、关节速率和双臂间距约束的协调臂部运动。 智能体可以在不执行命令的情况下查询运动规划器，并回放已记录的画面，以便在物理尝试之间建立感知流程。

sents.en: Calibrated inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces support Cartesian motion, gripper control, and coordinated arm movement subject to workspace, joint-rate, and inter-arm separation constraints.
sents.zh: 经过校准的反向运动学和伺服接口支持笛卡尔运动、夹具控制以及受工作空间、关节速率和双臂间距约束的协调臂部运动。

sents.en: Agents may query the motion planner without executing a command and replay recorded images to develop perception routines between physical attempts.
sents.zh: 智能体可以在不执行命令的情况下查询运动规划器，并回放已记录的画面，以便在物理尝试之间建立感知流程。

paragraphs.en: The physical campaign comprises five tasks and evaluates three coding agents, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5 through Claude Code and GPT-6-astra through Codex, all at maximum reasoning effort, that revise executable policy bundles while keeping model weights fixed. Each lineage begins with an empty library, without a seed policy or simulation reference solution. Subsequent tasks inherit the preceding policy bundle and library. The library records reusable code, procedures, and textual memories together with their provenance. Code packages are harvested from successful executions supported by valid evidence, while procedures and memories may additionally retain lessons from failed attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 该物理性行动包含五个任务，并评估了三种编码智能体：通过 Claude Code 运行的 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5，以及通过 Codex 运行的 GPT-6-astra。所有智能体均以最大推理强度运行，在保持模型权重固定的同时修订可执行的政策包。 每个谱系都从一个空白的库开始，不包含初始政策或模拟参考解决方案。 后续任务会继承前一个任务的政策包和库。 该库记录了可重用的代码、程序以及文本记忆，并附带其来源信息。 代码包从有有效证据支持的成功执行中获取，而程序和记忆则可能额外保留失败尝试中的经验教训。

sents.en: The physical campaign comprises five tasks and evaluates three coding agents, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5 through Claude Code and GPT-6-astra through Codex, all at maximum reasoning effort, that revise executable policy bundles while keeping model weights fixed.
sents.zh: 该物理性行动包含五个任务，并评估了三种编码智能体：通过 Claude Code 运行的 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5，以及通过 Codex 运行的 GPT-6-astra。所有智能体均以最大推理强度运行，在保持模型权重固定的同时修订可执行的政策包。

sents.zh: 每个谱系都从一个空白的库开始，不包含初始政策或模拟参考解决方案。

sents.en: Subsequent tasks inherit the preceding policy bundle and library.
sents.zh: 后续任务会继承前一个任务的政策包和库。

sents.zh: 该库记录了可重用的代码、程序以及文本记忆，并附带其来源信息。

sents.zh: 代码包从有有效证据支持的成功执行中获取，而程序和记忆则可能额外保留失败尝试中的经验教训。

paragraphs.en: Each task receives a 12-hour wall-clock budget covering policy revision and physical interaction. Compared agents share the task order (Banana into Bowl, Push-T, Cup Upright, Block Stacking, Spell SEAR), hardware interfaces, available tools, and evaluator configuration, and run on a frozen harness package whose file set is checked by checksum on every rig; a lineage may move between rigs from one task to the next. A task may terminate early after ten consecutive scored forward-task successes. Early termination additionally requires successful evidence from both arms, and reset attempts, diagnostic probes, and outcomes marked unknown or invalid are excluded from the early-stopping window. Block Stacking has no early stop: the tower persists between attempts, an attempt succeeds when the free-standing column ends taller than it started, and toppling the tower is a separate reset task.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都拥有 12 小时的实际运行时间预算，涵盖策略修订和物理交互。 对比智能体共享任务顺序（香蕉放入碗中、推 T、杯子直立、积木堆叠、拼写 SEAR）、硬件接口、可用工具以及评估器配置，并在一个冻结的框架包上运行；该框架包的文件集在每台设备上都会通过校验和进行核查，同一智能体序列可在不同设备间从一个任务切换到下一个任务。 如果连续十次得分正向任务成功，某个任务可能会提前终止。 提前终止还要求双臂均获得有效证据，而重置尝试、诊断探测以及标记为未知或无效的结果将被排除在提前停止窗口之外。 积木堆叠任务没有提前停止机制：塔楼在多次尝试之间保持原状，当独立立柱的最终高度高于初始高度时，该尝试即视为成功；而推倒塔楼则是一个单独的重置任务。

paragraphs.en: After the CaP campaign, each task’s policy bundle is frozen and evaluated on operator-staged scenes. The frozen evaluator scores each episode and the operator confirms or amends the verdict. Appendix I specifies episode counts, scoring rules, and which practice segments enter the totals. Every offline episode we checked ran on the rig on which its task was practiced.
paragraphs.zh: CaP 活动结束后，每个任务的策略包将被冻结，并在操作员搭建的场景中进行评估。 冻结的评估器会为每一集打分，操作员则会确认或修改该评分结果。 附录 I 规定了剧集数量、评分规则以及哪些练习环节会纳入总分计算。 我们检查过的每一集离线运行都是在其任务所对应的训练设备上执行的。

paragraphs.en: Tables 18 and 19 separate practice from evaluation. CaP evaluates frozen policy bundles; AaP keeps the LLM in the control loop. Each task inherits the preceding workspace and has a 12-hour practice budget. Bold times mark the streak: ten consecutive scored forward successes with both arms represented. Other entries show the budget, followed by forward successes/attempts. CaP counts scored forward attempts; AaP counts all recorded forward evaluations, including unresolved verdicts and requests closed at the budget limit. For Block Stacking, a practice attempt is one block placement, successful when the column ends taller than it started; there is no early stop.
paragraphs.zh: 表 18 和表 19 将练习与评估区分开来。 CaP 评估已冻结的策略包；AaP 则将 LLM 保留在控制回路中。 每个任务都会继承前一个工作区，并拥有 12 小时的练习预算。 加粗的时间标记了连续成功记录：使用两个操作臂均实现了十次连续得分的前向成功。 其他条目显示了预算，其后是前向成功次数/尝试次数。 CaP 统计得分的前向尝试次数；AaP 则统计所有记录的前向评估次数，包括未决判定和因达到预算限制而关闭的请求。 对于积木堆叠任务，一次练习尝试即放置一个积木；当该列最终高度高于初始高度时即为成功；此过程不会提前终止。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation scores in these tables are out of ten. Non-stacking scores are ten times the mean outcome (success: one; partial: one half; failure: zero). Block Stacking scores average the maximum cube count attained in each episode, capped at ten. The final row averages all five tasks before rounding. CaP uses ten scenes per non-stacking task and ten tower episodes per model. When a scene is restaged, only its final evaluation is counted. AaP uses five scenes or tower episodes per task.
paragraphs.zh: 这些表格中的评估分数以十分制计算。 非堆叠任务的分数是平均结果的十倍（成功：一分；部分成功：半分；失败：零分）。 方块堆叠任务的分数为每轮中达到的最大立方体数量平均值，上限为十分。 最后一行在四舍五入前对全部五个任务求平均值。 CaP 每个非堆叠任务使用十个场景，每个模型使用十个塔楼回合。 当一个场景被重新演绎时，仅计算其最终的评估结果。 AaP 每个任务使用五个场景或塔楼回合。

sents.zh: 这些表格中的评估分数以十分制计算。

paragraphs.en: Total attempts include forward attempts, resets, and probes. Unscored probes exclude probes submitted for a judge verdict, although those remain in total attempts. All totals use the reported lineage segments: when a task has multiple launches, the selected segment is the one inherited by the next task, or the latest launch for the final task. CaP hardware time sums those segments; AaP hardware time sums their launch-to-end durations, rounded to the nearest minute.
paragraphs.zh: 总尝试次数包括正向尝试、重置和探测。 未计分的探测不包括为裁判裁决而提交的探测，但这些探测仍计入总尝试次数。 所有总数均使用报告的路径段：当一项任务有多个启动时，所选的段是下一项任务继承的段，或是最终任务的最新启动。 CaP 硬件时间对这些段进行求和；AaP 硬件时间则对其从启动到结束的时间段求和，并四舍五入到最近的分钟。

paragraphs.en: The platform comprises two i2rt YAM Ultra manipulators, each with six revolute joints and a LINEAR_4310 parallel-jaw gripper. The arms are fixed side by side along one edge of the table, with approximately 0.51 m between their bases, and face a shared workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 该平台包含两台 i2rt YAM Ultra 机械臂，每台机械臂均有六个旋转关节和一个 LINEAR_4310 平行夹爪。 这两台机械臂沿桌子的一条边缘并排固定，其基座之间相距约 0.51 米，且朝向一个共享的工作空间。

sents.en: The platform comprises two i2rt YAM Ultra manipulators, each with six revolute joints and a LINEAR_4310 parallel-jaw gripper.
sents.zh: 该平台包含两台 i2rt YAM Ultra 机械臂，每台机械臂均有六个旋转关节和一个 LINEAR_4310 平行夹爪。

sents.en: The arms are fixed side by side along one edge of the table, with approximately 0.51 m between their bases, and face a shared workspace.
sents.zh: 这两台机械臂沿桌子的一条边缘并排固定，其基座之间相距约 0.51 米，且朝向一个共享的工作空间。

paragraphs.en: Three RealSense RGB-D cameras provide complementary views. A fixed D435 overview camera is mounted approximately midway between the arm bases, 0.86 m above the tabletop, and faces into the workspace. Its optical axis points approximately 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} away from vertically downward, equivalent to 70 ∘ 70^{\circ} below horizontal. A D405 is rigidly mounted on each wrist. In the local flange frame, each wrist camera is offset approximately 70 mm laterally from the flange axis and 70–76 mm along it, with its optical axis tilted inward by approximately 25 ∘ 25^{\circ} relative to the flange’s forward ( + z +z ) axis. Its orientation relative to the table therefore changes with the arm pose.

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the audit summarized in Section 4.4 . For every failed or partial evaluation unit we located, in the evaluation record and the frozen policy, the check that ended progress, and classified it by what stopped the robot: a physical impossibility; a refusal by the harness, namely its safety guard, motion planner, joint limits, or step budget; or a limit the agent wrote itself, such as a reach cap, tolerance, clearance margin, grasp restriction, disabled step, or stopping rule. A scene counts as physically possible when another agent, the same agent in the other mode, or the platform’s measured grasp reach shows that the motion can be done. The harness enforces joint limits, a workspace box per arm, a 0.25 m keep-out region around the other arm’s base, and a speed limit near the table. It does not model objects on the table, and its planner checks straight-line paths locally, so a refusal does not establish that a target is unreachable. Table 21 gives the counts. The units comprise Fable’s and Opus’s frozen-policy episodes, block-placement calls from GPT-6-astra’s frozen Block Stacking policy and its other frozen-policy episodes, and Fable’s live AaP episodes. Because block-placement calls and whole-task episodes are different units, the counts describe the audited failures rather than a common episode-level failure rate across models. Camera images were not part of this audit; statements about contact between objects rest on logged motion and stopping heights.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了第 4.4 节中概述的审计情况。 对于我们发现的每一个失败或部分失败的评估单元，我们在评估记录和冻结策略中确定了导致进程终止的检查项，并根据阻止机器人继续执行的原因对其进行了分类：物理上的不可能性；约束系统（即其安全保护、运动规划器、关节限制或步数预算）的拒绝；或智能体自行设定的限制，例如可达范围上限、容差、间隙余量、抓取限制、禁用步骤或停止规则。 当一个场景被另一个智能体、同一智能体在另一种模式下的操作，或平台测得的抓取可达范围证明可以完成相应动作时，该场景即被视为物理上可行的。 约束系统强制执行关节限制、每条机械臂的工作空间框、另一条机械臂基座周围 0.25 米的禁区，以及靠近桌面的速度限制。 它并未对桌上的物体进行建模，且其规划器仅局部检查直线路径，因此拒绝执行并不意味着目标不可达。 表 21 列出了具体数量。 这些评估单元包括 Fable 和 Opus 的冻结策略回合、GPT-6-astra 的冻结“积木堆叠”策略及其其他冻结策略回合中的积木放置调用，以及 Fable 的实时 AaP 回合。 由于积木放置调用和完整任务回合属于不同的评估单元，这些数量描述的是审计中发现的失败情况，而非跨模型统一的回合级失败率。 摄像头图像未包含在此次审计中；关于物体之间接触情况的陈述均基于记录的运动数据和停止高度。

sents.zh: 本附录详细说明了第 4.4 节中概述的审计情况。

sents.en: For every failed or partial evaluation unit we located, in the evaluation record and the frozen policy, the check that ended progress, and classified it by what stopped the robot: a physical impossibility; a refusal by the harness, namely its safety guard, motion planner, joint limits, or step budget; or a limit the agent wrote itself, such as a reach cap, tolerance, clearance margin, grasp restriction, disabled step, or stopping rule.
sents.zh: 对于我们发现的每一个失败或部分失败的评估单元，我们在评估记录和冻结策略中确定了导致进程终止的检查项，并根据阻止机器人继续执行的原因对其进行了分类：物理上的不可能性；约束系统（即其安全保护、运动规划器、关节限制或步数预算）的拒绝；或智能体自行设定的限制，例如可达范围上限、容差、间隙余量、抓取限制、禁用步骤或停止规则。

sents.en: A scene counts as physically possible when another agent, the same agent in the other mode, or the platform’s measured grasp reach shows that the motion can be done.
sents.zh: 当一个场景被另一个智能体、同一智能体在另一种模式下的操作，或平台测得的抓取可达范围证明可以完成相应动作时，该场景即被视为物理上可行的。

sents.en: The harness enforces joint limits, a workspace box per arm, a 0.25 m keep-out region around the other arm’s base, and a speed limit near the table.
sents.zh: 约束系统强制执行关节限制、每条机械臂的工作空间框、另一条机械臂基座周围 0.25 米的禁区，以及靠近桌面的速度限制。

sents.en: It does not model objects on the table, and its planner checks straight-line paths locally, so a refusal does not establish that a target is unreachable.
sents.zh: 它并未对桌上的物体进行建模，且其规划器仅局部检查直线路径，因此拒绝执行并不意味着目标不可达。

sents.en: Table 21 gives the counts.
sents.zh: 表 21 列出了具体数量。

sents.en: The units comprise Fable’s and Opus’s frozen-policy episodes, block-placement calls from GPT-6-astra’s frozen Block Stacking policy and its other frozen-policy episodes, and Fable’s live AaP episodes.
sents.zh: 这些评估单元包括 Fable 和 Opus 的冻结策略回合、GPT-6-astra 的冻结“积木堆叠”策略及其其他冻结策略回合中的积木放置调用，以及 Fable 的实时 AaP 回合。

sents.en: Because block-placement calls and whole-task episodes are different units, the counts describe the audited failures rather than a common episode-level failure rate across models.
sents.zh: 由于积木放置调用和完整任务回合属于不同的评估单元，这些数量描述的是审计中发现的失败情况，而非跨模型统一的回合级失败率。

sents.en: Camera images were not part of this audit; statements about contact between objects rest on logged motion and stopping heights.
sents.zh: 摄像头图像未包含在此次审计中；关于物体之间接触情况的陈述均基于记录的运动数据和停止高度。

paragraphs.en: Further audited cases ( Section 4.4 ). In Fable’s Spell SEAR run, a letter-straightening step turned a letter the wrong way on its only practice use; the agent disabled the step after that single attempt and left it disabled, and the frozen policy leaves a crooked letter in two evaluation scenes. Its code for clearing the middle of the table runs in 6 of 10 evaluation scenes but never ran during practice. Opus’s Block Stacking policy measured cubes at 37–39 mm but in its ninth hour fixed the size at 28–33 mm to match the judge’s nominal value, and it interprets normal arm tracking error as contact, raising release heights by 8–19 mm; only 1 of 11 cubes placed on a column remains there in the last six evaluation episodes, against 7 of 15 in the first four. GPT-6-astra’s Cup Upright policy lays the cup back down and stops after a refused turn with about two thirds of its steps unused, and Opus’s Push-T policy stops 80 to 170 ∘ 170^{\circ} from the goal with 8,000 to 11,000 of its 15,000 steps left. Most stops not attributable to the policy’s own rules were harness refusals of poses those policies selected.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步审核的案例（第 4.4 节）。 在 Fable 的 Spell SEAR 运行中，一个字母矫正步骤在其唯一一次实践使用中将一个字母翻转到了错误方向；该智能体在那次单次尝试后便禁用了此步骤，并一直保持禁用状态，而冻结的策略则在两个评估场景中留下了歪斜的字母。 其用于清理桌子中央的代码在 10 个评估场景中的 6 个中运行过，但在实践过程中从未运行。 Opus 的“堆叠方块”策略最初测量的立方体尺寸为 37–39 毫米，但在第九小时将其尺寸固定为 28–33 毫米以匹配裁判的名义值；该策略还将正常的臂部跟踪误差解释为接触，导致释放高度增加了 8–19 毫米。在最后六个评估回合中，仅有 11 个立方体中有一个能稳定放置在柱子上，而前四个回合中则有 15 个中的 7 个成功放置。 GPT-6-astra 的“杯子直立”策略在遭遇一次被拒绝的转向后会将杯子重新放平并停止运行，此时约三分之二的步骤尚未使用；Opus 的“推转”策略则会在距离目标 80 至 170°（170^{\circ}）处停止，而此时其 15,000 个步骤中仍有 8,000 至 11,000 步未使用。 大多数无法归因于策略自身规则的运行停止，都是由于智能体拒绝了这些策略所选定的姿势。

paragraphs.en: Banana into Bowl. No frozen failure dropped a banana, set it beside the bowl, or knocked the bowl; every full failure is a move refused or abandoned, and each policy tries its first plan once. Fable grasps with the gripper tilted by at most 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , so a banana 0.60 m out was refused although tilted grasps reach it. GPT-6-astra quits when both of its two camera poses are unavailable, having removed an earlier fallback within minutes of its first launch without any incident, and lifts or carries with a single wrist angle. In one scene the banana and bowl are 0.76 m apart and each arm reaches only one of them. No frozen policy passes the banana between arms; both live agents did, though with more motion steps than the frozen budget allows. Opus releases over the bowl center, 30 mm above the rim, wherever it holds the banana. It wrote this rule before its first robot attempt, and two bananas came to rest across the rim.
paragraphs.zh: 将香蕉放入碗中。 没有冻结的智能体掉落香蕉、将其置于碗旁或碰倒碗；每次完整的失败都意味着某个动作被拒绝或放弃，且每个策略都会尝试其首个计划一次。 Fable 的抓取器倾斜角度最多为 15°（15^{\circ}），因此尽管倾斜抓取可以够到，但距离为 0.60 米的香蕉仍被拒绝抓取。 当 GPT-6-astra 的两个摄像头姿态均不可用时，它会停止操作；它在首次启动后几分钟内便移除了早期的备用方案且未发生任何意外，并以单一腕部角度进行抬升或搬运。 在一个场景中，香蕉与碗相距 0.76 米，而每条机械臂仅能触及其中之一。 没有冻结的策略能在双臂之间传递香蕉；两个在线智能体都做到了，尽管所需的动作步数超过了冻结策略所允许的范围。 无论 Opus 持握香蕉的位置如何，它都会将其释放到碗中心上方 30 毫米处（高于碗沿）。 它在首次机器人尝试之前编写了这条规则，结果有两个香蕉最终停在了碗沿的另一侧。

paragraphs.en: Push-T. The staged scenes often require a large turn. Fable pushes up to 10.5 cm, turning the block 13 to 37 ∘ 37^{\circ} per push, and re-measures after every push. Opus shortened its pushes to 35 mm in its fourth hour, after pushes appeared to spin the block by 65 to 171 ∘ 171^{\circ} at a time when its model of the tool–block contact was wrong and some headings were misread. It corrected the model at hour 7.5 but never revisited the push length. Its left-arm pushes delivered a median 8% of the predicted turn against 64% for the right arm, and its two stopping rules, written for the final centimetres, fired 80 to 170 ∘ 170^{\circ} from the goal. The 16 ∘ 16^{\circ} cap on predicted turn per push in its code was never reached, because a 35 mm push cannot be predicted to turn the block by more than about 14 ∘ 14^{\circ} . GPT-6-astra rejected correct outline fits scoring 7.8 and 8.6 mm against a fixed 7 mm limit, unchanged since its first hour, and ended both attempts without touching the block. Elsewhere its finishing tolerance, tighter than the judge usually applies, sent it into extra pushes that worsened the pose, and each of its pushes costs about 835 motion steps because it lifts to a camera pose after every push.
paragraphs.zh: Push-T。 分阶段操作的场景通常需要较大的旋转角度。 Fable 每次推动最多可达 10.5 厘米，使物块每次旋转 13 至 37°，并在每次推动后重新测量。 Opus 在第四小时将每次推动缩短至 35 毫米，此前其推动似乎每次会使物块旋转 65 至 171°，而当时它对工具与物块接触点的模型存在错误，部分方向也被误读。 它在第 7.5 小时修正了该模型，但从未再次调整推动长度。 其左臂推动实现的平均旋转角度为预测值的 8%，而右臂为 64%；其两个专为最后几厘米设定的停止规则，在距离目标 80 至 170° 时触发。 其代码中设定的每次推动预测旋转角度上限为 16°，但从未达到，因为 35 毫米的推动无法预测会使物块旋转超过约 14°。 GPT-6-astra 拒绝了正确轮廓拟合结果（评分为 7.8 和 8.6 毫米），而固定限制为 7 毫米且自第一小时起未作更改；最终两次尝试均未接触物块。 在其他情况下，其完成精度要求比裁判通常采用的标准更严格，导致它进行了额外的推动，反而使姿态变得更差；由于每次推动后都会抬起至相机姿态，因此每次推动约消耗 835 个动作步。

paragraphs.en: Cup Upright. Fable’s only method pinches the rim through the cup’s opening, which works only when the opening faces an arm. It chose the method in its first 20 minutes, following a suggestion in the task card, and never tried the body grasp that both other agents used on the same scenes. All three of its frozen failures are refusals with no motion, and one was caused by a 0.20 m clearance from the parked arm, inherited from Push-T and never tested, where the harness requires 0.12 m. Opus’s near-horizontal body grip left the cup upright in 2 of 9 stand-ups, with no check that the grip holds. GPT-6-astra grips the body and turns the cup in the air. With the cup held 0.40–0.435 m from the arm base, 17 of 18 practice turns succeeded; at 0.454 m or more, all 5 were refused at the wrist. Its rule for choosing where to turn was revised twice, each time to fix the latest incident, and in one evaluation scene it picked the farther spot. After any refused turn it lays the cup down and stops. Its live agent instead turned the cup flat on the table and re-gripped it.
paragraphs.zh: 杯子保持直立。 Fable的唯一方法是通过杯口夹住杯沿，而这种方法只有在杯口朝向手臂时才能奏效。 它在最初20分钟内就选择了这种方法，这是遵循任务卡上的建议，并且从未尝试过其他两个智能体在同一场景中使用的抓握杯身的方法。 它所有三次冻结失败都是无动作的拒绝，其中一次是由于与停放的手臂之间存在0.20米的间隙所致，这个间隙是从Push-T继承而来且从未经过测试，而约束装置要求该间隙为0.12米。 Opus近乎水平的抓握杯身的方法在9次成功立起杯子中有2次使杯子保持直立，但并未检查抓握是否牢固。 GPT-6-astra会抓住杯身并在空中旋转杯子。 当杯子距离手臂基座0.40–0.435米时，18次练习旋转中有17次成功；在0.454米或更远时，5次尝试全部在手腕处被拒绝。 它选择旋转位置规则的修订了两次，每次都是为了修正最近发生的问题，而在一次评估场景中，它选择了更远的位置。 在任何被拒绝的旋转之后，它都会将杯子放下并停止。 它的实时智能体则相反，将杯子平放在桌上并重新抓握。

sents.zh: 它选择旋转位置规则的修订了两次，每次都是为了修正最近发生的问题，而在一次评估场景中，它选择了更远的位置。

sents.en: After any refused turn it lays the cup down and stops.
sents.zh: 在任何被拒绝的旋转之后，它都会将杯子放下并停止。

sents.en: Its live agent instead turned the cup flat on the table and re-gripped it.
sents.zh: 它的实时智能体则相反，将杯子平放在桌上并重新抓握。

paragraphs.en: Block Stacking. Fable places cubes within a median 2.9 mm, and the error does not grow with height. Its stall at about nine cubes looks like a wrist limit, but follows from its own choice to square each cube with the one below: from layer seven it turned the gripper 28 to 41 ∘ 41^{\circ} off the line from the arm base, and at that height the planner accepted 17 of 17 moves with the gripper within 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} of the line and 4 of 34 when it was 30 to 43 ∘ 43^{\circ} off. In practice it rarely built above six cubes after its record in hour three. Opus’s placement code carried a height correction between calls that counted the arm’s normal 3 mm tracking error as contact. The correction grew to 17–20 mm; cubes that stayed were released a median 0.2 mm below the true top and cubes that fell a median 6.5 mm above it, and the cube size it had fixed at 28–33 mm plausibly added to the error. When GPT-6-astra released a cube, it almost always stayed, 6 of 7 times, but most calls stopped before releasing. A low carrying path that keeps 170 mm from the tower and about 92 mm from every other cube, whatever that cube’s height, blocked 8 calls, and replaying its planner with a height rule it wrote later finds a path in 7 of them. A 6.1 ∘ 6.1^{\circ} heading tolerance, 200-step descent allowances, and a camera-coverage threshold ended 8 more, and harness reach refusals on approaches it had chosen ended 3. It spent 5.7 of its 12 hours on a narrow-grasp method for crowded cubes, which produced one practice success, and never considered moving cubes apart.
paragraphs.zh: 积木堆叠。 Fable 将立方体放置的偏差中位数为 2.9 毫米，且该误差不会随高度增加而增大。 它在堆叠约九个立方体时出现停滞，看似是手腕动作的限制，但实际源于它自身选择将每个立方体与下方的立方体对齐：从第七层开始，它将抓取器相对于机械臂基座的直线旋转了 28 至 41°；在该高度，规划器接受了 17 次移动中的全部 17 次（抓取器与直线的偏差在 10° 以内），以及 34 次移动中的 4 次（偏差在 30 至 43° 之间）。 实际上，在第三小时的记录之后，它很少能堆叠超过六个立方体。 Opus 的放置代码在每次调用之间执行了高度校正，并将机械臂正常的 3 毫米跟踪误差计为接触。 该校正量增长至 17–20 毫米；成功固定的立方体中位位置比实际顶部低 0.2 毫米，而掉落的立方体则比实际顶部高 6.5 毫米；它设定的立方体尺寸（28–33 毫米）很可能也加剧了误差。 当 GPT-6-astra 释放一个立方体时，该立方体几乎总是能保持位置（7 次中有 6 次），但大多数调用在释放前就停止了。 一条低矮的搬运路径——与塔身保持 170 毫米的距离，并与其他所有立方体保持约 92 毫米的距离（无论这些立方体的高度如何）——阻碍了 8 次调用；而使用它后来编写的高度规则重新运行规划器后，其中 7 次找到了可行路径。 6.1° 的航向容限、允许 200 步的下行调整以及相机覆盖阈值导致另外 8 次调用终止；而在它已选定的接近路径上，机械臂抓取范围不足则导致 3 次终止。 在总共 12 小时中，它有 5.7 小时采用了一种针对密集立方体的窄抓握方法，该方法仅在一次练习中取得成功，且从未考虑过将立方体分开移动。

paragraphs.en: Spell SEAR. No frozen policy put a wrong letter in the row. Staged scenes 6 to 10 add a crowded middle, letters lying across the target row, and required letters 0.53–0.58 m from the nearer arm base, and no frozen policy solved scenes 6 to 9. Besides the crooked and distant letters described in Section 4.4 , Fable twice lowered a letter that, judging from its logged stopping height, came to rest on a required letter still standing near its slot, because its clearing code removes only unneeded blocks. GPT-6-astra’s frozen policy refuses any placement whose fully open hand, modeled as an 86 × 144 86\times 144 mm rectangle, would touch another block. The rectangle only grew during practice, its notes explicitly refuse to shrink it, and it caused 13 refusals, while its step budget ran out in 5 of 10 scenes. Its live agent reordered letters, cleared distractors, and tilted the tool for distant letters, and succeeded on every staged scene it was given. Every evaluation scene requested SEAR, so reading direction was not tested in evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 拼写 SEAR。 没有任何冻结策略在该行中放入错误的字母。 第 6 至第 10 个场景增加了拥挤的中间部分，字母横跨目标行，所需字母距离较近的手臂基座为 0.53–0.58 米，且没有冻结策略能解决第 6 至第 9 个场景。 除了第 4.4 节中描述的歪斜和遥远的字母外，Fable 两次降低了某个字母；根据该字母记录的下落高度判断，它最终停在了一个仍位于其插槽附近的所需字母上，因为它的清理代码仅移除不必要的方块。 GPT-6-astra 的冻结策略拒绝任何放置操作，如果其完全展开的手（建模为 86 × 144 毫米的矩形）会接触到其他方块。 该矩形仅在练习期间扩大，其说明明确拒绝将其缩小，并因此导致了 13 次拒绝；而在 10 个场景中有 5 个场景的步骤预算用尽。 其实时智能体重新排列了字母、清除了干扰物，并为远处的字母倾斜了工具，成功完成了所有被给予的预设场景。 每个评估场景都要求拼写 SEAR，因此在评估中未测试阅读方向。

paragraphs.en: Earlier work is not carried forward. Fable’s counted Spell SEAR segment starts from its Block Stacking workspace. An earlier launch of the same task, not the one counted, had already picked distant letters with a tilted gripper and re-checked each letter’s angle after placing it, but inheritance follows the task order, so the counted segment never saw that work. More generally, only 1 to 25% of a bundle’s substantive code lines recur in the same agent’s bundle for the previous task. The exception is Block Stacking to Spell SEAR, where Fable keeps about 40% and GPT-6-astra about 47% by reusing their cube-handling code for letter blocks, while Opus keeps 3 to 6%. No frozen policy reads the persistent library.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的工作并未被延续下来。 Fable 中被计数的 Spell SEAR 阶段始于其 Block Stacking 工作区。 同一任务的一次早期启动（非被计数的这一次）已经用倾斜的夹爪抓取了远处的字母，并在放置每个字母后重新检查了其角度；但继承遵循任务顺序，因此被计数的阶段从未看到过这些工作。 更普遍地看，一个任务包中实质性代码行的重复率仅为 1% 到 25%，且仅出现在同一智能体执行前一个任务时所用的任务包中。 例外情况是 Block Stacking 到 Spell SEAR 的转换：Fable 通过复用其立方体处理代码来构建字母块，保留了约 40% 的代码；GPT-6-astra 保留了约 47%；而 Opus 仅保留了 3% 到 6%。 没有任何冻结策略会读取持久化库。

paragraphs.en: How the sessions are spent. Across the five tasks, GPT-6-astra made 8,023 tool calls, about 133 per hour, against 2,660 for Fable and 3,528 for Opus, and it read harness documentation and source 911 times, against 185 and 163. After changing code, Fable ran an offline check before the next hardware attempt in 62% of cases, GPT-6-astra in 47%, and Opus in 30%; after a failure, Fable opened an additional camera image before retrying in 44% of cases, against 7% for Opus. Opus never ran the Block Stacking reset task and cleared the spelled word once in 12 hours, whereas Fable ran a scored reverse attempt after almost every forward attempt. For every agent the robot was executing an attempt for only 34–42% of session time.
paragraphs.zh: 会话时间的分配方式。 在五项任务中，GPT-6-astra 共执行了 8,023 次工具调用，平均每小时约 133 次；而 Fable 为 2,660 次，Opus 为 3,528 次。此外，GPT-6-astra 阅读了 911 次框架文档和源代码，而 Fable 和 Opus 分别为 185 次和 163 次。 在修改代码后，Fable 在 62% 的情况下会在下一次硬件尝试前进行离线检查，GPT-6-astra 为 47%，Opus 为 30%；出现失败后，Fable 在 44% 的情况下会在重试前打开额外的摄像头图像，而 Opus 仅为 7%。 Opus 从未执行过“积木堆叠”重置任务，并且在 12 小时内仅正确拼写出单词一次；相比之下，Fable 几乎在每次正向尝试后都会执行一次计分反向尝试。 对于每个智能体，机器人执行尝试的时间仅占会话时间的 34%–42%。

paragraphs.en: Fable reaches the ten-success streak on all four non-stacking tasks, using 29.5 hours of hardware time across the five tasks; Opus reaches it on two, and GPT-6-astra on none in 60 hours ( Table 18 ). segments that reached the streak average 67% on staged scenes, against 38% for the six non-stacking segments that ran out of budget. Figure 18 shows every practice attempt.

paragraphs.en: Probes and scene variation. GPT-6-astra spends 358 of its 597 attempts, 60%, on unscored probes, compared with 8 of 355 for Fable. Opus uses 72 probes in total, 51 of them on Spell SEAR. On that task, GPT-6-astra spends five hours practicing pick and place through the clearing task before attempting the Spell SEAR task; its last seven scored spellings then succeed, three short of the streak. Many of GPT-6-astra’s probes deliberately change the next starting state: with its jaws closed it pushes the empty bowl 20–40 mm to a new position; it sets up a T rotated by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} ; and it performs 48 of its 52 cup resets as probes to place cups farther out. These actions follow an instruction to succeed across layouts. At least three of its success streaks break on the scored attempt following such a probe.

paragraphs.en: Reset states versus staged states. In every one of Fable’s practice spellings, its scrambling reset leaves at most one block in the middle of the table and no required letter farther than 0.48 m from an arm base; in evaluation, 8 of 10 scenes have blocks in the middle and 2 have a required letter 0.53–0.58 m away. Only 10 of Opus’s 64 practice Push-T starts require a turn of more than 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , compared with 6 of the 10 staged scenes. GPT-6-astra’s reset always leaves the T within 175 mm of its outline, whereas the staged starts are 158–269 mm away. Fable’s cup reset leaves every cup with its opening toward an arm. In Fable’s Cup Upright run a dropped cup came to rest facing away from both arms; the agent continued without resolving that configuration, 14 refused resets did not count toward the streak, and it reached the streak with 7.7 of its 12 hours unused.
paragraphs.zh: 重置状态与分阶段状态。 在 Fable 的所有练习拼写中，其打乱后的重置状态最多只会在表格中央留下一个方块，且任何必要字母与机械臂基座的距离都不会超过 0.48 米；而在评估中，10 个场景中有 8 个场景的方块位于中央，另外 2 个场景的必要字母则距离基座 0.53–0.58 米。 Opus 的 64 次练习“推-转”操作中，仅有 10 次需要超过 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} 的旋转，而分阶段场景中的这一数字为 6 次（占 10 次中的 6 次）。 GPT-6-astra 的重置操作始终使字母 T 与其轮廓的距离保持在 175 毫米以内，而分阶段操作的初始位置则距离轮廓 158–269 毫米。 Fable 的杯子重置操作确保每个杯子的开口都朝向机械臂。 在 Fable 的“杯子直立”运行中，一个被放下的杯子最终静止时开口背对两个机械臂；智能体并未解决这一状态便继续执行任务，14 次拒绝重置未计入连续成功次数，且它在完成该任务时仍有 7.7 小时（占总时长 12 小时）未被使用。

paragraphs.en: Live execution. Under agent-as-policy, Fable’s code grows from 202 lines after Banana into Bowl to 3,576 lines in 30 files after Spell SEAR, with at least 15 files issuing robot commands; these scripts account for 99% of its 33,532 practice commands and 98% of its 5,916 evaluation commands, and on Block Stacking and Spell SEAR background loops open and close most practice attempts without a separate model decision. GPT-6-astra issues each of its 7,537 commands through a separate model call, requests about one image per arm motion against Fable’s 0.14, and writes ten small helpers, none of which moves the robot. Fable’s scripted Cup Upright routine closes on the cup’s paper wall in all 18 visible practice grasps and in none of 23 evaluation grasps; its single evaluation success comes after switching to a body-squeeze routine written during practice.
paragraphs.zh: 实时执行。 在“智能体即策略”模式下，Fable 的代码从 Banana 到 Bowl 阶段后的 202 行增长至 Spell SEAR 阶段后分布在 30 个文件中的 3,576 行，其中至少有 15 个文件会发出机器人指令；这些脚本占其 33,532 条练习指令的 99%，以及 5,916 条评估指令的 98%；在 Block Stacking 和 Spell SEAR 的背景循环中，大多数练习尝试无需单独的模型决策即可自动开启和关闭。 GPT-6-astra 通过独立的模型调用发出其全部 7,537 条指令，每次手臂动作仅请求约一张图像（而 Fable 为 0.14），并编写了十个小型辅助程序，但其中没有任何一个能驱动机器人移动。 Fable 脚本化的“杯子直立”流程在所有 18 次可见的练习抓取中都会因接触杯子的纸壁而终止，但在 23 次评估抓取中均未发生这种情况；其唯一一次评估成功是在切换到练习期间编写的“身体挤压”流程之后实现的。

paragraphs.en: Cost. GPT-6-astra issues its first robot attempt 3 to 8 minutes after each launch, while Fable and Opus first spend 23 to 53 minutes reading and writing code. Per scored forward success, practice costs about $3.7 in API spend for Fable, $11 for Opus, and $18 for GPT-6-astra. For the Cup Upright segment the recorded API costs are about $96, $254, and $368, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 GPT-6-astra 在每次发射后 3 到 8 分钟就执行了首次机器人尝试，而 Fable 和 Opus 则需要先花费 23 到 53 分钟来阅读和编写代码。 在每次成功向前得分中，Fable 的 API 使用成本约为 3.7 美元，Opus 为 11 美元，GPT-6-astra 为 18 美元。 在“直立杯”环节，记录的 API 成本分别为约 96 美元、254 美元和 368 美元。

paragraphs.en: Losing objects. Opus’s Spell SEAR policy knocks the S off the table in the fourth hour, the E in the sixth, and the R in the ninth. From hour 4.4 its own scene description reports that the word cannot be completed because the S is missing. Nevertheless it spends its last 7.5 hours, and 62 of its 101 attempts, continuing the task; its memory records the loss of the S and E, but further code revision cannot replace the missing letters. Practice ends with 1 success in 45 scored spelling attempts, and the frozen policy scores 0 of 10 on the staged scenes. In the third hour of Opus’s Cup Upright run an attempt knocks a lying cup off the table; the next 169 attempts, including the ten-success streak, operate on the remaining two-cup scene.
paragraphs.zh: 物品丢失。 Opus 的 Spell SEAR 策略在第四小时去掉了字母 S，第六小时去掉了 E，第九小时去掉了 R。 从第 4.4 小时开始，其场景描述报告称无法完成该单词，因为缺少了字母 S。 尽管如此，它仍用最后 7.5 小时以及 101 次尝试中的 62 次继续执行任务；其记忆记录了 S 和 E 的丢失，但进一步的代码修订也无法补全缺失的字母。 练习最终以 45 次拼写尝试中获得 1 次成功而结束，而在分阶段场景测试中，该固定策略得分为 0/10。 在 Opus 的 Cup Upright 运行第三小时，一次尝试将桌上一个倒置的杯子碰落；接下来的 169 次尝试（包括连续十次成功的阶段）均在仅剩两个杯子的场景中进行。

paragraphs.en: Block Stacking. The task asks for the tallest tower, and the run’s score is the maximum height reached, but the feedback for each placement is a binary success whenever the column ends taller than it started. Fable reaches 310 mm, about eight cubes, in its third hour, then cycles through building towers of five or six cubes, toppling them, and rebuilding ( Figure 20 ). Placements that increase the height of these shorter towers continue to earn successful verdicts even though the record does not improve. Placement success and progress toward a higher tower must therefore be reported separately; the pattern does not by itself establish that the feedback caused the rebuilding.
paragraphs.zh: 积木堆叠。 该任务要求搭建最高的塔，运行得分即为达到的最大高度，但每次放置的反馈是二元的：只要最终列高高于初始高度，即视为成功。 Fable 在第三小时时堆叠到 310 毫米（约八个立方体），随后循环搭建五至六个立方体的塔、将其推倒，再重新搭建（图 20）。 即使未能打破纪录，只要能够提升这些较矮塔的高度，相关放置操作仍会持续获得成功判定。 因此，必须分别报告放置的成功与否以及向更高塔迈进的进展；仅凭这一模式本身无法确定反馈是否导致了重建行为。

paragraphs.en: This section summarizes the design of LIBERO-RIG ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , the benchmark that supplies the hardware-fault condition of tier T2 ( Section 2.4 ) and one of the five simulated families. The companion paper also evaluates nine end-to-end VLA models under the same protocol, which we do not reproduce here.

paragraphs.en: LIBERO-RIG measures how robust a policy is to perturbations of the physical parameters of the robot it runs on, with the task held fixed. It keeps the instruction, the object identities, the success predicate, and the nominal initial-state identifiers of every LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) task, and changes only the rig, the robot hardware and the way it is set up, one axis at a time, by a prescribed amount. The rig is parameterized by the extrinsics and intrinsics of the scene and wrist cameras, the calibration between camera and arm, the gain and rate of the controller, the noise in the arm’s reported state, the base pose of the arm, the table height, and the geometry of the end-effector pads. Formally, the rig configuration enters the episode in three places: the sensing map, through which the policy observes the world (camera mounting and optics, proprioception noise); the actuation map, through which its commands reach the world (camera-to-arm calibration, gain); and the physical arrangement of robot, table, and end effector (base pose, table height, pad geometry). A shared initial-state identifier therefore fixes the task’s start, not an identical geometry or an identical first observation. The base benchmark is LIBERO’s four ten-task suites, LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-10, simulated in MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) through robosuite ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) , each task with 50 fixed initial states, a scene camera, a wrist camera, proprioception, and a nominal control rate of 20 Hz.

sents.zh: LIBERO-RIG 衡量一项策略在机器人物理参数受到扰动时的鲁棒性，同时保持任务不变。

sents.en: It keeps the instruction, the object identities, the success predicate, and the nominal initial-state identifiers of every LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) task, and changes only the rig, the robot hardware and the way it is set up, one axis at a time, by a prescribed amount.

paragraphs.en: Table 22 lists the ten axes used in this paper. The organizing idea is the type column, which classifies each fault by its direct effect on the camera images at a matched arm and object configuration. An observable fault changes at least one camera image of that configuration, as with a moved camera or a shifted robot base. A latent fault changes no camera image; it shows only in a non-visual input or in how the arm responds to a command, as with a rotated calibration or noise on the reported arm pose. Gripper-pad geometry sits between the two, since the pads occupy a few pixels of the wrist view. The split matters for mitigation: image augmentation targets what a policy sees, so by itself it does not address a fault that leaves the image of a given state unchanged. Each axis is a small, exactly specified transform of the simulator model or of the command stream. Action-frame rotation, for example, rotates the commanded translation and rotation about the world vertical before the controller’s scaling and clipping, a controlled proxy for one rotational component of a calibration error.
paragraphs.zh: 表22列出了本文使用的十个轴。 组织性思路是“类型”列，它根据故障对匹配的手臂和物体配置下相机图像的直接影响来对每个故障进行分类。 可观察的故障会改变该配置下的至少一个相机图像，例如相机移动或机器人基座偏移的情况。 潜伏性故障不会改变任何相机图像；它仅体现在非视觉输入中，或体现在手臂对命令的响应方式上，例如校准旋转或报告的手臂姿态存在噪声。 夹爪垫的几何结构介于两者之间，因为夹爪垫会占据手腕视角中的少量像素。 这种区分对于缓解措施很重要：图像增强针对的是策略所看到的内容，因此单独使用它无法解决那些使给定状态的图像保持不变的故障。 每个轴都是对模拟器模型或命令流进行的一个微小且精确指定的变换。 例如，动作帧旋转会在控制器的缩放和裁剪之前，围绕世界垂直轴旋转所命令的平移和旋转，这可以作为校准误差中一个旋转分量的受控代理。

paragraphs.en: Every axis has five settings, s1 to s5. For every axis these form a ladder from the smaller tested magnitudes to a rebuilt rig, with the first two levels at 2 and 5 degrees of camera twist and 1 and 2 cm of base displacement; the magnitudes are not claimed to represent measured real-world drift, and a given level does not carry the same physical severity across axes. This paper uses level 3, which we call moderate, throughout: the 18-task course, the T2 re-grades of practiced policies, and every LIBERO-RIG number in the main text are at the moderate level. The one exception is a severity sweep that also grades policies at levels 4 and 5, which we call severe ( Table 12 , Figure 17 , and Table 24 ); each of these labels its level. A condition is one combination of suite, axis, and level, and spans all ten tasks of the suite. Table height applies only to the two suites whose arenas are height-adjustable, so the ten axes give 190 perturbed conditions plus four nominal ones. Every episode’s parameters are pinned in checksummed manifests rather than sampled at run time, and every condition starts its tasks from the same fixed initial states as the unperturbed baseline, so every policy meets the same perturbation on the same start.
paragraphs.zh: 每个轴都有五个设置，从 s1 到 s5。 对于每个轴，这些设置构成一个阶梯，从较小的测试幅度延伸至重建的装置，其中前两个级别分别对应 2 度和 5 度的相机扭转以及 1 厘米和 2 厘米的基座位移；这些幅度并不声称代表实际测量到的现实世界漂移，且同一级别在不同轴上的物理严重程度并不相同。 本文全程使用第 3 级，我们称之为“中等”：18 项任务的课程、已训练策略的 T2 重新评分，以及正文中所有 LIBERO-RIG 数值均处于中等级别。 唯一例外是一个严重程度扫描，它还会在第 4 级和第 5 级对策略进行评级，我们称之为“严重”（表 12、图 17 和表 24）；这些级别各自都会标注其等级。 一个条件是指套件、轴和级别的某一组合，并涵盖该套件的全部十项任务。 表格高度仅适用于两个竞技场高度可调的套件，因此十个轴共产生 190 个扰动条件和四个正常条件。 每一集的参数都通过校验和化的清单固定下来，而非在运行时采样；每个条件都从与未扰动基线相同的固定初始状态开始执行任务，因此所有策略都在相同的起始状态下面临相同的扰动。

paragraphs.en: The score is the raw success rate under each condition, read against the same policy’s unperturbed rate on the same suite. Raw rates answer the deployment question directly, how often the policy works on this rig, and the gap to the nominal rate is the perturbation cost; a retention companion, the ratio of the two, allows a capability-adjusted reading. Each policy receives a per-axis profile rather than a single number, which tells a practitioner which rig changes it tolerates and which it does not. An episode starts from its fixed initial state, settles for ten control steps under a no-op command, and hands control to the policy; it ends as a success the moment LIBERO’s predicate holds and as a failure when the budget runs out, with the step budget scaled to the control rate so that the simulated-time budget stays constant. The policy receives no fault identity, severity, rate, or calibration metadata, and any hidden state is reset between episodes. Two things must hold for a perturbed condition to measure the policy rather than the benchmark: the task must remain solvable, and its goal must remain visible. LIBERO-RIG tests both with fairness checks, replaying LIBERO’s recorded demonstrations under the exact inverse of the perturbation where an inverse exists, following the demonstration’s path with a closed-loop tracking witness where it does not, and auditing goal visibility along each perturbed camera. The evidence is reported as diagnostics and never used to remove a condition or an episode from the score.
paragraphs.zh: 得分是每种条件下未经处理的成功率，通过与同一策略在未受扰动情况下在同一测试套件上的成功率进行对比得出。 未经处理的成功率直接回答了部署问题：该策略在此测试平台上运行的频率，以及与基准成功率的差距即为扰动成本；而两者的比率作为补充指标，可提供经能力调整后的解读。 每个策略都会获得一个按轴划分的分布图，而非单一数值，这能让从业者了解该策略能容忍哪些测试平台的变化，而不能容忍哪些变化。 一个回合从固定的初始状态开始，在无效操作命令下运行十个控制步后，将控制权交给策略；一旦 LIBERO 的谓词成立，回合即判定为成功；若预算耗尽则判定为失败，其中步数预算会根据控制率进行缩放，以确保模拟时间预算保持恒定。 策略不会接收到任何故障身份、严重程度、发生率或校准元数据，且任何隐藏状态都会在回合之间被重置。 一个受扰动的条件若要衡量的是策略本身而非基准，则必须满足两个前提：任务必须仍然可解，且其目标必须仍然可见。 LIBERO-RIG 通过公平性检查对两者进行测试：在存在逆扰动时，重新播放 LIBERO 记录的演示，并采用闭环跟踪见证机制沿演示路径执行；同时，还会沿着每个受扰动的摄像头路径审计目标可见性。 相关证据将以诊断信息的形式报告，且绝不会用于从得分中移除某个条件或回合。

paragraphs.en: The unit in SEAR is a cell, one task under one condition, rather than a full condition. The LIBERO-RIG course, which a Lineage run takes after LIBERO-PRO in place of RoboLab, is a development course of 18 cells at the moderate level: four or five tasks from each of the four suites, each paired with one perturbation axis, chosen so that all ten axes appear ( Table 23 ); the control-frequency axis is excluded for the reason above. Each cell receives the family’s per-task development budget ( Appendix E ) and is graded on the DEV, VAL, and TEST bands of Appendix D , exactly as an unperturbed LIBERO task would be. The agent is given the stock LIBERO task text with only the task reference changed; nothing in the workspace names the fault. The course is run as three seed-matched runs per model (two for Gemini-3.6-flash, whose donor has two libraries), and the matched Vanilla control runs one 60-minute session per cell, three repetitions, with the same text; its host grades come every 15 minutes (the lineage runs’ every 5), with agent-initiated submissions in both, so readings taken before 30 minutes favor the lineage runs and Section 3.2 quotes the 30-minute mark. The T2 results of Section 4.1 take policies practiced on unperturbed LIBERO and re-grade them, frozen, on all 40 tasks under every axis at the moderate level; the severity sweep adds the two severe levels, and Table 12 gives the per-axis values.

paragraphs.en: For every developed cell we take the best valid policy a model’s adaptation runs wrote on it and run it, frozen, on every other cell of the same base task: the other axes at the moderate and the two severe levels for Opus and DeepSeek-v4-flash, at the moderate level for the other models. The reference is the same model’s LIBERO-PRO-practiced policy for that task, run frozen on the identical cell (the T2 transfer of Section 4.1 ), so the comparison asks whether practice under one hardware fault helps under a different one. Both sides of the comparison are validation grades, complete grades only, paired on identical cells; the score is the macro over the ten axes of the mean over cells ( Table 24 ). The gain is at most about ten points either way. It is positive for Opus, DeepSeek-v4-flash, and Gemini-3.6-flash, and larger at the severe levels than at the moderate level for Opus. It is negative for GPT-5.6-sol and Kimi-k3.

paragraphs.en: Opus: measure first, build infrastructure, verify by proprioception. Opus makes the most tool calls (196 per two-hour RoboLab run against 101 on a one-hour LIBERO-PRO task, the one model whose effort scales with difficulty), runs the simulator locally, and views six to seven images per run. The looking is diagnostic, not reactive: image views lead to code edits 38% of the time (baseline 24%), concentrate in the second half of its exploration once the pipeline exists, and do not follow failure-flagged results. It compiles what it measured into geometry: only 20% of its RoboLab lineage policies call SAM3 (73% of no-library policies do), and its libraries hold height maps, rim fits, and footprint searches where other models hold SAM3 detector prompts. Its policies verify the grasp by gripper aperture (97%), guard by remaining step budget (98%), and retry (94%), the idioms most strongly associated with success within Opus. It writes the most to the library, five to ten entries per step, phrased as sentences that carry a reason (“measure the hang, do not assume it”), and it is the only model that writes about the harness rather than the robot. It submits the least: half its runs are graded only by auto-evaluation. Its skills are almost uniformly useful (38 of 42 with three or more uses have positive lift, where a skill’s lift is how much more often policies that import it succeed than policies that do not), and its best-of-3 winners lose nothing from validation to test.
paragraphs.zh: Opus：先测量，再构建基础设施，最后通过本体感知进行验证。 Opus 的工具调用次数最多（在持续两小时的 RoboLab 运行中为 196 次，而在持续一小时的 LIBERO-PRO 任务中为 101 次；后者是唯一一个努力程度会随难度增加而变化的模型），它在本地运行模拟器，并且每次运行会查看六到七张图像。 这种观察行为具有诊断性而非反应性：图像查看在 38% 的情况下会引发代码修改（基线为 24%），这些修改主要集中在管道构建完成后的探索后半阶段，并且不会针对被标记为失败的结果进行后续操作。 它将测量结果整合为几何信息：在 RoboLab 的谱系策略中，仅有 20% 的策略调用了 SAM3（而无需依赖库的策略中则有 73% 调用），其库中存储的是高度图、边缘拟合和足迹搜索，而其他模型则存储的是 SAM3 检测器提示。 它的策略通过抓夹开口（97%）验证抓取动作，通过剩余步数预算（98%）进行防护，并执行重试（94%）；这些是 Opus 中与成功关联最紧密的惯用模式。 它向库中写入的内容最多，每步生成五到十条记录，并以带有理由的句式表达（例如“测量悬挂状态，不要假设”），并且它是唯一一个会记录关于约束装置而非机器人本身的模型。 它的提交次数最少：一半的运行仅通过自动评估进行评分。 它的技能几乎全部具有实用价值（在 42 项技能中，有 38 项的使用次数达到三次或以上且提升值为正；一项技能的提升值表示导入该技能的策略成功频率高于未导入该技能的策略），并且其“三选一”最佳模型从验证到测试阶段的表现没有任何下降。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6-sol: fast, blind, and it overfits VAL. GPT-5.6-sol never reads an image by itself; it saves frames to disk and reasons about them numerically. It makes the fewest tool calls (60, and only 40 on LIBERO-PRO), edits the least (7 files), runs the simulator locally the most (16 to 21 times per run), and submits the most (3.6 times; 90% of its best rounds are its own submissions). It treats SAM3 as a source of candidates rather than ground truth: its bundles carry one or two text prompts at the median, the fewest of any model, but the most geometric filtering (3.1 filters per bundle against 0 to 0.4 for the others, and a color gate in 83% of RoboLab lineage bundles). Half of what it writes to memory is about what SAM3 misses, not how to phrase the prompt. This separation, SAM3 for what is present and code for which object the instruction means, made it the second-best model on RoboLab without a library. Its style is fast or never: 31% of its RoboLab runs succeed by minute 40 and almost none after 100. Three costs follow. It shows the largest VAL-to-TEST gap of any model (4 to 7 points) and 20% of its runs end on a policy worse than their best; its library lowers its RoboLab score ( − 4.5 -4.5 ; Table 5 ), because its skills are task-named suite helpers whose most-used member has negative lift; and with Gemini-3.6-flash it is one of the two models for which best-of-3 beats Vanilla on RoboLab ( Section 3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.6-sol：速度快，但存在盲目性，且对验证集（VAL）出现过拟合。 GPT-5.6-sol 从不单独读取图像；它会将图像帧保存到磁盘，并以数值方式进行分析推理。 它的工具调用次数最少（60次，在 LIBERO-PRO 上仅为40次），编辑文件最少（7个），但本地运行模拟器的次数最多（每次运行16至21次），提交次数也最多（3.6次；其最佳轮次的90%均为自身提交）。 它将 SAM3 视为候选项的来源，而非基准事实：其捆绑包中位数仅包含一两个文本提示，是所有模型中最少的，但几何过滤最多（每个捆绑包平均3.1个过滤器，而其他模型为0至0.4个，且83%的 RoboLab 谱系捆绑包中还包含颜色门控）。 它写入内存的内容中，有一半是关于 SAM3 遗漏的信息，而非如何措辞提示。 这种分离机制——SAM3 负责识别存在的内容，代码则用于确定指令所指代的对象——使其在没有库支持的情况下，在 RoboLab 上成为第二佳模型。 其执行风格要么快速，要么完全无法完成：31%的 RoboLab 运行在第40分钟前即告成功，而超过100分钟的几乎不存在。由此产生了三个成本问题。 它在验证集（VAL）与测试集（TEST）之间的表现差距最大（相差4至7分），且20%的运行最终采用的策略劣于其最佳策略；它的库会降低 RoboLab 得分（−4.5；见表5），因为其技能是任务命名的套件辅助工具，其中最常用的成员甚至没有带来性能提升；此外，在使用 Gemini-3.6-flash 时，它是仅有的两个在 RoboLab 上“最佳3次运行”能击败 Vanilla 的模型之一（第3.1节）。

sents.zh: GPT-5.6-sol：速度快，但存在盲目性，且对验证集（VAL）出现过拟合。

sents.en: It shows the largest VAL-to-TEST gap of any model (4 to 7 points) and 20% of its runs end on a policy worse than their best; its library lowers its RoboLab score ( − 4.5 -4.5 ; Table 5 ), because its skills are task-named suite helpers whose most-used member has negative lift; and with Gemini-3.6-flash it is one of the two models for which best-of-3 beats Vanilla on RoboLab ( Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 它在验证集（VAL）与测试集（TEST）之间的表现差距最大（相差4至7分），且20%的运行最终采用的策略劣于其最佳策略；它的库会降低 RoboLab 得分（−4.5；见表5），因为其技能是任务命名的套件辅助工具，其中最常用的成员甚至没有带来性能提升；此外，在使用 Gemini-3.6-flash 时，它是仅有的两个在 RoboLab 上“最佳3次运行”能击败 Vanilla 的模型之一（第3.1节）。

paragraphs.en: Kimi-k3: explores well, ships rarely, learns along the lineage. Kimi-k3 matches or beats Opus on five of seven self-exploration settings ( Table 14 ) and adapts to hardware faults nearly as well as Opus when it has a library (94.4 against 97.0% TEST), but not without one (72.0 against 96.7). Its dominant failure is delivery: 64% of its graded RoboLab rounds never contained a policy file, because it probes the simulator in background processes and runs out of time; in the 40-minute best-of-3 draws, 90% of attempts ship nothing. Its shipped Vanilla policies score a mean 42 VAL, against 63 for Opus, with closed-loop code (aperture check 88%, retry 92%, wrist-camera refinement 77%). It looks at six to eight images per run, late, and edits after 68% of them (baseline 25%), the most corrective use of vision in the study. It is the model whose library gain grows along the lineage ( − 26 -26 points in the first seven steps to + 35 +35 by step 45), whose skills are almost all useful (23 of 24 with three or more uses have positive lift), and the second to carry LIBERO-origin control skills onto the Isaac rig.
paragraphs.zh: Kimi-k3：探索能力出色，但很少生成可用方案，并沿模型谱系持续学习。 Kimi-k3 在七种自我探索设置中的五种表现与 Opus 相当或更优（表 14）；当配备知识库时，其对硬件故障的适应能力几乎与 Opus 相当（测试中分别为 94.4% 和 97.0%），但无知识库时则明显不足（72.0% 对比 96.7%）。 其主要失败模式是方案交付问题：在分级 RoboLab 任务中，64% 的回合从未生成策略文件，因为它会在后台进程中对模拟器进行探测，最终导致时间耗尽；在持续 40 分钟、三局两胜制的对局中，90% 的尝试均未生成任何可用方案。 其生成的 Vanilla 策略平均 VAL 得分为 42，而 Opus 为 63；相关闭环代码包括：孔径检查（88%）、重试机制（92%）以及手腕摄像头优化（77%）。 每次运行中，它会查看六到八张图像，且处理时间偏晚；在 68% 的图像处理后还会进行编辑（基线为 25%），这是该研究中视觉信息的最大程度修正性应用。 它是知识库增益随模型谱系演进而持续提升的模型（前七步损失 26 分，到第 45 步则转为 +35 分）；其技能几乎全部具有实用价值（24 项技能中，有 23 项在三次及以上使用后表现出正向提升），并且是第二个能将源自 LIBERO 的控制技能迁移到 Isaac 平台上的模型。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-v4-flash: text-only, and it reads the library rather than importing it. Given open-set segmentation and a depth lifter, the one model that cannot see composes them into working manipulation: 98% of its RoboLab policies call SAM3 and lift the mask through the depth camera, with eight distinct prompts per lineage bundle, it ships a policy in 85% of runs (more often than Kimi-k3 or Gemini-3.6-flash), and on RoboLab it is ahead of Gemini-3.6-flash, the multimodal model of the same tier, without and with a library (though not in best-of-3). It writes skills it does not call again (51 to 71% of its skills are never reused, the highest share) and imports library code in few of its policies (14% on robosuite, 19% on LIBERO, 34% on LIBERO-PRO, 20% on RoboLab, against 53 to 100% for the other four models); its library gain on RoboLab is + 4.1 +4.1 TEST points on the 58 tasks its runs completed, and its 18-point gain on LIBERO-PRO, the largest of any model, does not arrive as copied text: the policies that copy the most from the inherited memories score lower (75) than those that copy nothing (87). Its memories are concrete constants (“descend the TCP to top_z − - 0.016 for a 0.028-tall box so the jaws wrap the sides”). Its weakness is what it cannot see: when SAM3 misses it has no fallback, and it trails Gemini-3.6-flash on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-v4-flash：纯文本模型，它会读取库文件而不是导入它。 在开放集分割和深度提升器的条件下，这个无法直接感知的单一模型能将它们组合成可用的操控操作：其 RoboLab 策略中 98% 会调用 SAM3，并通过深度摄像头提升掩码；每个谱系包包含八个不同的提示，它在 85% 的运行中都能生成策略（比 Kimi-k3 或 Gemini-3.6-flash 更频繁），并且在 RoboLab 上优于同级别的 multimodal 模型 Gemini-3.6-flash，无论是否使用库文件（尽管在“最佳三选一”测试中并非如此）。 它会编写自己不再重复调用的技能（其 51% 至 71% 的技能从未被重复使用，比例最高），并在少数策略中导入库代码（robosuite 上为 14%，LIBERO 上为 19%，LIBERO-PRO 上为 34%，RoboLab 上为 20%，而其他四个模型的比例则在 53% 至 100% 之间）；在 RoboLab 的 58 个已完成任务中，使用库文件带来的增益为 +4.1 +4.1 TEST 分，而在 LIBERO-PRO 上获得的 18 分增益是所有模型中最高的，但这并非来自复制文本：从继承记忆中复制最多内容的策略得分较低（75），而完全不复制的策略得分更高（87）。 其记忆是具体的常量（例如：“将 TCP 下降到 top_z − - 0.016，以处理一个高 0.028 的盒子，使夹爪能够包裹两侧”）。 它的弱点在于无法感知的事物：当 SAM3 出现错误时，它没有备用方案，并且在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 上的表现落后于 Gemini-3.6-flash。

paragraphs.en: Gemini-3.6-flash: shortest policies, one perception route, skills it never reuses. Gemini-3.6-flash writes the shortest policies in the study (median 22 lines on the RoboLab lineages; 153 without a library), edits four times per run, opens an image in 2% of runs, and never runs the simulator locally. SAM3 is its entire perception (39 VAL with it against 2 without), and its adaptation is the prompt: 11 distinct prompts per lineage bundle with synonym lists in 95% of them (“grey bin”, “gray bin”, “plastic bin”, “storage bin”, “container”). Its one strong control habit is polling the success predicate to the end (86% of lineage bundles): 68% of its logged failures end with the motion complete and the jaws closed on air. It authors skills it mostly calls once, and on RoboLab it has called rig methods that do not exist. Its library gain on RoboLab is + 2.0 +2.0 ; its larger gains elsewhere ( + 47 +47 on the LIBERO-RIG course, + 13 +13 on LIBERO-PRO) sit on the cells it fails alone. Its no-policy rounds (38%) are delivery failures upstream of robotics.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini-3.6-flash：策略最短，感知路径单一，且技能从不重复使用。 Gemini-3.6-flash 在研究中编写了最短的策略（RoboLab 谱系中位数为 22 行；不使用库时为 153 行），每次运行编辑四次，2% 的运行中打开图像，且从未在本地运行模拟器。 SAM3 构成了其全部感知能力（使用它时 VAL 为 39，不使用时则为 2），其适应方式依赖于提示：每个谱系包包含 11 个不同提示，其中 95% 的提示包含同义词列表（“灰色垃圾桶”“灰垃圾桶”“塑料垃圾桶”“储物桶”“容器”）。 它唯一稳定的控制习惯是直到最后才查询成功谓词（86% 的谱系包如此）：其记录失败的 68% 案例以动作完成、下颌闭合在空气中结束。 它编写的技能大多仅调用一次，并且在 RoboLab 上甚至调用了并不存在的 rig 方法。 它在 RoboLab 上的库增益为 +2.0 +2.0；在其他任务中的更大增益（LIBERO-RIG 课程中为 +47 +47，LIBERO-PRO 中为 +13 +13）则建立在其单独失败的任务单元之上。 其无策略的回合（38%）是机器人系统上游的交付失败。

paragraphs.en: Failure by task category (RoboLab Vanilla, validation episodes). Relative placement (stacking, spatial relations) scores 1.7 times each model’s mean; tools and utensils score 28% for Opus, 24 for GPT-5.6-sol, and 3 on average for the other three; reorientation scores 0.29 of each model’s mean and thin or handled objects 0.48. Over 21,552 graded episodes the within-cell rank correlation between a layout’s pass rate and the target’s reach, lateral offset, yaw, or clutter averages 0.04 in magnitude. Where a policy logged its closing aperture, 78% of failed episodes closed on air (under 5 mm) against 18% of successful ones. For Kimi-k3 and Gemini-3.6-flash, 54 and 55% of zero-score runs never delivered a policy file.
paragraphs.zh: 按任务类别划分的失败情况（RoboLab Vanilla，验证回合）。 相对位置（堆叠、空间关系）得分是各模型均值的 1.7 倍；工具与器具方面，Opus 得分为 28%，GPT-5.6-sol 为 24%，其余三种模型平均得分为 3；重新定向得分是各模型均值的 0.29 倍，而薄型或带把手物体的得分则为 0.48。 在超过 21,552 个评分回合中，布局通过率与目标物的抓取、横向偏移、偏航或杂乱程度之间的单元格内等级相关系数平均绝对值为 0.04。 在策略记录了其闭合开口的情况下，78% 的失败回合是在空中闭合（小于 5 毫米），而成功回合中这一比例为 18%。 对于 Kimi-k3 和 Gemini-3.6-flash，54% 和 55% 的零分运行从未生成策略文件。

paragraphs.en: Verification schools and policy shape. Two verification schools never mix within a model: Opus, Kimi-k3, and DeepSeek-v4-flash test the grasp by gripper aperture after closing (97, 88, and 74%); GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.6-flash test by the environment’s holding flag (92 and 45%). Opus refines from the wrist camera at pre-grasp in 75% of RoboLab lineage bundles and Kimi-k3 in 77%, the other three in 22% on average. The library halves the policy and moves logic into imports: an Opus lineage policy is 293 lines importing 524 lines of skills, a GPT-5.6-sol one 124 plus 256, a Gemini-3.6-flash one 22 plus 137. Open-category selection and multi-object cells are a second source of failure, and stronger models suffer less from it: these cells score 0.83 of the model’s mean for Opus and 0.66 for the others. Success falls monotonically from blocks (81% for Opus) through bananas and bottles to mugs and bowls (55) to tools.

paragraphs.en: Accumulation mattered more than perturbation. Every model handled LIBERO-PRO’s reworded instructions comparatively well; the harder problem was accumulating useful experience. On the hardest LIBERO-Goal task, Opus scored 0 of 5 with the stock instruction and 2 of 5 after it was rephrased seventeen steps into the LIBERO-PRO curriculum. The drawer, not the wording, was the difficulty, and what differed was the library: 171 entries at the stock run against 262 at the PRO run, including two self-authored skills that did not exist earlier. The comparison is not strictly like for like, since the two scores come from different bands and both runs timed out mid-refactor.
paragraphs.zh: 积累比扰动更为重要。 每个模型都相对较好地处理了 LIBERO-PRO 的改写指令；更困难的问题在于积累有用的经验。 在最难的 LIBERO-Goal 任务中，使用原始指令时 Opus 在 5 项中得 0 分，而在指令经过十七步改写后融入 LIBERO-PRO 课程时，则获得了 2 分。 真正的困难在于抽屉本身，而非措辞；而不同之处在于技能库：原始运行包含 171 个条目，而 PRO 运行则包含 262 个，其中包括两个此前并不存在的自创技能。 这一比较并非严格意义上的同类对比，因为这两个分数来自不同的阶段，且两次运行都在重构过程中因超时而终止。

paragraphs.en: Every model received the same tasks, tools, budgets, and library machinery, but one model gained little from them. Inkling-small completed the robosuite and LIBERO tasks at 25.2 ± 3.3 25.2\pm 3.3 and 6.4 ± 2.2 6.4\pm 2.2 % TEST and was withdrawn partway through LIBERO-PRO; one of its lineages went 29 consecutive tasks without a valid policy. It wrote memories in about half its runs but almost never a code skill: after 47 tasks its three libraries held 0, 6, and 2 skills. In these runs, Inkling-small produced little working code for later tasks to reuse. We exclude it from the remaining tables.

paragraphs.en: Most of the difficulty comes from the task rather than the model. On RoboLab, the cell explains 56% of the variance in cell scores, the model explains 22%, and their interaction explains the remaining 22%. The average rank correlation of task difficulty between model pairs is 0.69. Models often struggle on the same tasks, but their failures do not form strictly nested sets. Seven cells are solved only by Opus, and five by no model.
