paragraphs.en: Counts behind Section 4.2 . On the first half of the RoboLab curriculum, pooled over each model’s three lineages, Opus reused 202 distinct skills in 660 imports; the other models reused 26 to 126 skills. Across simulators (MuJoCo Panda to Isaac Sim Franka), 86 Opus imports of 12 skills reached 52% of its RoboLab policies and 73 Kimi-k3 imports of 14 skills reached 42%; GPT-5.6-sol made three such imports and the other two models none. The skills that cross are servo wrappers and grasp idioms, with per-skill lift of + 17 +17 to + 36 +36 points. Reuse is heavy-tailed: the top tenth of skills takes 40 to 68% of uses, and independent lineages converge on the same concepts under different names. Memories propagate alongside code: 83 to 93% of Opus’s lineage policies carry identifiers from inherited memories that are absent from the matched no-library policies. Final programs import 16 to 21% of a lineage’s skill modules, and 96 to 133 skills per lineage have been shadowed by newer versions. A VLA library’s memory file runs to a median 180,000 characters on RoboLab. Library gains concentrate on cells a model fails alone: on LIBERO-PRO, cells with a Vanilla score below 50% gain + 33 +33 and + 39 +39 points for the two weakest models against + 2 +2 and + 4 +4 on cells they already solve, + 25 +25 against + 3 +3 for GPT-5.6-sol, and + 14 +14 against − 1 -1 for Kimi-k3. Kimi-k3’s RoboLab library gain grows along the lineage from − 26 -26 points in its first seven steps to + 24 +24 to + 35 +35 from step 28 on. Frozen and re-graded on LIBERO-PRO, Opus’s LIBERO-practiced lineage policies score 47.7% TEST, against 40.7% for its best-of-3 policies.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节之后的计数。 在 RoboLab 课程的前半部分，综合各模型三条谱系的数据来看，Opus 在 660 次导入中重用了 202 项不同技能；其他模型则重用了 26 至 126 项技能。 在不同模拟器（从 MuJoCo Panda 到 Isaac Sim Franka）中，Opus 对 12 项技能的 86 次导入占其 RoboLab 策略的 52%，而 Kimi-k3 对 14 项技能的 73 次导入则占 42%；GPT-5.6-sol 进行了三次此类导入，其他两个模型则没有。 跨模型使用的技能包括伺服控制包装器和抓取惯用表达，每项技能的提升幅度为 +17 至 +36 分。 技能重用呈现长尾分布：排名前十的技能占据了 40% 至 68% 的使用次数，且独立谱系在不同名称下会趋同于相同概念。 记忆会随代码一同传播：Opus 谱系策略中有 83% 至 93% 携带了来自继承记忆的标识符，而这些标识符在匹配的无库策略中并不存在。 最终程序会导入谱系中 16% 至 21% 的技能模块，且每条谱系中有 96 至 133 项技能已被新版本覆盖。 在 RoboLab 上，VLA 库的记忆文件长度中位数为 180,000 个字符。 库的增益集中在模型单独无法完成的单元上：在 LIBERO-PRO 上，对于 Vanilla 得分低于 50% 的单元，两个最弱的模型分别获得了 +33 和 +39 分；而在它们已能解决的单元上，增益仅为 +2 和 +4 分；GPT-5.6-sol 的增益为 +25 对 +3 分；Kimi-k3 的增益为 +14 对 −1 分。 Kimi-k3 在 RoboLab 库上的增益随谱系推进而增长：在其最初七步中为 −26 分，从第 28 步开始则增至 +24 至 +35 分。 在 LIBERO-PRO 上冻结并重新评分后，Opus 经过 LIBERO 训练的谱系策略测试得分为 47.7%，而其最佳三选一策略的得分为 40.7%。

paragraphs.en: These tables support Section 4.3 . The groups are observational, not randomized interventions. A RoboLab session records 66 to 72 teacher episodes per agent-hour against about 490 on LIBERO, and ends with a median 109 to 122 successful demonstrations per task against 430 to 486. Among the 52 well-supplied RoboLab tasks, the reasoning gap within a placement count (1.2 and 9.4 percentage points) is within the task-to-task spread (permutation p = 0.57 p=0.57 ), while multi-placement demonstrations are roughly three times as long. Robosuite’s precise multi-stage tasks also stay hard: nut assembly scores 3% and two-arm handover 7%, against 100% for cube lifting.
paragraphs.zh: 这些表格支持第 4.3 节。 这些分组属于观察性研究，而非随机干预实验。 一个 RoboLab 会话每智能体-小时记录 66 至 72 个教师互动片段，而 LIBERO 上约为 490 个；每个任务的成功演示次数中位数为 109 至 122 次，而 LIBERO 上为 430 至 486 次。 在 52 个资源充足的 RoboLab 任务中，单次部署任务内的推理差距（1.2 和 9.4 个百分点）处于任务间差异范围内（置换检验 p = 0.57），而多次部署的演示时长大致是单次部署的三倍。 Robosuite 精确的多阶段任务同样具有挑战性：螺母组装任务的得分率为 3%，双臂交接任务为 7%，而立方体举升任务的得分率则为 100%。

sents.en: Robosuite’s precise multi-stage tasks also stay hard: nut assembly scores 3% and two-arm handover 7%, against 100% for cube lifting.

paragraphs.en: Two further limits follow from the setup rather than the model. Every AR session fine-tunes π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on teacher demonstrations by supervised learning, so the agent’s research choices all sit in the data: which tasks to collect more of, whether to add recovery rollouts and jittered starts, and how to fix the teacher. And without a judge, an agent’s own teacher becomes its bound: a self-exploration session verifies episodes with camera checks it writes itself, and its teacher is its own code policy, which passes 3 to 10% of the multi-step LIBERO-10 states, so the VLA sees few correct multi-step demonstrations and reaches 6 to 17% there against 40 to 85% on the single-stage suites (LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Object).
paragraphs.zh: 另有两个限制源于设置本身，而非模型。 每次 AR 会话都通过监督学习，基于教师示范对 π₀.₅ 进行微调，因此智能体的研究选择全部体现在数据中：要收集更多哪些任务、是否添加恢复性执行序列和随机化起始点，以及如何调整教师。 在没有评判者的情况下，智能体自身的教师便成为其界限：一次自我探索会话会通过摄像头检查来验证由它自己生成的回合，而它的教师就是其自身的代码策略——该策略在 LIBERO-10 的多步状态中仅能通过 3% 到 10% 的测试；因此，VLA 很少看到正确的多步示范，在此类任务上的表现仅为 6% 到 17%，而在单阶段套件（LIBERO-Spatial 和 LIBERO-Object）上则能达到 40% 到 85%。

paragraphs.en: The idea that an agent can improve its own performance through iterative self-evaluation predates the current generation of large language models but has been revitalized by their code-generation capabilities. Shinn et al. (2023) show that an agent can improve across repeated attempts with no weight update at all, by writing reflections on its own failures into an episodic memory that later attempts read. Zelikman et al. (2024) introduce the Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP), which recursively rewrites its own improvement procedure in code, demonstrating that language models can bootstrap increasingly effective optimization strategies without human-designed update rules. More recently, scaffold engineering has emerged as a complementary axis of self-improvement: rather than modifying model weights, agents evolve the scaffolding code that orchestrates their reasoning and tool use. Weng (2026) provides a comprehensive survey of this paradigm, distinguishing weight-level from scaffold-level improvement and cataloging the design patterns that enable it. Lin et al. (2026a) operationalize the idea by building coding agents that automatically evolve their own harness code through observability-driven feedback loops. A critical methodological concern is whether observed performance gains truly stem from improved strategies or merely from resampling. Lin et al. (2026b) address this directly, showing that a substantial fraction of apparent self-evolution in LLM agents can be attributed to lucky draws rather than genuine capability acquisition, and propose controlled protocols to disentangle the two.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过迭代自我评估来提升自身性能这一理念早于当前世代的大语言模型，但后者生成代码的能力使其重获新生。Shinn 等人 (2023) 指出，智能体无需任何权重更新，仅通过在每次尝试中记录自身失败并写入情景记忆（后续尝试会读取该记忆），就能在重复尝试中持续改进。Zelikman 等人 (2024) 提出了“自训练优化器”（Self-Taught Optimizer, STOP），它能递归地以代码形式重写自身的改进流程，证明了语言模型无需人类设计的更新规则，即可逐步构建出越来越有效的优化策略。 近期，“脚手架工程”成为自我提升的另一个补充方向：智能体不再修改模型权重，而是演化出用于协调推理和工具使用的脚手架代码。 Weng (2026) 对这一范式进行了全面综述，区分了权重层面的改进与脚手架层面的改进，并梳理了实现这些改进的设计模式。Lin 等人 (2026a) 通过构建编码智能体将这一理念付诸实践：这些智能体能通过以可观测性为驱动的反馈循环，自动演化自身的运行支持代码。 一个关键的方法论问题是：观察到的性能提升究竟是源于策略的真正改进，还是仅仅因为重新采样？Lin 等人 (2026b) 直接针对这一问题展开研究，表明大型语言模型智能体中相当一部分表观的“自我演化”实际上源于运气而非真实能力的获取，并提出了受控协议以区分这两种情况。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work develops benchmarks for measuring how well language model agents can conduct end-to-end research and engineering. Chan et al. (2024) introduce MLE-bench, which evaluates agents on Kaggle-style machine learning engineering tasks with automatic grading. Wijk et al. (2025) propose RE-Bench, which measures frontier AI R&D capabilities by asking agents to improve the performance of given ML systems under a time budget, emphasizing the distinction between one-shot coding and iterative self-improvement. Starace et al. (2025) scale the ambition further with PaperBench, which asks agents to replicate full AI research papers from scratch. Rank et al. (2026) focus specifically on post-training: PostTrainBench evaluates whether agents can automate the reward modeling, alignment, and fine-tuning pipeline for language models. In the embodied domain, Zhu et al. (2026) introduce EdgeBench, which studies scaling laws for agents that learn from real-world interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 一项并行研究致力于制定基准，用于衡量语言模型智能体在执行端到端研究和工程任务方面的表现。Chan 等人 （2024）提出了 MLE-bench，该基准通过自动评分机制，评估智能体在 Kaggle 风格的机器学习工程任务中的表现。Wijk 等人 （2025）提出了 RE-Bench，该基准通过要求智能体在时间限制内提升给定机器学习系统的性能，来衡量前沿人工智能研发能力，并强调了一次性编码与迭代自我改进之间的区别。Starace 等人 （2025）通过 PaperBench 进一步提升了挑战难度，该基准要求智能体从头开始复现完整的人工智能研究论文。Rank 等人 （2026）则专门聚焦于训练后阶段：PostTrainBench 评估智能体是否能够自动化语言模型的奖励建模、对齐和微调流程。 在具身智能领域，Zhu 等人 （2026）提出了 EdgeBench，该基准研究从真实世界交互中学习智能体的扩展定律。

paragraphs.en: Experience can enter the system through four complementary pathways ( Figure 14 ). First, the agent consolidates reusable code, procedures, and lessons into its skill and memory libraries. Second, generated policies serve as executable teachers: repeated rollouts produce data for training VLAs or other learned action and world models, with outcome-aware selection, since teachers are imperfect; successful trajectories support imitation, and failures can inform recovery learning. Third, the interaction history (observations, tool calls, program revisions, and outcomes) could provide training signal for the reasoning agent itself, turning simulation or physical interaction into an environment for reinforcement learning over the agent’s decisions. Fourth, the harness through which the agent observes and acts can itself be revised. Our rollout-driven π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} fine-tuning instantiates one connection in this loop; establishing the full cycle requires several rounds in which updated tools return to the agent, its strategy adapts, and the system is evaluated on held-out tasks, with comparisons that freeze individual components to show whether joint adaptation helps beyond updating each component alone.
paragraphs.zh: 经验可以通过四种互补的路径进入系统（图 14）。 首先，智能体将可重用的代码、程序和经验整合到其技能和记忆库中。 其次，生成的策略充当可执行的“教师”：重复执行会产生用于训练 VLA 或其他已学习的动作和世界模型的数据，并采用结果导向的选择方式，因为“教师”本身并不完美；成功的轨迹支持模仿学习，而失败则可以为恢复学习提供信息。 第三，交互历史（观察结果、工具调用、程序修订和结果）可以为推理智能体本身提供训练信号，从而将模拟或物理交互转化为一个用于强化学习的环境，以优化智能体的决策。 第四，智能体用于观察和行动的机制本身也可以被修订。 我们的基于执行流程的 π₀.₅ \pi_{0.5} 微调实现了这一循环中的一个连接；要建立完整的循环，需要进行多轮迭代：更新后的工具返回给智能体，其策略随之调整，并在预留的任务上对系统进行评估，通过冻结单个组件进行比较，以判断联合优化是否比单独更新每个组件更具帮助。

paragraphs.en: A key step in this loop is segmenting task instructions and collected trajectories into aligned, reusable action units. Rather than distilling an entire long-horizon task into a single behavior, we propose associating shorter trajectory segments with language descriptions of their local objectives. For example, placing a cup on a saucer can be decomposed into grasping the handle, lifting the cup, transporting it above the saucer, lowering it into contact, releasing the gripper, and withdrawing the arm. The reasoning agent or generated program connects these skills, checks their outcomes, and revises the sequence when execution deviates from the plan. Segmentation should therefore reflect meaningful changes in objectives and completion conditions rather than arbitrary temporal boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环中的一个关键步骤是将任务说明和收集到的轨迹分割为对齐且可重复使用的动作单元。 我们主张将较短的轨迹片段与其局部目标的语言描述相关联，而不是将整个长时程任务提炼为单一行为。 例如，将杯子放在碟子上可以分解为：握住把手、提起杯子、将其移至碟子上方、将其放低接触碟子、松开夹持器以及收回手臂。 推理智能体或生成的程序会连接这些技能，检查其结果，并在执行偏离计划时修正序列。 因此，分割应反映目标与完成条件的有意义的变化，而非随意的时间边界。

sents.en: Segmentation should therefore reflect meaningful changes in objectives and completion conditions rather than arbitrary temporal boundaries.
sents.zh: 因此，分割应反映目标与完成条件的有意义的变化，而非随意的时间边界。

paragraphs.en: This decomposition establishes a useful division of labor. The language backbone handles long-horizon reasoning, task composition, and recovery decisions, while the action model translates local language-conditioned objectives into smooth, high-frequency, continuous control. The action model can become a generalist across reusable manipulation skills, retaining the feedback responsiveness needed for execution without having to determine the full task strategy. Training on instruction-aligned segments could make experience reusable across tasks that share manipulation components but require different plans. Within the proposed co-evolution loop, the agent can refine both the segmentation and the skill descriptions as it learns which abstractions its action model can execute reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 这种分解建立了一种有效的分工。 语言主干负责处理长期推理、任务组合和恢复决策，而动作模型则将基于语言的局部目标转化为平滑、高频且连续的控制。 动作模型可以成为可重复使用的操控技能方面的通才，在执行过程中保留所需的反馈响应能力，而无需确定完整的任务策略。 在指令对齐的片段上进行训练，可以使经验在不同任务中重复使用，这些任务虽然共享操控组件，但需要不同的计划。 在拟议的协同进化循环中，智能体可以在学习哪些抽象概念能够被其动作模型可靠执行的同时，不断优化分段和技能描述。

paragraphs.en: The interaction harness itself can also evolve as the agent discovers limitations in how it observes, acts, and learns. Repeated failures may reveal that static images omit important execution events, motivating video feedback or richer temporal traces. Objects falling outside the reachable workspace may motivate explicit safety zones and motion constraints that preserve the conditions for continued practice. Experience can similarly inform tool interfaces, logging, reset procedures, and failure diagnostics. These changes improve the infrastructure through which subsequent policies are developed and executed, complementing updates to skills, memories, and model tools. In SEAR only skills and memories persist between tasks ( Section 2 ); the proposed loop would also carry model weights forward, and a system that can revise its own harness carries one more kind of state, which we would treat on the same grounds. Interaction informs changes to the harness, which in turn changes the evidence and actions available in future rounds. To evaluate this process reliably, harness revisions should be versioned and assessed while keeping final evaluation criteria and protected test information outside the agent’s modification scope.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体发现其在观察、行动和学习方式上的局限性，交互框架本身也可以随之演化。 反复的失败可能表明静态图像遗漏了重要的执行事件，从而推动采用视频反馈或更丰富的时序痕迹。 超出可达工作空间范围的物体可能会促使系统设立明确的安全区域和运动约束，以维持持续练习所需的条件。 经验同样可以为工具界面、日志记录、重置流程以及故障诊断提供指导。 这些变化能够改进后续策略开发和执行所依赖的基础设施，同时补充技能、记忆和模型工具的更新。 在 SEAR 中，只有技能和记忆会在任务之间保留（第 2 节）；而所提出的循环机制还会将模型权重延续下去，一个能够自我修订框架的系统则多了一种状态类型，我们也会基于同样的理由将其纳入考量。 交互会推动框架的变化，而这些变化反过来又会改变未来回合中可用的证据和行动。 为了可靠地评估这一过程，框架的修订版本应被版本化并加以评估，同时确保最终的评估标准和受保护测试信息不被纳入智能体的修改范围。
